title: Director - AI Product Management
description: Job Description:. . . . . The Director - AI Product Management owns an AI-first product domain end-to-end at Vertex, Inc., from product strategy and roadmap through customer experience and commercial readiness. This is a Director-level, hands-on leadership role with initial direct reports and a growing team. The role requires someone who operates both strategically and tactically: engaging directly with customers, unifying AI capabilities, agents, workflows, and platform integrations under a coherent product strategy, and translating customer learning into product priorities and roadmap decisions with urgency. The incoming director is expected to form a market positioning view within the first 30 days, engage actively with customer and onboarding data within 60 days, and deliver an updated roadmap informed by customer and design partner feedback within 90 days. Own the full lifecycle of an AI-first product: strategy, roadmap, commercial readiness, and customer experience. Unify product outcomes, AI agents, capabilities, workflows, platform integrations, and SKU considerations under a single, coherent product strategy. Engage directly with customers to identify what is and is not working; translate insights, onboarding data, and design partner feedback into product priorities and roadmap decisions. Identify product gaps, prioritize improvements, and drive resolution with urgency in a hands-on, customer-facing environment. Pitch and demonstrate the product to customers and stakeholders; represent Vertex in customer-facing settings and at industry forums. Lead, mentor, and grow a small and expanding team of direct reports; mobilize cross-functional partners to deliver against product outcomes. Partner with engineering, AI, and platform teams to integrate agents, workflows, and capabilities into a unified customer experience. Drive product commercialization, maintain competitive awareness, and contribute to differentiated market positioning. Occasional travel required.. Required Qualifications. 12+ years of product management experience in SaaS or cloud environments. 5 years' experience delivering commercial SaaS or AI-first products to market. Experience with AI-first product development, including agent-based workflows and platform and ecosystem integration; proven ability to design products that bring together AI agents, capabilities, and integrations into a unified customer outcome. Customer-facing product leadership: experience working directly with customers, pitching and demonstrating products, and translating customer feedback into product decisions and roadmap priorities. Excellence project management skills to identify product gaps, prioritize improvements, and drive outcomes rapidly in a hands-on, high-urgency environment. Experience with people management and demonstrated ability to influence implementation, sales engineering, and marketing to drive product success. Excellent communication and presentation skills representing a product to customers, senior leadership, and external audiences.. Preferred Qualifications. Background in tax, accounting, or a related regulated domain; experience in the tax technology space is particularly compelling. People-management experience with a track record of developing and growing direct reports. Commercial AI product experience including product SKU design and go-to-market execution. Experience in customer implementation, sales engineering, professional services, or UX, with a track record of translating customer learning into product decisions. Bachelor's degree in business, or a related field; equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree.. COMMENTS:. title: Security Operations Engineer
description: Job Description:. . . . . Vertex Inc. is looking for a Security Operations Engineer role to strengthen our security monitoring, incident response, detection engineering, and SecOps automation capabilities. This role is ideal for a hands-on security practitioner who has a passion for investigating threats, responding to incidents, improving security tooling, and building operational solutions that help security teams work faster and more effectively. Given the 24/7/365 nature of the security operations function, the Security Operations Engineer participates in a rotating shift schedule designed to provide continuous security analysis and incident response coverage. Within the coverage, this will require working nights, weekends, holidays, and extended hours based on the assigned coverage and operational needs. . . Responsibilities. . Monitor, triage, investigate, and respond to security alerts across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, SaaS, and application environments. . Lead end-to-end incident response - detection through containment, eradication, recovery, and post-incident improvement - including root-cause analysis and corrective action tracking. . Build, tune, and maintain detection logic across SIEM, EDR, cloud, and network platforms; conduct proactive threat hunting aligned to MITRE ATT&CK. . Develop and maintain SecOps tooling, scripts, API integrations, and workflow automations to improve investigation speed and response execution. . Apply AI responsibly in SecOps workflows, with the ability to explain, validate , test, and maintain all AI-assisted outputs. . Collaborate cross-functionally to close telemetry gaps, improve detection coverage, and translate incident findings into lasting security improvements. . . Required Qualifications. . Hands-on knowledge in security operations, incident response, detection engineering, or threat hunting, with demonstrated ability to lead significant investigations. . Strong knowledge of attacker tactics and techniques across endpoint, identity, network, cloud, and email environments, including MITRE ATT&CK mapping and IOC analysis. . Experience with SIEM platforms (Sentinel, Splunk, Chronicle, QRadar , or Elastic) and proficiency writing and tuning detection queries using KQL, SPL, Sigma, YARA, or equivalent. . Experience with EDR/XDR platforms (Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, SentinelOne , Cortex XDR, or Carbon Black), including triage, investigation, and containment. . Scripting or automation experience using Python, PowerShell, or Bash; AI-assisted development acceptable provided the candidate can explain, validate , test, and maintain the code. . Practical use of AI tooling for securit y - such as Claude, GitHub Copilot, or OpenAI Codex - to accelerate tooling development, detection drafting, and a nalysi s workflows. . Experience with at least one cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP, or OCI), including cloud logging, identity, and security monitoring. . Solid understanding of identity security, including MFA, conditional access, privileged access, token abuse, and identity-based attacks. . Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex security issues to technical and non-technical audiences. . Independent, self-starter, analytical, evidence-driven work style with strong attention to detail. . . Preferred Qualifications. . Bachelor's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Assurance, Computer Science, or a related field. . Experience with threat intelligence, malware triage, digital forensics, or reverse engineering. . Experience with vulnerability management or compliance-driven SecOps (SOC 2, ISO 27001, PCI DSS, or HIPAA). . Familiarity with detection-as-code, Git-based workflows, CI/CD pipelines, and code review practices. . Relevant certifications such as GIAC (GCFA, GCIH, GCFR, GCLD, GDAT, or GEIR), OffSec (OSIR, OSTH, OSCP, or OSAI), AWS Security Specialty, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, Microsoft SC-200, or CompTIA CASP+. . Equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant professional experience accepted in lieu of a formal degree. . . COMMENTS:. title: GTM Operations Analyst – Analytics & Automation
description: Job Description:. . . . . As part of the Global Go-to-Market (GTM) Operations team, this hands-on role delivers commercial analysis, reporting, and automation across the commercial organization. . Working alongside GTM Operations colleagues, business leaders, and technical specialists, the Analyst develops reliable insights and practical solutions that improve decision-making and reduce manual work. This role takes ownership of agreed initiatives while building on existing capabilities and supporting reuse across regions. . Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities. Partner with commercial stakeholders and GTM Operations colleagues to understand business needs and deliver agreed analytics and automation initiatives. Build and maintain dashboards, reports, and analytical models supporting planning, pipeline management, forecasting, and commercial execution. Identify trends, risks, and opportunities, translating analysis into clear insights and recommendations. Develop workflow automations and AI-assisted solutions, working with technical specialists on complex requirements and integrations. title: Principal AI Engineer
description: Job Description:. . . . . The Principal AI Engineer provides technical leadership in the design, development, training, orchestration, and operationalization of enterprise AI systems. This role defines strategy and technical standards across traditional AI/ML models, large language models, model training and fine-tuning, data and retrieval systems, and agentic AI architectures. The Principal AI Engineer remains deeply hands-on while partnering across product and platform teams to build scalable, reliable, secure, and high-quality AI capabilities.. Essential Job Functions and Responsibilities. Define and own technical strategy across enterprise AI systems, spanning traditional AI/ML models, large language models, model training and fine-tuning, retrieval, orchestration, and agentic AI. Design, train, fine-tune, evaluate, and optimize traditional AI/ML models and large language models using parameter-efficient techniques (e.g., QLoRA, LoRA, PEFT) and full fine-tuning where warranted. Design orchestration and abstraction layers that connect LLMs to enterprise tools, data, APIs, and specialized sub-agents while decoupling product teams from underlying models and providers. Design, build, and operate MCP (Model Context Protocol) servers and establish standards for how AI tools and capabilities are defined, exposed, versioned, and consumed. Design and optimize retrieval (RAG) systems, including chunking strategies, embedding models, vector stores, hybrid/keyword search, re-ranking, and context assembly. Design and optimize data pipelines for ingestion, cleaning, labeling, feature engineering, storage, versioning, and reuse of training, validation, and test datasets. Build reproducible AI/ML pipelines and establish standards for experiment tracking, dataset management, model versioning, checkpoints, metrics, and evaluation. Define evaluation methodologies and benchmarks across model, retrieval, and orchestration quality, including regression testing, retrieval precision/recall, tool-selection accuracy, task success, latency, and cost. Build routing, context-window management, memory, observability, and tracing strategies for multi-step and agentic AI workflows. Establish practices for AI data governance, lineage, quality, licensing/consent, PII handling, safety, guardrails, authentication, and access control. Partner with product and platform teams to operationalize AI capabilities, onboard tools and agents, and transition trained and fine-tuned models into production. Mentor engineers, establish technical standards and best practices, and raise AI engineering maturity across teams.. Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities. Strong hands-on experience designing, training, fine-tuning, and deploying traditional AI/ML models and large language models in production environments. Deep experience with parameter-efficient fine-tuning (QLoRA, LoRA, PEFT), quantization, model evaluation, and the tradeoffs between fine-tuning approaches. Deep hands-on experience with LLM orchestration, agentic AI patterns, MCP servers, tool/function calling, and frameworks such as LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Semantic Kernel, or equivalents. Deep experience with retrieval/RAG architectures, including chunking strategies, embeddings, vector databases, hybrid search, re-ranking, and context assembly. Proficiency with ML/DL frameworks and libraries such as PyTorch, Hugging Face Transformers/PEFT/TRL, and scikit-learn. Experience building and operating scalable data and AI pipelines and platforms using technologies such as Spark, Ray, dbt, or equivalents. Strong understanding of AI/ML data management, including dataset storage architecture, versioning, lineage, governance, quality, and PII handling. Experience with AI/ML evaluation, experiment tracking, reproducibility, observability, distributed training, and compute, cost, and latency optimization. Ability to define enterprise AI strategy, architecture, technical standards, and best practices while remaining hands-on in code. Strong stakeholder collaboration, technical leadership, mentoring, and problem-solving skills.. Education and Experience. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related discipline; advanced degree in ML, AI, or Data Science preferred. 12 or more years of experience in AI/ML engineering, applied ML, or data engineering, with significant hands-on model training and fine-tuning. description: Job Description:. . . . . This position is a senior-level role responsible for leading the design, implementation, and maintenance of scalable, secure, and high-performance software systems across multiple projects. title: Senior AI Security Engineer
description: Job Description:. . . . . Job Description Summary. The AI Security Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for securing the AI systems, models, and pipelines that power Vertex's products. This role partners with product engineering, platform, governance, and information security teams to identify, assess, and mitigate risks specific to large language models, retrieval-augmented generation, agentic workflows, and the AI supply chain. Operating at the intersection of offensive research, defensive engineering, and policy, this role translates the evolving AI threat landscape into concrete, measurable controls. Design, develop, and deploy security capabilities that protect AI and Agentic AI systems. . Perform threat modeling, security reviews, and vulnerability analysis across LLM-enabled applications, RAG systems, inference pipelines, and agentic workflows. . Conduct hands-on and automated red team testing focused on AI-specific risks, including prompt injection; document reproducible failure modes and drive durable mitigations with engineering teams. . Build and extend AI security automation, evaluation harnesses, and secure-by-default patterns covering AI system design, development, deployment, and least-privilege agent configurations. . Define agent coordination, delegation, and escalation patterns; guide developers on security and privacy best practices for agentic coding and MCP-enabled tooling. . Monitor emerging AI threats and platform changes; translate relevant risks into prioritized controls and ensure full system traceability using identity, security, and logging frameworks. . Serve as the AI security incident SME, providing rapid triage, root-cause analysis, and proactive collaboration with defensive security teams. . Identify and resolve cross-team technical risks and dependencies to sustain AI security program delivery. . Required Qualifications. 5+ years of experience in security engineering, application security, AI/ML engineering, or security architecture, with hands-on experience securing AI/ML or LLM-based systems. . Demonstrated ability to independently lead security reviews for complex AI systems and drive mitigation plans across engineering teams with limited oversight. . Practical experience assessing AI-specific risks: prompt injection, insecure output handling, sensitive data exposure, excessive agency, model and data supply chain weaknesses, and unsafe retrieval or memory patterns. . Advanced understanding of AI system behavior, including model vulnerabilities, evaluation results, and security-relevant failure modes. . Proficiency in Python (or equivalent) for security automation, evaluation scripts, test harnesses, and evidence-collection workflows. . Working knowledge of modern AI stacks - model APIs, orchestration frameworks, vector databases, retrieval pipelines, and agentic workflows - and at least one major cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure). . Familiarity with AI security and governance frameworks (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001); strong written and verbal communication skills for both technical and non-technical audiences. . Preferred Qualifications. Experience leading AI red team engagements, test-and-evaluation activities, secure AI design reviews, or product security programs across multiple teams. . Experience deploying, integrating, or securing AI/ML systems in production or customer-facing environments outside of a lab setting. . Hands-on experience with AI security tooling, model scanning, or custom evaluation harnesses. . Background in cloud security, IAM, application security, data protection, logging/monitoring, incident response, or security operations for production systems. . Experience coordinating technical work across product, platform, and security stakeholders. . External contributions, presentations, or publications in AI security, adversarial AI, AI assurance, or secure AI engineering. . title: Account Executive, SaaS Product Line Specialist
description: About the Team & Role. Rubrik's Product Line Sales organization drives focused growth across Rubrik's specialized workloads, including our SaaS data protection and security portfolio (Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, Salesforce, and other critical SaaS applications). This team partners closely with core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success to bring deep product and technical expertise into every SaaS opportunity - from first conversation through technical validation to close. We're hiring a SaaS Product Line Sales Specialist to own and accelerate Rubrik's SaaS data protection business within a defined territory. This is a highly technical, quota-carrying overlay role: you'll be the subject-matter expert who can go deep on tenant architecture, identity and access models, backup and recovery mechanics, and the shared responsibility model - and use that fluency to win deals against SaaS-native point solutions. The ideal candidate has sold in this exact space before, at a company like AvePoint, CoreView, or Keepit, and understands both the buyer and the competitive landscape intimately. What You'll Do. Own the SaaS product line number: partner with core Account Executives to identify, qualify, and close SaaS data protection and security opportunities across net-new and existing accounts. Lead with technical credibility: articulate Rubrik's SaaS architecture, security posture, and the gaps in Microsoft's and Google's native shared responsibility model in a way that resonates with both technical and business buyers. Drive technical discovery and validation: run or co-lead discovery calls, demos, and proof-of-concept engagements for M365, Google Workspace, and Salesforce workloads alongside Sales Engineers. Win competitive deals: build and defend positioning against SaaS-native vendors (AvePoint, CoreView, Keepit, Veeam, Druva, and similar), translating technical differentiation into business value. Build territory and account plans: develop a coverage strategy in partnership with core sales, SE, and channel teams to maximize SaaS attach and expansion within the install base. Engage multiple stakeholders: present to IT administrators, security and compliance teams, and executive economic buyers, tailoring the message to each audience. Forecast with discipline: maintain accurate pipeline and forecast data in Salesforce and participate in regular business reviews. Stay current: maintain deep knowledge of Rubrik's SaaS roadmap, the M365/Google Workspace/Salesforce ecosystems, and the competitive landscape. Experience You'll Need. SaaS sales experience: 3+ years of quota-carrying sales experience selling SaaS data protection, security, or governance solutions for Microsoft 365, Google Workspace, or Salesforce environments. Directly relevant background: experience at a SaaS data protection or management vendor such as AvePoint, CoreView, or Keepit (or a comparable company like Druva, Veeam, or Spanning) is strongly preferred. Genuine technical depth: comfortable discussing tenant architecture, APIs, identity and access management (Entra ID/Azure AD), backup and recovery mechanics, and security and compliance frameworks without relying solely on a Sales Engineer. Proven technical selling motion: a track record of running or co-leading technical discovery and proof-of-concept engagements, not just handing off to a technical resource. Consultative approach: comfortable navigating complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles across IT, security, and executive buyers in mid-market and enterprise accounts. Overlay/specialist experience: prior success working in a platform-selling model alongside core Account Executives, Sales Engineers, and Customer Success. Track record: consistent history of quota attainment and strong pipeline generation. Education: bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Preferred Qualifications. Hands-on familiarity with Microsoft 365 administration, Entra ID/Azure AD, or Salesforce administration. Experience selling a data security or resiliency platform that spans SaaS, cloud, and on-premises workloads. Existing relationships with IT, security, or compliance buyers in target accounts. #LI-CG1. title: Channels Operations Manager, Managed Services
description: Job Summary. Rubrik's Global Partner Organization is seeking an experienced and strategic leader to serve as a trusted business partner to our managed services ecosystem. In this role, you will own the operational strategy, program design, and go-to-market execution for Rubrik's managed services business-driving alignment across managed service providers (MSPs), field sales, marketing, and product teams. This is not a transactional operations role. You will act as a strategic advisor to MSP partners and internal stakeholders alike, shaping how Rubrik engages with and grows its MSP channel. You bring a proven track record of influencing without authority, building lasting partner relationships, and translating business strategy into executable programs. Your efforts will directly influence Rubrik's market positioning and revenue growth in managed services. *** This position requires a minimum of 2 days/week at Rubrik's HQ in Palo Alto, CA ***. What You'll Do:. Strategic Partnership: Build deep relationships with MSP leadership to drive mutual growth and platform commitment. Business Planning: Create annual and semi-annual business plans with sales, setting shared goals and performance milestones. Performance Management: Lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to assess progress, address risks, and align on future priorities. Programs: Partner with the programs and incentives team to evolve the MSP program framework, including partner tiers, onboarding requirements, incentive structures, and growth criteria that reward and accelerate top performers. GTM Strategy: Develop and evangelize a GTM Strategy and Plan for the managed services route to market, galvanizing cross-functional action and ensuring consistent execution across field, marketing, and partner teams. Data & Metrics: Define and track metrics for individual MSP performance and program health, creating leading-indicator frameworks that enable proactive intervention and growth planning. Pipeline and Forecast: Drive pipeline accountability and forecast accuracy across the MSP channel, partnering with sales leadership to ensure visibility and predictability in MSP-sourced revenue. Process and tools: Lead highly cross-functional initiatives to identify and close gaps in managed services processes and systems, working across sales, product, finance, and partner success. Internal Advocacy: Serve as the internal champion for MSP partner needs, translating partner feedback into actionable insights for product, marketing, and enablement teams. Experience You'll Need:. To be successful in this role, candidates should meet the following requirements:. Minimum of a Bachelor's degree from an accredited four-year university. 5-7 years in a strategy and operations, channel operations, or partner success function within a technology or SaaS environment. Track record of serving as a strategic advisor or business partner to external partners or customers, driving joint business planning and outcomes. Proven ability to own and drive large cross-functional GTM initiatives in a fast-paced enterprise environment. Robust analytical background with familiarity with Salesforce, Tableau, or equivalent tools for pipeline and performance reporting. Preferred Skills:. Ability to develop trust-based with cross-functional internal stakeholders, driving alignment and results without direct authority. Experience managing channel ecosystems at scale, with a strong understanding of the MSP business model and go-to-market motion. Strategic mindset with the ability to develop a GTM playbook in line with organizational objectives, then operationalize it across teams. Strong analytical instincts-able to deconstruct complex problems, leverage data to drive decisions, and translate insights into partner-facing and executive-ready recommendations. Aptitude to identify growth opportunities within the managed services route to market and build programs that capture them. Solid experience with Salesforce and Tableau; comfort working with pipeline data and partner performance metrics. Excellent communication and executive presence-comfortable presenting to senior leaders, facilitating partner executive sessions, and driving cross-functional alignment. #LI-MR1. title: Corporate Accounting Leader
description: The Global Corporate Accounting team manages and drives the close which is a critical process for ensuring accurate and timely financial statements for cross functional teams including the SEC reporting and finance teams. Our partners primarily include FP&A, Revenue Ops, Financial Reporting, Tax, Treasury, IT, Sales Ops, Engineering, and Global Workplace Services. We operate a global team and work in lockstep with our offshore Corporate Accounting shared services team to enhance and scale processes. The Corporate Accounting team is responsible for accounting, adoption of new standards, and operationalizing the following areas including, but not limited to, payroll and related benefits, commissions, leases, and capitalized software, in accordance with US GAAP. We are looking for a seasoned and experienced Corporate Accounting Leader to lead our Corporate Accounting team. This leader will shape the future state accounting function roadmap, automation strategy, and how AI reshapes the close as the company scales. In this role, you will bring knowledge of best practices and proven experience scaling accounting processes to drive the team. You will mentor the team and leverage AI to drive efficiencies to the close process while staying in compliance with regulatory requirements such as SOX. You will work cross-functionally across the organization solving complex problems and driving a culture of transparency and accountability. Your influencing skills will extend your impact deep into the broader finance org and beyond. This role reports to the Senior Director, Assistant Controller at our HQ in Palo Alto and is an in-office hybrid role 3 days a week. What you'll do:. Continually Enhanced and Scale the Close Process: Develop and execute a plan on how to scale the global accounting close process while incorporating changes in the business. Demonstrated use of AI/automation in accounting processes. Develop and Defend Accounting Positions: Prepare and/or review accounting memos with ambiguous facts and situations and arrive at the appropriate conclusion. Mentor and Develop: Lead and mentor a team of corporate accounting professionals, as well as an offshore shared services team and relevant stakeholders. Positive Impact to Cross-Functional Organizations: Work closely with stakeholders to drive positive change for Rubrik. External Audit and SOX/Internal Controls Readiness: Ensure work product is compliant with US GAAP/PCAOB and SOX. Ensure high quality and timely deliverables to external/internal auditors. We're looking for someone who has:. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field; CPA or equivalent certification is required. 12+ years of relevant experience, ideally with a mix of Big 4 public accounting and high-growth public software/technology company; have worked in Corporate Accounting and other functions within a CAO. Possess deep understanding of US GAAP; experience with reducing close timeline within sacrificing accuracy; worked in an environment that complies with SOX controls and Big 4 external audits requirements. Extensive experience with accounting tools (e.g., Netsuite, Xactly, LeaseQuery, Coupa) and Excel/Google Sheets. Experience with AI tools. Have a vision on what an efficient Corporate Accounting function should look like at scale in a high growth environment and drive change. Ability to adapt and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. title: Customer Success Engineer/ Sr Customer Success Engineer
description: Customer Success Engineer/ Sr Customer Success Engineer. Location: Tokyo, Japan. Role Overview. As a Senior Customer Success Engineer focused on technical support, you will provide enterprise-level post-deployment support to Rubrik customers across Japan. You will troubleshoot complex data protection and cyber-resilience issues, drive rapid resolution of support cases, and ensure our customers can rely on Rubrik Security Cloud to protect and recover their critical data and workloads. This role is part of Rubrik's Global Customer Support and Success Organization and is Japan-remote. About Rubrik. Rubrik is on a mission to secure the world's data. With Zero Trust Data Security™, Rubrik helps organizations achieve business resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. Rubrik Security Cloud, powered by machine learning, secures data across enterprise, cloud, and SaaS applications. Rubrik helps organizations uphold data integrity, deliver data availability that withstands adverse conditions, continuously monitor data risks and threats, and restore businesses with their data when infrastructure is attacked. Rubrik.com. About the Team. Rubrik's Global Customer Support and Success Organization is a team of professionals committed to providing a world-class post‑purchase experience. The team delivers post‑deployment technical support to customers and partners across a wide range of technologies and cloud deployments and ensures timely activation and adoption of Rubrik's SaaS products and technologies. The Customer Support Team is composed of seasoned experts in data management and security who possess an in‑depth knowledge of Rubrik's solutions, data protection, and recovery strategies. They are skilled at swiftly diagnosing and solving complex issues while keeping the overall customer experience at the forefront. What You Will Do. Provide expert‑level technical support to enterprise customers across Japan via phone, web, email, and other support channels. Provide local-language support in Japanese, ensuring customers can interact in their preferred language across phone, email, and written channels. Handle all levels of technical support cases - from basic configuration questions to complex issues involving snapshots, replication, data recovery, networking, and cloud deployments. Listen to customer concerns, use structured troubleshooting and problem analysis techniques to isolate root causes, and recommend/implement appropriate solutions. Independently diagnose and resolve problems across Rubrik Security Cloud and supported environments (VMware, Linux, Kubernetes, AWS, Azure, databases, and SaaS workloads), partnering with Support Engineering and Product Engineering on escalations when needed. Perform cluster health checks, monitor the health and performance of customer environments, and proactively identify risks or improvement opportunities. Follow standard procedures for proper escalation of unresolved issues to internal teams and drive escalations to timely resolution. Communicate clearly and regularly with customers on case progress, next steps, and action plans; ensure proper recording and closure of all issues. Create and contribute technical content to Rubrik's knowledge base, deployment guides, FAQs, and internal runbooks. Provide feedback from customers and the field to Support Engineering, Product, and Engineering teams to drive product enhancements and improvements. Mentor junior engineers and contribute to repeatable troubleshooting playbooks that improve efficiency and customer experience. Work in shifts, including occasional weekends, as required to support customers. What You Will Bring. 6+ years in enterprise technical support, DevOps, or similar customer‑facing technical roles, troubleshooting complex infrastructure, data protection, and cloud issues, including advanced issues such as snapshots, replication, and data recovery. Strong hands‑on expertise with:. Virtualization (VMware vCenter & ESXi). Linux administration. Networking fundamentals. Cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure, and/or Google Cloud Platform. Backup and recovery concepts and enterprise storage. Databases, preferably MSSQL. Office 365 /SharePoint. Experience troubleshooting and supporting workloads such as databases, virtual and physical servers, and SaaS applications. Hands‑on experience with cloud deployments and managing applications running on cloud platforms. Strong problem‑solving, troubleshooting, and analytical skills, with the ability to lead complex technical escalations through to resolution. Native or near‑native Japanese (business‑level) and business‑level English, with the ability to provide end‑to‑end technical support in Japanese (phone, email, and written documentation) while collaborating with global internal teams. Excellent written and verbal communication skills and strong interpersonal skills. Self‑driven, proactive, hardworking team player with a commitment to customer success. Willingness to learn and adapt to the entire technology stack. Comfort with filing bugs, documenting problem scenarios, and working closely with Engineering to reproduce and resolve issues. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. Bonus Points. Experience with Rubrik or other data‑protection platforms such as Cohesity, Veeam, Veritas, NetApp, or similar. title: Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention
description: Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention. The Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention is responsible for reducing churn, improving customer health, and protecting recurring revenue through early risk detection, cross‑functional mitigation, and scalable retention programs. The role partners closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Competitive Intelligence, and Pricing & Packaging to orchestrate coordinated customer‑save strategies. This role also provides renewal objection handling expertise , enabling teams to navigate downsells, downgrades, competitive threats, pricing pushback, TCO/ROI concerns, and budget constraints. The ideal candidate excels at influencing cross‑functional teams, handling commercial risk, and translating customer insights into save actions. Key Responsibilities. 1. Churn Risk Identification & Health Intelligence. Maintain a standardized customer risk scoring framework leveraging health signals, product usage, support patterns, sentiment, and competitive exposure. Identify early risk indicators (e.g., discount cliffs, adoption gaps, under-deployed licenses, sponsor turnover). Partner with Renewal Ops, Data team to automate risk workflows in Salesforce. Collaborate with Competitive Intelligence to map competitive displacement trends and update counter strategies. 2. Cross‑Functional Risk Orchestration (Renewals, CS, CI, Pricing). Lead weekly renewal risk reviews/war rooms with Renewals, CSMs/CEMs, and Sales to align on mitigation actions. Build account-level mitigation plans that include adoption interventions, executive alignment, value reinforcement, and commercial flexibility. Partner with Pricing & Packaging and Deal Desk to design controlled commercial offers (e.g., term/ramp, New Product Introductions, New SKU Impact, Product Bundling etc). Escalate systemic product, billing, or support issues and track resolution. 3. Renewal Objection Handling. Serve as the subject‑matter expert for Renewals by providing guidance, playbooks, and strategic support to overcome critical renewal objections. Diagnose downsell and downgrade risks , recommend right‑sizing strategies, and deliver value‑based narratives to reinforce ROI and prevent unnecessary revenue loss. Partner with Competitive Intelligence to address competitive pricing challenges, coach teams on TCO and switching‑cost comparisons, and collaborate with Pricing on controlled incentive structures. Provide Renewals reps with ROI models, justification materials, payment‑flexibility options, pricing guardrails, and negotiation strategies to resolve budget and pricing objections while protecting retention revenue. 4. Preemptive Retention Programs. Launch and manage proactive churn-prevention programs , such as:. Early renewal health checks. Competitive threat campaigns. Discount cliff mitigation. description: Cyber Resilience Architect, APJ. . Rubrik is seeking a Cyber Resilience Architect (Field CTO) to drive technical strategy and business leadership across the APJ region.. In this role you will act as a transformation architect operating at the intersection of business strategy and technical execution. You will help large enterprises modernize their approach to Data Protection, Cyber Recovery, Identity Resilience, and AI-driven security and governance. You are accountable for influencing regional revenue outcomes by leading high-impact discovery, shaping differentiated architectures, and guiding strategic account execution. You will evangelize and architect Rubrik's portfolio across on-prem, cloud, SaaS, identity, cyber resilience, and AI solutions. Core Responsibilities. Executive Advisory: Serve as a trusted advisor to CIOs, CISOs, and Board. Partner with CIOs on modern data protection, operational efficiency, and cloud strategy. Partner with CISOs on cyber resilience, identity protection, and breach recovery readiness. At the executive level, position data resilience as a board-level priority - aligning Rubrik's platform to measurable outcomes such as operational continuity, risk reduction, regulatory compliance, and AI readiness. Revenue Acceleration: Partner with regional leadership to hit revenue goals by leading high-impact technical discoveries and architecting innovative solutions for Tier-1 accounts. Deal Orchestration: Master the MEDDIC framework to qualify opportunities, identifying technical "champions" and neutralizing competitive threats through superior architecture. Product Liaison: Distill complex field requirements into actionable insights for the Product Management team, ensuring the APJ voice influences our global roadmap. Technical Leadership: Design integrated solutions across On-Prem, SaaS, Identity, and Multi-Cloud environments, with a specific focus on Cyber Security including designing isolated recovery environments (IRE) and clean room recovery. Market Evangelism: Represent Rubrik at select industry events and executive forums. Contribute to thought leadership initiatives and support key marketing engagements as needed. This is an important but limited portion of the role, with primary focus remaining on strategic account execution and revenue impact. About you. 18+ years in Sales Engineering or Technical Consulting, with consistent success in winning 7-figure enterprise deals across APJ. Strong executive presence with experience engaging CIO, CISO, and Board-level stakeholders. You have deep roots in data protection, disaster recovery, and cybersecurity (zero-trust, isolated recovery environments, cyber recovery). Commercially astute - able to connect technical strategy to financial and operational impact. Entrepreneurial - willing to go the extra mile, strong work ethic, resourceful, "get it done" attitude. Strives in moving in a fast-paced environment; including handling multiple calls/demos per day with immediate follow up. Strong understanding of APJ market dynamics, regulatory landscapes, and cultural nuances. Bachelor's degree required or equivalent experience. title: Director, Corporate IT — Employee Experience & AI
description: About Rubrik. Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection, and management in the emerging multi-cloud world. We are the leader in cloud data management, delivering a single platform to manage and protect data in the cloud, at the edge, and on-premises. Enterprises choose Rubrik to simplify backup and recovery, accelerate cloud adoption, enable automation at scale, and secure against cyber threats. We've been recognized as a Forbes Cloud 100 Company two years in a row and as a LinkedIn Top 10 startup. Rubrik provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or genetics. In addition to federal law requirements, Rubrik complies with applicable state and local laws governing nondiscrimination in employment in every location in which the company has facilities. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation, and training. Job Introduction. Corporate IT has traditionally been measured by how well it works a queue: tickets raised, tickets closed, SLAs met. That era is ending. Automating a ticket only makes a broken model faster. We want to remove the ticket. We are hiring a Director of Corporate IT to lead Employee Experience globally at Rubrik and rebuild it with AI at the center. The goal is ticketless service: from hire to retirement, an employee's access, devices, tools, and answers arrive before they have to ask. Our north star is "My Digital Twin", an agentic layer carrying an employee's full context alongside the organization's memory: role, team, entitlements, assets, policy, and history. A system with that context does not need a form. It provisions, anticipates, explains, and repairs. This is a multi-year journey, starting from a real environment that thousands of employees depend on daily. You will own both halves: run the global service organization at a high standard today, and dismantle the parts of it that AI should replace tomorrow. Neither can slip. The team you will lead spans the US, India, and other regions, and the employees you serve are spread across every Rubrik site. The role is based onsite in Bangalore and forms part of the onsite management team there, while the mandate, the standards you set, and the roadmap you own are global. The environment. A globally distributed estate: Windows, macOS, and Linux endpoints, virtual desktops, conference rooms across sites in multiple regions, and a broad portfolio of third-party SaaS and open source applications. Collaboration and identity tools: Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, etc. Endpoint and MDM: VMware Workspace ONE, Jamf, Microsoft Intune, etc. VDI and remote desktop environments. AV and conferencing: Google Meet, Zoom, room systems, digital signage, event production. ITSM: Atlassian (Jira Cloud, Confluence, Opsgenie, Jira Service Management). Public cloud provider environments: GCP, Azure, AWS, etc. Enterprise AI: Claude Code and Claude Cowork, Glean, and other LLM and agent platforms. and others. What you will be doing. Run the business: operational excellence today. Own the global end-user service portfolio: Tech Lounge, ticketing, email and Slack support channels, escalations, and reporting, delivered consistently across regions and time zones. Own endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, the VDI estate, and AV and conferencing technology including room reliability and all-hands production. Own administration, governance, and adoption of enterprise AI tooling for employees. Hire, develop, and coach a globally distributed team of support staff and systems engineers across the US, India, and other locations, and grow site and functional leaders under you. Set one global service standard while respecting local needs: follow-the-sun coverage, consistent tooling and policy, shared knowledge, and a single escalation model across sites. Run IT service management to established practice (for example ITIL), own office-wide communications for incidents, outages, and changes, and keep a continual improvement focus across every technology area. Own the procurement forecast and vendor relationships for corporate and end-user IT globally, including India, partner with Information Security on identity, endpoint, and access, and carry IT-managed systems through SOC 2, SOX, and PCI audits. Represent operations in cross-functional programs under the Global IT Strategy & Operations pillar, spanning Global Service Desk, IT Supply Chain, AVOps, and InfraOps. Change the business: build toward ticketless. Own the global ticketless roadmap: a multi-year sequence with milestones that can be measured and defended, and a rollout sequence across regions rather than a pilot that never leaves one site. Re-architect hire-to-retire as event-driven rather than request-driven, so joiner, mover, and leaver events trigger provisioning, entitlements, device readiness, and access removal with no human in the loop. Build the organizational memory that "My Digital Twin" depends on: a trustworthy graph of people, roles, entitlements, assets, policies, and history, with data quality good enough for autonomous action. Deploy AI agents against the biggest sources of employee friction and redesign the service catalog around intent instead of forms, holding agents to resolution rather than deflection. Set the guardrails for autonomous IT: identity-aware authorization for agents, least privilege, human approval where it genuinely matters, and audit trails. Move the measurement model from SLAs to experience outcomes, and redeploy your team as automation lands into automation engineering, knowledge ownership, and experience design. What we are looking for. Leadership and operating track record. Experience leading corporate IT, end-user services, or workplace technology at global scale, including managing managers and senior technical staff in more than one region. A track record of running a demanding environment well while changing it. We will ask for specifics on both. Fluency with AI and automation applied to operations: agents, workflow orchestration, integration across identity and ITSM systems, retrieval over internal knowledge. You need to know what is achievable, what is hype, and where the failure modes are. Hands-on depth in endpoint device management and client systems engineering across Windows, macOS, and Linux, MDM platforms, VDI, and AV and conferencing across multiple sites. Depth in identity and access (Okta or equivalent), SaaS administration, and public cloud environments. Practical experience putting enterprise AI tools in employees' hands at scale, beyond pilots. Vendor management and procurement, plus IT technical program management with globally distributed teams, and the working habits that make distributed leadership effective across time zones. Executive presence and influence in a matrix organization, with the ability to develop senior leaders and build a culture of integrity, service excellence, accountability, and best practice sharing across sites. Security and compliance are treated as design constraints rather than obstacles, with exposure to SOC 2, SOX, or PCI cycles. . AI-native depth, in a CorpIT context. • Demonstrated hands-on fluency with current generative AI tools, and the judgment to know where they help and where they don't. • Experience with AI-powered digital employee experience management platforms and endpoint telemetry, used to fix problems before employees report them. • Experience deploying AI assistants or agents inside a corporate stack of identity, MDM, ITSM, and collaboration tools, including where human-in-the-loop approval belongs. • Experience automating the employee lifecycle end to end, where joiner, mover, and leaver events drove provisioning and access through agentic tooling working from organizational memory rather than from a form. • Experience running a service as a product measured on employee outcomes rather than ticket counts, with knowledge treated as a maintained asset. How we will know it is working. A rising share of employee needs met with a north-star goal of no ticket ever filed. New hires are productive on day one, consistently and without expediting. Role changes and departures reflected in access automatically, within minutes. Autonomous resolution measured on quality and employee satisfaction, not closure. Support capacity per employee improves while experience scores rise, with clean audits throughout. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. description: . Director, Product Design. . Location: Palo Alto, US. About Rubrik. Join the public powerhouse that is securing the future of AI. Rubrik has officially entered a new era. Fresh off a headline-making successful IPO and boasting over $1.57 Billion in ARR , we have the market stability of a giant and the hunger of a startup. We've already conquered Data Security-now, we are pivoting to our most ambitious mission yet: Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. About the Team & Role:. Our design team is strong and mighty, with about 60 amazing individuals from all walks of the industry and life located worldwide. As our company and our products grow rapidly, it is crucial to scale the experience of our product and our design team in the right way and with the right people. Every hire counts!. As Rubrik's Palo Alto-based Director of Product Design , you will step into a pivotal role leading some of our key strategic investments and partnering with Engineering and Product leaders to empower a talented team-pioneering next-generation enterprise UX that cements design as our competitive differentiator and as a proud winner of the Red Dot and iF Design Awards. Deepen Customer-Centricity: Lead the team in cultivating direct customer relationships. You'll ensure that research and validation are core components of the design cycle, keeping us grounded in real-world enterprise problems. What you'll bring to the team:. Leadership Experience: At least 3 years in a formal people management role. Strategic Portfolio: A portfolio that showcases not just beautiful UI, but your ability to lead teams through complex problem-solving, organizational shifts, and successful product launches. description: Director, Product Design. . Location: Bangalore, India. About Rubrik. Join the public powerhouse that is securing the future of AI. Rubrik has officially entered a new era. Fresh off a headline-making successful IPO and boasting over $1.57 Billion in ARR , we have the market stability of a giant and the hunger of a startup. We've already conquered Data Security-now, we are pivoting to our most ambitious mission yet: Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. About Team & About Role:. Our design team is strong and mighty, with about 60 amazing individuals from all walks of the industry and life located worldwide. As our company and our products grow rapidly, it is crucial to scale the experience of our product and our design team in the right way and with the right people. Every hire counts!. As Rubrik's Bangalore based Director of Design you will step into a pivotal role leading some of our key strategic investments and partnering with Engineering and Product leaders to empower a talented team-pioneering next-generation enterprise UX that cements design as our competitive differentiator and as a proud winner of the Red Dot and iF Design Awards. Sneak peak to our product: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=F9949Q-_onc&t=9s. Red Dot design Award. iF Design Award. Rubrik Design Medium Page. What you'll do:. Build & Lead High-Performing Teams: Recruit, mentor, and retain a world-class team of designers. You'll be responsible for their career growth, providing coaching on both craft and navigational "soft" skills to help them scale their impact. Define Strategic Vision: Partner with VP and Director-level leadership in Product Management and Engineering to define the long-term roadmap. You'll transform high-level business goals into actionable design strategies that balance immediate needs with a "North Star" vision. Champion Design Excellence: Ensure all team deliverables meet the highest standards of craft, usability, and visual consistency across the product. Drive Operational Excellence: Establish and refine design processes that allow the team to move fast without breaking the user experience. You will oversee the end-to-end execution of complex product areas, ensuring a high bar for quality and consistency. Evangelize Design Culture: Act as a primary advocate for Design across Rubrik. You'll bridge the gap between technical complexity (cybersecurity, AI, infra) and consumer-grade usability, ensuring that "Design" is seen as a business differentiator, not just a service. Deepen Customer-Centricity: Lead the team in cultivating direct customer relationships. You'll ensure that research and validation are core components of the design cycle, keeping us grounded in real-world enterprise problems. What you'll bring to the team:. Leadership Experience: 12+ years of relevant experience in product design, with at least 5+ years in a formal people management role. Strategic Portfolio: A portfolio that showcases not just beautiful UI, but your ability to lead teams through complex problem-solving, organizational shifts, and successful product launches. Business Acumen: The ability to speak the language of PMs and Engineers. You understand how design decisions impact the bottom line and technical debt. title: Employee Relations Partner & HR for HR
description: Employee Relations Partner & HR for HR. . About the role. The Employee Relations (ER) Partner is a hands-on, execution-focused role within the People Team, responsible for running workplace investigations and resolving employee relations matters across Rubrik's three organisations: R&D, GTM and G&A. This role serves as a trusted advisor to Business Partners, Legal, People leaders and managers, ensuring employee concerns are addressed consistently, objectively, and in alignment with company policies and employment laws. Working with our Business Partners, Legal and People leaders, you will conduct thorough, impartial investigations, provide expert ER guidance, support consistent, risk-informed decision making and deliver clear, well-documented outcomes. This role also serves as our "HR for HR": the trusted, impartial point of contact for ER matters involving members of the People Team, providing independent oversight, ensuring those matters are handled with objectivity and confidentiality. You will work to the shared ER case methodology, documentation standards and governance set centrally by the People Team, helping us deliver a consistent employee and manager experience across every function and region.. This role helps ensure Rubrik maintains a fair and legally compliant workplace by:. Delivering objective, high-quality workplace investigations. Providing expert guidance on complex employee relations matters. Driving consistency in employee relations practices and outcomes. Providing insights that inform policy, process and leadership decisions. Reporting line: Senior Director HRBP & dotted line into our Internal Employment Counsel. This is a US-focused role, with opportunities to be involved in or drive aspects of our international ER cases. . What You'll Do:. . Investigations and case execution. Own the end-to-end execution of workplace investigations across R&D, GTM and G&A, including allegations of harassment, discrimination, retaliation and policy violations: scoping, planning, neutral fact-finding interviews, credibility assessments, findings and recommendations. Collaborate with Internal Legal to develop and execute investigation plans, and recommend appropriate resolutions to Business Partners, People leaders and other stakeholders. Act as liaison to external counsel and investigators on HR-related investigations. Produce clear, accurate investigation reports and case documentation to the standard set by the People Team's central ER framework. Facilitate and support interactive processes with employees seeking a reasonable medical accommodation. Contribute ER input to performance and separation matters, supporting consistent, well-documented decisions and helping to mitigate risk. Use AI tools (e.g., Claude) to speed up investigation work: drafting investigation plans and interview outlines, summarizing evidence, and structuring reports. A human always verifies accuracy, credibility findings, and conclusions.. ER Partnership across R&D, GTM and G&A, and HR for HR. Serve as the "HR for HR": the confidential, impartial ER point of contact for matters involving People Team members, including managing conflicts of interest and escalating to Legal or external parties where appropriate. Serve as a subject matter expert and advisor on employee relations best practices to Business Partners, People leaders and the business, ensuring Business Partners can focus on strategic partnership while you lead complex case execution. Partner with Legal to ensure consistent interpretation and application of policies and practices across organisations and geographies. Identify emerging employee relations risks and organizational trends, partnering with HRBPs, Legal and leaders to proactively address root causes before issues escalate. Contribute to frontline manager development through training and guidance on fundamental ER topics that support a fair and equitable workplace. Consistency, insight and continuous improvement. Maintain case-tracking systems and reports, using intake and triage tooling consistently so every matter is logged, categorised and resolved against common metrics. Use AI-assisted analysis of case data to surface ER trends (hot spots, repeat issues, manager patterns) and turn them into recommendations for senior leadership. Help build and refine AI-enabled playbooks, templates, prompt libraries, and manager guides. Partner Legal and COE on policy development and process improvements informed by case outcomes and organizational trends. Participate in key People or business initiatives as required. . Experience You'll Need:. Bachelor's degree and 5 - 7+ years of direct experience conducting workplace investigations, including allegations of harassment, discrimination and retaliation. Proven ability to manage a caseload independently and to a high standard, from intake through to final report. Knowledge of federal, state and local laws and statutes governing employment policies and practices. Strong understanding and application of workplace investigation best practices and standards, including conducting neutral fact-finding interviews, credibility assessments and maintaining confidentiality. Sound judgement and discretion in handling highly sensitive and confidential matters, including those involving colleagues within the People Team. Experience supporting multiple business functions (for example engineering, sales and corporate functions) and building credibility with leaders at all levels. Excellent planning, organisation and time management skills, with attention to detail and the ability to handle multiple matters in a fast-paced, time-sensitive environment. Ability to communicate objectively with employees and management through complex, difficult and emotional issues. Outstanding written and verbal communication skills. Strong business acumen and the ability to build relationships across all levels of the organisation. Preferred:. Experience with international ER matters and working alongside external and internal counsel. Experience using case-management or intake and triage tooling, and reporting on ER trends and metrics. Experience in a technology or high-growth environment. title: ENG Project/ Program - Intern
description: . ABOUT THE JOB. We are looking for a highly organised and motivated Project/ Program Manager Intern to join our dynamic team. As an intern, you'll assist in managing our On Prem/Saas product delivery. You will assist in the planning, managing, and execution of several technical programs and initiatives each year for our Engineering Organisation across our Product portfolio. You will get an first-hand experience in driving the improvement of our processes throughout the development, validation and deployment lifecycle. You will be collaborating with stakeholders and understanding the components of delivering large features/ initiatives and their associated technical complexities. This role will provide you the opportunity to learn how to navigate complex situations while evaluating risks and aligning with business priorities. You will learn to manage tasks while working in a fast-paced environment and developing your technical expertise. Your responsibilities will include assisting in driving metrics improvement, learning to communicate the current status, and helping in delivering features to market.. Responsibilities include:. Planning & Execution:. - Assist in defining program scope, goals, milestones & success metrics. - Develop & maintain project plans, schedules & documentation. - Track project progress and communicate updates to stakeholders. - Create dashboards or reports to track progress, KPIs. Coordination and Communication:. - Collaborate with Engineering and Product Leadership and functions such as Engineering, Product Management, Customer Support etc. to prioritize, plan, and deliver new features and products to the market. - Assisting in the communication of schedules, status, and issues to stakeholders. - Assist in running effective and efficient meetings that accomplish goals in a timely manner. Risk Management:. - Identifying potential risks and assisting in the development of mitigation plans. - Collaborating with development teams to aid in addressing and resolving issues that may impact timelines. Continuous Improvement:. - Recommending tools and methodologies to enhance efficiency and automation. - Document lessons learned and best practices for future projects. Mandatory Skills & Qualifications:. Pursuing a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems or a related field. Strong organizational and analytical skills. Basic understanding of Software development lifecycle(SDLC) and agile methodologies. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Ability to learn fast and work collaboratively in a fast-paced team environment. Preferred/Nice-to-have skills. Exposure to Cloud Platforms - AWS/Azure/GCP. Exposure to Storage domain. Exposure to Enterprise product development. Minimum eligibility criteria. - CGPA 8 and above. - 2027 graduates of Circuital branches only. - Available from January 2027 to May 2027 in Bangalore for the onsite internship (No remote options). title: Field Sales Operations Manager
description: Rubrik has become the fastest growing enterprise software company in Silicon Valley. We are seeking a passionate and highly driven individual to join our world class, career enhancing Sales Operations team! This team partners with Field Sales Leaders on cutting edge GTM strategies, metric tracking, and infrastructure development. Sales Operations is integral to the overall success of the sales organization, providing data, process, and decision making that ultimately drives revenue, growth and sales productivity. Rubrik's Americas Sales team is one of the fastest growing in the industry and is led by a dynamic team of sales executives and cross-functional leaders. The Field Sales Operations Manager will have the charter and opportunity to help shape the growth of the business through a combination of metric tracking and reporting, territory planning, and strategic projects focused on growth and optimization. What You'll Do:. Work directly with our Americas sales teams (AE to Sr. VP's) to help grow and shape the business to drive growth, bringing a combination of analytical and operational experience. Partner with the sales leadership to drive a strong operational cadence around forecasting, pipeline management, account management, and sales performance reporting. Own a weekly reporting cadence that provides a view into the business segment health and potential blind spots in performance. Drive accountability for key sales revenue KPI's throughout the quarter. Bring analytics and problem-solving acumen, with experience working on large datasets and initiatives to drive short, and long-term revenue goals. Deliver Quarterly Business Reviews (QBR) to segment leaders and management, covering prior-quarter performance and progress. Invest in identifying areas of improvement and managing/delivering ad-hoc projects pertaining to sales strategy/ops. and related areas to drive value. Engage and be able to Influence cross-functional stakeholders in identifying and executing use-cases to drive top-line revenue. Support sales teams with quoting and account management requests and navigate internal systems and processes (e.g. SFDC, CPQ, Clari, etc). Work with various internal partners (Order Mgmt., Deal Desk, Finance, Sales Management and Product Ops.) to drive efficient execution and root cause analysis for escalations. Build a GTM plan, culminating in a the creation of equitable sales territories and work with sales and cross-functional teams in designing associated quotas and PG targets. Support end-of-quarter and month-end closing procedures, including booking escalations, SFDC maintenance, system troubleshooting, etc. Experience You'll Need:. 5-7+ years in Sales Operations or similar role; Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience. Requires advanced communication skills and ability to interface directly with Sales VP's. Requires sales operations experience within Americas Tier1 Strategic accounts and build of GTM plans and associated territory carving. Preferred tech experience: Salesforce CRM, CPQ, & Renewals modules. Clari Forecasting, Claude Code/CoWork Skill implementations, and Advanced Excel/ G-sheets. Strong revenue reporting and sales/financial analytical skill and managing large datasets. Prior experience with operations support for large customer segments or business units. Experience in structuring problems, taking initiative and following through with strong execution. Qualifications:. Unwavering "customer first" mentality with passion for service level and execution quality. Proactive, creative, and flexible, using good judgment to accomplish tasks on schedule with minimal direction and supervision. High-energy with positive attitude and bias for productivity in all aspects of the job. Passionate and motivated to make a massive impact and work hard in a fast-paced environment. Strong people skills: Ability to develop relationships with Sales VP's, drive consensus, and results from cross-functional teams. Detail oriented, willing to roll up his/her sleeves and get things done, cross-functionally, on time, and with quality results. #LI-MR2. title: Finance Manager, GTM
description: Finance Manager, GTM. . This role sits at the center of a fast-scaling GTM org on an AI-native transformation journey. You'll be expected to keep pace with rapid growth, bring order to ambiguity, and continuously challenge how the finance function operates - not just run the existing playbook. The Finance Manager will report to Director Finance, and they will own financial reporting to finance and sales leaders. They will manage Headcount, T&E expense, and support key deliverables like annual planning, bookings forecast, BvA analysis, monthly/quarterly financial reporting and ad hoc analysis of the business. RoI/Cost-benefits ratios. BvA explanations to Finance Executive Leaders. Provide ad hoc reporting and analysis for senior management as needed to review and improve business and financial performance. Mentor junior analysts on the team, and construct independent processes that support your work, that analysts can be trained on. Business Partner with the VP of Sales Ops & VP of Sales Enablement. Own headcount management. Manage the SKO, President Club Budgets. Reporting. Build monthly and quarterly decks with topline and expense insights. Project Manage the teams' deliverables around monthly and quarterly close activities. . Experience You'll need. Excellent attention to detail. 7+ years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 6 years and a Master's degree. Advanced Excel & Google Sheets skills. Excellent analytical and written communication skills. Ability to work well in cross-functional teams and build strong working relationship with key partners. Demonstrated abilities to prioritize and manage multiple assignments in a fast-paced environment to meet deadlines with efficiency and accuracy. It is helpful, but not required to have. Experience with Adaptive Insights, NetSuite, Salesforce, Tableau, Workday, Coupa. Prior experience managing headcount and conducting BvA calls (Budget vs Actual). description: GSI Service Delivery Program Manager. . Location: Bangalore, India. Job summary:. We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Services Program Manager to develop a post-sales enablement and service-delivery quality framework for Rubrik's Global System Integrator (GSI) partners. Success in this role guarantees consistent and successful service delivery from Rubrik's largest and most complex GSI partners to ensure customer success, satisfaction, and retention worldwide. Pro-active and assertive development of the partner services relationships is a critical success factor for this role. It is both strategic and tactical and requires clear operational oversight, strong partner advocacy, and an ability to incent and reward top performance from Rubrik SMEs at all levels within the partners' organizations. The ideal candidate understands how to work effectively with the Partner's organization in collaboration with Rubrik's Sales and Service Delivery teams to make Rubrik the preferred vendor for easy enablement and adoption of Rubrik best practices to deliver high value and margin-rich services to their largest and most complex customers. The GSI Services Program Manager is a critical contributor in the Partner Services Operations team within Rubrik's Global Customer Success organization. Partner Services Operations enables partners to deliver post-sales support and services to their customers using reliable and innovative systems, processes and programs that ensure a high level of Customer Satisfaction with minimal dependence on Rubrik. The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for collaborating with and advocating for partners for the benefit of our mutual customers.. Key Responsibilities:. Program Leadership & Management: Lead and coordinate a scalable high-growth engine of post-sales support and professional services GSI engineers. Motivate this strategic workforce to achieve high Rubrik standards in product knowledge and service quality. Partner Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with GSI partners and their Rubrik account teams, acting as the primary point of contact for post-sales service issues, escalations, and proactive management of a seamless hand-off from sales to services. Must be able to navigate and present to all management levels within the partner and Rubrik organization. Customer Satisfaction: Maintain strong customer focus to ensure all managed partners are delivering world-class customer services, in collaboration with Rubrik, by measuring and monitoring customer satisfaction. Training & Enablement: Facilitate and track role-based training and certification to GSIs that ensures they are well-equipped to deliver services aligned with Rubrik's company standards, in partnership with Rubrik University, Rubrik Sales, and Global Customer Success. Process & Quality Improvement: Implement and refine processes for support and professional services delivery, promoting best practices, scalability, and eliminating friction and inefficiencies. Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain program KPIs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and stakeholders. Facilitate Services QBRs to ensure continuous improvement on both sides of the partnership. Analyze program quality metrics to correctly assess and incent high partner performance, while requiring non-performers to improve or exit the program. Partner Advocacy: Comprehensively understand the partners' go-to-market strategy, global support structure, and service delivery plan; document and present partner's approach to internal key stakeholders as an advocate for what the partners need from Rubrik to be successful. Support Oversight : Provide oversight on partner's open support cases and product gaps, to ensure timely resolution and appropriate resourcing and visibility within Rubrik. Facilitate resolution for any customer complaints regarding partner-delivered services. . ABOUT YOU:. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or related technical field; advanced degree preferred. 10+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical support, or professional services, in a customer-facing role at an enterprise technology solution provider. Cyber Security experience is desired. Demonstrated experience working with GSIs or large multi-regional channel partners. Quickly understands the business issues, data challenges, and both the commercial and services aspects of strategic partnerships within global service delivery teams. Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with excellent communication and presentation ability, specifically to summarize complex product issues into clear executive summaries. Strong project management background, with demonstrated success coordinating multiple programs, workstreams, and people toward common, measurable objectives. Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical skills, including hands-on experience analyzing customer data to facilitate data-driven decisions and to develop executive presentations. Experience with Salesforce, Atlassian, and Tableau reporting and data preferred. Motivated, proactive self-starter with a customer-centric mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes from cross-functional teams, including those outside direct influence. title: HR Business Partner, Corporate Functions
description: HR Business Partner, Corporate Functions. About the Role. We're looking for a new member of our People team who loves all things People! This HRBP role sits within the HR Business Partner team, supporting the Corporate Functions (Finance, Accounting, IT, Infosec and Legal) and Marketing client groups. You'll partner closely with Senior HR Business Partners to deliver a world class day-to-day experience for employees and managers, with a strong focus on employee relations and building the coaching capability of our first-line and mid-level managers. This role will be based in Palo Alto, CA. Onsite 3 days per week. What You'll Do. Be an AI-native HRBP, not just an AI user. Question how People work gets done today (manager coaching prep, ER documentation, program rollouts) and bring ideas to redesign the workflow around AI rather than just speeding up the old one. Know where human judgment stays non-negotiable; ER, coaching, and sensitive conversations are never handed off. Let data not just anecdotes guide how you coach managers and flag emerging people trends and issues. Serve as a trusted, go-to partner for employee relations, helping managers and employees work through workplace concerns, guiding them to the right resolution, and escalating complex or sensitive cases to the Senior HRBP as needed. Build the coaching capability of first-line and mid-level managers, helping them grow their own people leadership skills rather than just solving issues for them. Covering organizational health, employee engagement, development, and policy interpretation. Partner with and support the Senior HR Business Partner(s) on business-specific people initiatives and roadmap execution. Support execution of annual people programs (year-end and mid-year performance reviews, talent reviews, compensation planning, engagement initiatives, succession planning) in partnership with the Senior HRBP. Partner with Centers of Excellence (Compensation, Talent Acquisition, Talent & Development, DEI, People Operations) to help identify and support process improvements. Translate ambiguous people/policy questions into clear guidance and next steps, communicating HR concepts simply and effectively to managers at all levels.
