title: HR Business Partner R&D
description: HR Business Partner, R&D. Location: Palo Alto, CA (3 days in office). . We are seeking an experienced HR Business Partner, R&D to partner with managers across Engineering, Product, Design, and Customer Support to strengthen manager capability, build high-performing teams, and drive business and talent outcomes. This hands-on role focuses on manager coaching, performance management, compensation planning, organizational health, and people program execution. As a trusted advisor, you will help managers navigate complex people decisions, improve team performance, and build the capabilities required to achieve business objectives. You will diagnose organizational challenges, identify opportunities and translate them into practical, high-impact people solutions. You will also help shape the future of HR business partnering by leveraging AI and agentic workflows to improve decision quality, expand HRBP leverage, enhance manager support, and deliver scalable people solutions. This role is designed for a highly accountable HRBP who thrives in a high-velocity environment, takes ownership of outcomes, has strong bias for action, proactively solves problems, and continuously improves how work gets done. The ideal candidate combines the judgment of a trusted advisor, the execution rigor of an operator, and the mindset of a builder.. Scope of Impact. . Business Partnership. Build trusted partnerships with managers and leaders across supported R&D organizations, serving as a credible advisor on talent, organization, and people-related decisions. Translate business objectives into practical solutions that enable organizational effectiveness. Balance business priorities, employee experience, and long-term organizational implications when advising managers. Proactively identify organizational risks, capability gaps, talent concerns, and workforce trends, and drive recommendations that improve business outcomes. Manager & Leadership Capability. Advise first-line and mid-level managers on people leadership, performance management, employee development, engagement, organizational health, and team effectiveness. Identify capability gaps and implement targeted interventions that strengthen manager effectiveness and team performance. Coach managers through challenging employee situations, difficult conversations, performance concerns, organizational change, and development planning. Provide guidance on HR policies, processes, and people practices while reinforcing broader organizational considerations. Deliver manager enablement and leadership development initiatives that improve effectiveness and consistency at scale. Performance, Talent Management and Compensation. Own execution of annual people programs, including performance reviews, calibration discussions, talent reviews, and compensation planning, ensuring high-quality outcomes and strong manager engagement. Coach managers through complex performance management decisions and strengthen performance expectations, accountability, and employee development practices. Identify talent, retention, succession, and capability risks and develop mitigation plans with managers. Partner on compensation decisions aligned with company philosophy and leverage workforce insights to improve decision quality. HR Program Design, Execution & AI-Enabled Transformation. Design, implement, scale, and improve people programs that enhance manager effectiveness and organizational outcomes. Simplify, automate, and redesign people processes with a focus on outcomes rather than digitizing legacy workflows. Champion AI, automation, and agentic workflows across HRBP work to improve decision quality, increase capacity, and deliver scalable people solutions and impact beyond traditional human capacity. Deliver integrated HR solutions in partnership with the broader People team and identify innovative approaches that improve productivity, adoption, and effectiveness. Organizational Health, Engagement & Development. Advise leaders on organizational health, culture, and team effectiveness while strengthening the development, retention, and engagement of key talent. Use workforce sentiment, organizational insights, and people analytics to identify risks, diagnose challenges, and implement sustainable solutions. Employee Relations. Provide guidance and independently manage moderate to complex employee relations matters using sound judgment and risk assessment. Resolve employee concerns in partnership with managers and collaborate with Legal on sensitive, high-risk, or specialized matters. How You Create Impact. Translate complex business priorities into focused, executable people solutions. Influence decisions through expertise, credibility, and practical problem-solving. Demonstrate urgency, ownership, and follow-through while balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution. Leverage data, organizational insight, and systems thinking to diagnose challenges and develop scalable solutions. Strengthen manager effectiveness through coaching, development, and enablement. Drive execution of talent, performance, compensation, and people programs that improve organizational outcomes. Navigate employee relations and performance matters with sound judgment and appropriate risk assessment. Leverage AI, automation, and agentic workflows to increase impact, productivity, and scale while maintaining an enterprise mindset. What Success Looks Like. Be known for speed, ownership, sound judgment, and turning ambiguous people challenges into actionable solutions. Build trusted advisor relationships with managers who proactively seek your guidance on critical talent and organizational decisions. Elevate manager capability, accountability, and team effectiveness across supported organizations. Deliver strong execution of performance, talent, compensation, and people programs that improve business outcomes. Anticipate organizational risks and continuously improve how people work is delivered through AI, automation, and scalable solutions. Qualifications & Experience. Required Qualifications: Minimum 8 years of progressive HR experience, including at least 3+ years as a People Partner or HR Business Partner, with a Bachelor's degree in Business, Human Resources, or a related field; or 6+ years of experience with a Master's degree. title: Industrial Trainee
description: Intern - CA Industrial Trainee (Accounting / Reporting). About the Role. We are offering an excellent learning opportunity within our International Accounting & Reporting team based at Bangalore. Designed specifically for CA students seeking industrial training, this role supports our U.S. GAAP accounting team or International Reporting team. You will step into a global corporate environment, partner with team members worldwide, and gain hands-on exposure to corporate accounting principles, change management, and complex issue resolution. We are looking for motivated individuals who thrive in a fast-paced setting and embrace new challenges.. About the Team. Our global accounting team is the backbone of our financial reporting. We are responsible for finalizing the financial statements for all subsidiaries across North America, EMEA, and APAC, ensuring strict adherence to the required GAAP in each country. This team drives compliance with regulatory guidelines and corporate accounting policies. From managing accurate and timely book closures to overseeing financial audits, GL management, and reconciliations, we maintain and elevate the overall control environment.. What You'll Be Doing. Support the Close Process: Assist the team with month-end and quarter-end U.S. GAAP close processes and related departmental responsibilities. Execute Accounting Tasks: Participate in the accurate and timely execution of close procedures to ensure highly reliable financial reporting. Collaborate Globally: Work closely with the broader corporate accounting team, shadowing experts to support a seamless monthly book closure. Learn Risk Assessment: Help analyze accounts to assess financial risks and learn to apply professional judgment to ensure the integrity of accounting entries, accruals, and reconciliations. Prepare Documentation: Draft journal entries and assist in maintaining account reconciliations consistent with strict corporate policies. Audit Support: Assist in preparing and maintaining essential reports and schedules for management, as well as those requested by internal and external auditors. GST & WHT: Support the reconciliation process, prepare and file tax returns, and manage refund applications as applicable. Technical Research: Support the team in researching complex technical accounting issues, gaining valuable exposure to how a global company documents and communicates its accounting positions. Internal Controls (SOX): Gain practical, hands-on exposure to the organization's internal control framework (SOX) by assisting in control procedures to ensure company-wide compliance. Continuous Learning: Stay current on evolving Accounting Standards pronouncements and learn how to directly apply them in a modern corporate setting.. Who We Are Looking For. Currently pursuing a Chartered Accountancy (CA) qualification. Eligible and actively seeking mandatory CA Industrial Training. Strong theoretical foundation in accounting principles (U.S. GAAP or IFRS knowledge is a plus). Highly motivated, detail-oriented, and able to thrive in a fast-paced environment. description: About Rubrik. Rubrik is on a mission to secure the world's data. As the Zero Trust Data Security™ Company, we deliver data resilience, data observability, and data recovery for cloud, SaaS, and enterprise environments. We help organizations keep their data secure, continuously available, and resilient against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We are looking for a high-energy, results-driven IT Contract Recruiter to join our Talent Acquisition team. In this role, you will play a critical part in shaping the future of Rubrik by sourcing, attracting, and hiring top-tier technology talent. Role Overview. As an IT Contract Recruiter, you will manage full-lifecycle recruiting for a variety of technical and IT positions across the enterprise. You will collaborate closely with IT hiring managers and cross-functional teams to identify candidates who possess exceptional technical skills and align with Rubrik's high-performance culture. Key Responsibilities. Full-Cycle Recruiting: Own end-to-end recruitment for complex IT and technology positions, Program Managers, AI Architects, & AI Engineers. Sourcing & Pipeline Building: Proactively source passive candidates through LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, industry networks, employee referrals, and specialized technical communities. Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to build rapport quickly with candidates and executive stakeholders alike. Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory. Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan. A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up). title: Lead, Customer Success Operations Analyst
description: About the role. Rubrik's Customer Success and Renewals organization is the operational backbone that keeps our retention and growth motions running as a measurable, automated, insight-driven system. We're looking for a senior Customer Success Operations professional to be the operational engine behind these motions - building the automation that removes manual toil, turning scattered data into trusted analytics, and acting as the connective tissue between Customer Success, Renewals, RevOps, Product, and Engineering. What You'll Do. Design and build automation across the customer lifecycle - onboarding, adoption tracking, renewal triggers, risk alerts, health-score refreshes - replacing manual workflows with scalable, self-refreshing processes. Partner with Product and Engineering to instrument customer and telemetry signals into the reporting layer, and coordinate on closing technical/product gaps surfaced by CS and Renewals data. Build and own CS/Renewals dashboards and executive data packs covering GRR/NRR, renewal trends, churn/downsell drivers, at-risk accounts, health distribution, adoption, and time-to-value. Design and govern product metrics across product/eng and post sales teams; own data integrity across Salesforce, the CS platform, Snowflake, and Tableau. Apply AI/LLM tools to automate reporting, build workflows and frameworks from scratch, accelerate analysis, and reduce manual operational work - and help set the standard for how the post-sales org uses AI to scale. Act as the operational bridge across RevOps, Sales Ops, Finance, Support Ops, Enablement, and Data/BI - leading cross-functional programs and driving alignment on data, definitions, and scaling initiatives. Deliver ad hoc and recurring analysis that turns raw data into decision-ready insight for CS and Renewals leadership. Experience you'll need. Minimum of 6 years in Customer Success Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Ops, or a CS/analytics function in B2B SaaS or enterprise technology. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or a related technical field preferred. Excel skills, plus fluency in SQL, Tableau, and Snowflake - able to independently build dashboards, + skills and frameworks/apps or agents, define metrics, and derive insight from complex, multi-source data. Demonstrated experience designing and building automations: workflow automation, triggered actions, CS-platform configuration. Hands-on experience applying AI/LLM tools to automate reporting, analysis, or operational workflows. Deep familiarity with Salesforce and a Customer Success platform (Gainsight, Totango, Planhat, or similar). Fluency in core post-sales metrics - GRR, NRR, churn, downsell, health scoring, segmentation, renewal motions - and judgment on which ones drive decisions. Strong technical/product reasoning, program-management ability, and a track record presenting metrics and insight to senior leadership. . . . . #LI-PM2. title: Manager, Customer Resilience Management - Customer Success
description: The Manager of the Customer Resilience team will drive all aspects of the post-sales journey for a select group of Enterprise Accounts at Rubrik. The successful candidate will lead a team of Customer Resilience Managers (CRMs) who act as the point of contact between Rubrik and our select clients, managing their journey with Rubrik and coordinating to achieve their business goals. To succeed as a Manager of the Customer Resilience team, you must have excellent leadership, interpersonal, and communication skills and be professional at all times. You will be responsible for hiring, coaching, mentoring, and day-to-day managing the individual contributors on your team, as well as mediating with customers. As a key member of the Customer Success leadership team, you will be responsible for delighting our customers and helping them achieve their tactical and strategic business objectives. Responsibilities. Provide effective leadership, direction, and development to a team of CRMs assigned to manage a select group of large accounts. Drive the strategy for managed accounts and coordinate cross-functionally, with a key focus on improving processes and efficiencies across the organization. Own team accountability for the full customer lifecycle - onboarding, adoption, growth, and renewal - ensuring CRMs are proactively managing customer health rather than only reacting to issues. Ensure CRMs drive the renewal of all purchased products and services across their accounts, engaging early to secure renewal and prevent churn. Ensure product activation and usage targets are being met for all accounts, holding CRMs accountable for closing adoption gaps. Review and ensure the quality of the team's customer-facing deliverables, including success plans, performance benchmarking, Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documents, and POC/account awareness reporting to SEs and Account Directors. Collaborate with Sales and develop strategies to grow existing accounts and ensure quality, efficient delivery of Rubrik services. Manage the day-to-day operational excellence of the team, including distributing accounts and balancing workload across CRMs. Drive process improvements, tools, and product enhancements that improve the customer journey. Collaborate with Sales, Marketing, Operations, Engineering, QA, and IT to improve overall customer satisfaction. Represent the Customer Success function as necessary on product teams and in other Rubrik decision-making forums. Build a high-performing CRM team through hiring, training, mentoring, coaching, and ongoing development - including career pathing and growth planning for each direct report. Own performance management for the team: goal-setting, ongoing feedback, calibration, and formal performance plans when needed. Closely monitor top support issues and trends with new products and releases; take corrective action and limit customer exposure. Collect and analyze metrics to guide decisions, and report portfolio health, renewal risk, and escalation trends to senior leadership. Own escalation management for the team, including engaging directly with customer executives on escalations that rise above the CRM level; initiate conference calls and drive issues to closure with timely stakeholder updates. Set goals and KPIs for the team - e.g., net/gross revenue retention, CSAT, renewal rate, and escalation volume - and review individual and team performance on an ongoing basis. Education & Experience. Bachelor's degree in a computer-related discipline preferred. 10+ years of experience in customer success and/or technical account management in a technology company. 3+ years leading and managing people, and building high-performing teams. Skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Strong planning, decision-making, staffing, and process-improvement skills. Excellent interpersonal and teamwork skills; proven ability to build working relationships at all levels of management. High standard for quality in process deliverables. Self-driven, proactive, hardworking team player. Proven track record of strategic problem-solving and planning. Willing to work across time zones and outside standard business hours when escalations require it. Able to travel to customer sites and internal offsites as needed. title: Manager, Planning & Strategic Operations
description: About the Team. Rubrik's Renewal Strategy & Operations team protects one of the most valuable, fastest-compounding assets in enterprise software: $1.57 billion in subscription ARR, growing 32% year-over-year. Every one of those dollars sitsinside a renewal contract - which means protecting and compounding that ARR is one of the highest-leverage jobs in the company. Renewal Strategy & Operations is the team that builds the operating system for that asset. We sit at the intersection of commercial strategy, systems, and execution, and we are genuinely in a 0-to-1 build phase - the forecasting models, governance frameworks, quoting infrastructure, and playbooks that will run this business at 2x today's scale don't fully exist yet. That's the work: you will be designing the machine. You'll bring a strategic voice that understands renewals as a business - thinking in terms of root cause, leverage points, and scalable systems. You'll partner directly with Sales, Finance, Deal Desk, Product, and IT leaders, and your fingerprints will be on the foundation this function runs on for years. What You'll Do. Be a strategic partner to the business. Act as a direct strategic and analytical partner to the Senior Director, translating renewal metrics (ARR retention, churn, NRR/GRR, pipeline coverage) into a narrative leadership can act on. Shape how the business talks about renewals in QBRs, and leadership reviews: what matters, why, and what we're doing about it. Architect the systems this business will run on. Take end-to-end ownership of how renewal workflows, forecasting models, and quoting frameworks are designed - not just monitored - including multi-year, co-term, and mid-term expansion structures built to maximize ARR retention at scale. Build the playbooks, governance frameworks, and standard operating procedures that don't exist yet, with an eye toward what this function needs to look like in two years, not just this quarter. Own governance and quality as a system. Run quote governance and data quality as a discipline: root-causing discrepancies across CRM and renewal systems and building the controls that prevent them from recurring. Partner with IT and RevOps to define what the systems and automation should actually do, rather than reacting to what they currently do. Lead cross-functionally, with real ownership. Be the primary liaison between Renewals Operations and BI/Data teams, and a trusted partner to Sales, Finance, Legal, and Customer Success on renewal goals, definitions, and standards. Bring structured thinking to new GTM programs and strategic initiatives - this role is expected to shape strategy, not just support it. Who You Are. 6+ years in a strategy consulting, Strategy & Operations at a high-growth or large-scale tech company, or Sales/Renewal Strategy & Operations in a hyper-growth SaaS business - the common thread is structured problem-solving in ambiguous, fast-moving environments. You see yourself as an operator and builder - someone who wants to put foundations under a business that will still be standing at 2x the scale. A structured, first-principles thinker: you can walk into ambiguity, build the framework, and drive it through to execution. Strong independent project management instincts: you can define scope, sequence dependencies, manage risk, and drive multiple concurrent initiatives without close oversight. Strong communicator, equally effective presenting to senior finance leadership and working through details with an individual analyst. B.A./B.S. required; MBA a plus. Nice to have: exposure to CPQ tools (Salesforce CPQ), forecasting platforms like Clari, SaaS renewal metrics (ARR, NRR, GRR, churn), or SQL/Python for ad hoc analysis. . . #LI - PM2. We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bangalore/interested to relocate for our hybrid working model. What you will be doing:. Hire, onboard and develop a team of engaged and high performing renewals professionals through thoughtful enablement, performance coaching and career development planning. title: Mid Market Account Executive | Tokyo
description: 職務概要. Mid-Market Account Executive（小規模顧客担当営業） は、担当領域における売上成長のすべてにオーナーシップを持ち、新規機会の創出・育成、パイプライン管理、アカウント戦略の実行、および既存顧客の拡大を担います。. 本ポジションは個人予算達成に強いコミットメントを持ち、プリセールス、SDR、チャネルセールス、およびRubrik パートナーと連携しながら、日本国内の担当主要アカウントに対して Rubrik を代表して活動し、売上目標を達成いただきます。また、エンド・ツー・エンドでセールスプロセスを管理し、チーム全体の成功において重要な役割を果たします。. 理想的な候補者は、Fortune 1000 企業に対して優れた営業実績を持ち、パイプラインの力強い拡大、アウトバウンドによる新規開拓、徹底した要件確認、イノベーション、そして継続的なハードワークを実証している方です。データセンター領域へのエンタープライズソフトウェア、SaaS、クラウド、IT インフラ関連製品・サービスの営業経験は必須です。 主な業務内容. 担当エリアの営業計画を策定および実行し、プロスペクティング、案件の見極め、管理、クロージングを通じて個人予算を達成する. 多数の戦略的商談を推進するため、パイプラインを構築・管理する. 小規模顧客を中心としたアカウントにおいて、新規成長機会を特定し、クロージングまで導く. 複雑なデータセンター環境において Rubrik のソリューションを提案・プレゼンテーションする. パートナー、ディストリビューター、VAR と協業し、共同販売および戦略立案を行い、高い成長を実現する. ローカル市場の動向や新たなビジネス機会、チャネルパートナー候補について Rubrik マネジメントへフィードバックを提供する. 応募資格（About You）. IT インフラまたは SaaS のいずれかにおける 3年以上のテック営業経験. 新規顧客（Net New Logos）獲得における一貫した成功実績. Fortune 1000 クラスのエンドユーザー向け営業での高い実績. チャネルとの協業において、高いオーナーシップと深い理解・経験を有する方. 継続的に目標を達成・上回ってきた実績. 高い達成意欲と「やり切る」マインドセット. 複雑なソリューションを販売した経験. 変化の早い環境でも自律して動け、マトリクス型組織で高いパフォーマンスを発揮できる方. Rubrik の RIVET バリュー を体現し、チームと協働しながら前向きな文化づくりに貢献できる方. #LI-FT1. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. title: MM Regional Director
description: About the team & role:. Rubrik's sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional development through our world class sales enablement program and our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something that truly matters, protecting the world's data. The MM Regional Sales Director will have ownership of all elements of bookings growth in their assigned region. We are looking to hire for this role based out of either Chicago, IL or Austin, TX. This includes managing a team of MM AEs toward discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, executing account strategies, and managing customer expansion. The RD will manage a team of sellers calling into small/mid-sized accounts within the region while wo rking in unison with regional leaders in Sales Engineering, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Partners to exceed sales objectiv es. This position will manage all aspects of the sales process and will play an integral role in the success of the overall sales team. What You'll Do:. Develops and implements a comprehensive strategy that maximizes Rubrik's position and opportunities across the territory. Build partner ecosystem and work closely with Focus partners to foster collaboration and opportunity. Manages and develops the team of sales representatives including recruiting, hiring, and enablement of team members. Hands on approach and thought leadership into account strategies and focus. Sells and promotes the introduction of Rubrik to MM prospects and provides guidance to the team on strategy, sales process and CxO level selling. Participates in strategic and tactical planning for the region and a key member of the MM Management team. Develops and execute a Focus plan to maximize revenue and growth across the region. Drives accurate team forecasting practice in line with management expectations. Conducts weekly progress meetings with sales team. Assists in the development of short, medium, and long term plans to achieve strategic objectives. Regularly interacts across functional areas with senior management or executives to ensure region objectives are met. Ability to influence thinking or gain acceptance of others in sensitive situations is important. Experience You'll Need :. 1-3 years of experience in sales management and experience on working on small, mid-sized deals. Relevant domain experience across backup, cloud and datacenter environments. Proven track record in a sales-driven organization, selling technology-related products and services. Solid written, verbal, and presentation skills. Creative with strong problem-solving skills and an ability to succeed in a fast-paced environment. Proven ability to work well as part of an extended sales team. Knowledge of Rubrik's specific domain area. #LI-Remote. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. title: Partner Programs & Analytics Manager
description: About the role:. Within the Global Channel Strategy and Operations Organization, you will drive operational excellence by serving as a critical bridge between business partners, internal stakeholders, and leadership. In this role, you will ensure seamless partner onboarding, deliver rapid case resolution, and analyze program workflows to optimize partner satisfaction. This high-impact role requires strong strategic thinking, resilient execution, and the ability to turn complex operational challenges into streamlined, scalable processes. What you'll do?. Strategic Workflow & Process Optimization: Responsible for case resolution for Partner Programs, uncover operational bottlenecks, and design proactive strategies to eliminate root-cause issues and reduce support volume working cross-functionally across Legal, Sales, Finance, and Product to secure rapid resolution. Content & Asset Operations Management: Oversee the lifecycle, governance, and distribution of internal enablement materials and partner-facing assets-ensuring documentation, program collateral, and operational resources are consistently updated, organized, and easily accessible where required. AI-Driven Data Analytics & Insights: Harness enterprise AI tools and analytical platforms to track key performance indicators (KPIs), perform root-cause analyses on case trends, and present actionable, data-backed recommendations directly to the Director, Partner Programs. Partner Lifecycle & Governance: Direct end-to-end New Partner Onboarding workflows, ensuring seamless implementation of regional approval matrices, legal contracts, and global governance protocols. Certification & Program Reporting: Establish and maintain real-time reporting architectures for Sales and Technical Certifications across the global ecosystem to measure partner capability and readiness. Financial & Operations Execution: Oversee Purchase Order (PO) creation, financial approvals, and fund distribution for Contra, Business Development Funds (BDF), and Market Development Funds (MDF) utilizing Coupa. Experience you'll need:. 5+ Years of Operations Experience: Proven track record in case management, partner operations, tier-2/3 support coordination, or business operations in a global setting. Demonstrated Resilience: A persistent, hands-on problem solver with a history of driving initiatives to completion despite obstacles, changing priorities, or tight timelines. Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Exceptional ability to audit existing processes, identify workflow inefficiencies, and implement scalable, data-backed solutions. Agility in High-Growth Environments: Strong flexibility and adaptability to pivot quickly, prioritize competing demand, and execute independently in a fast-paced environment. Technical Mastery: Advanced proficiency with CRM ticketing tools (Salesforce), enterprise procurement software (Coupa), and cloud collaboration platforms (Google Workspace). Modern AI & Technical Mastery: Practical, hands-on experience using generative AI tools and enterprise search platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, Glean) to optimize workflows, synthesize information, and accelerate problem-solving. Advanced proficiency with Salesforce, Coupa, and Google Workspace. Schedule Requirement: Ability to work full United States business hours (CST alignment) to support core global stakeholders. Education & Communication: Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, or a related field; exceptional written and verbal English communication skills. Preferred Qualifications 7+ years of specialized experience within Channel Programs, Channel Operations, or Partner Success in the SaaS or Cybersecurity sectors. Global experience managing cross-border channel operations and navigating international channel dynamics. Creative problem-solving capabilities with a history of innovating partner engagement models and program frameworks.. Working Hours: 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM IST. title: Principal AI Architect
description: About the role:. At Rubrik IT, we are transforming how the enterprise thinks and operates - building a "thinking enterprise" where intelligent, agentic systems reason across our data, tools, and workflows to drive speed, quality, and measurable business impact. As an AI Architect, you will be a pivotal technical leader driving AI Native solutions that make this vision real. You will operate where AI innovation, top-tier engineering, and business outcomes converge, acting as the technical bridge between complex business problems and cutting-edge AI execution. Leveraging our robust Enterprise AI Platform, you will translate ambiguous problems into concrete AI solution designs and ensure their successful deployment and measurable impact. This role is designed for systems-thinkers and orchestrators with an AI-first mindset - leaders who move fluidly between hands-on building AI solutions, and who know how to harness model APIs, data sources, and workflow layers to build practical technology that serves the business. What you'll do:. Lead applied AI solution design and architecture, breaking down ambiguous business problems into concrete, actionable AI solution designs. Contribute to the detailed design of large-scale, distributed AI/ML systems, ensuring performance, reliability, and security. Design and improve retrieval, prompting, tool-calling, and orchestration patterns for internal use cases such as knowledge assistants, workflow automation, and decision support. Champion and enforce design standards, patterns, and best practices for scalable and secure development of AI applications across teams. Drive the hands-on development and implementation of key AI components, supporting both traditional and Generative AI model development and deployment. Build and deploy AI-enabled internal workflows that connect enterprise systems, data sources, model APIs, and automation layers. Leverage AI-assisted development to accelerate implementation, bringing a strong 'editor' mindset to ruthlessly audit, review, and secure AI-generated code against our standards for reliability, security, observability, and documentation. Lead the implementation and continuous improvement of MLOps pipelines, including automated model training, versioning, deployment, and monitoring. Develop and maintain evaluation approaches for output quality, retrieval accuracy, latency, and failure modes, and use findings to improve system performance over time. Help identify where human review, controls, and escalation paths are required to support responsible deployment of AI-enabled systems. Apply sound engineering judgment to balance speed, usability, risk, and maintainability in production and near-production environments. Proactively collaborate with executive leadership, data science, engineering, and product stakeholders to translate business use-cases into scalable AI solutions. Lead rigorous problem formulation by partnering with R&D,, Security, Data, HR, Finance, and business stakeholders - ensuring we apply AI to the right problems before translating needs into scalable technical solutions. Provide technical leadership and mentorship to other AI/ML engineers, fostering a culture of engineering excellence and hands-on experimentation. Contribute reusable components, playbooks, and patterns that reduce duplicate effort and improve speed across the engineering environment. Technical architecture and AI implementations directly to measurable business outcomes, recognizing that technology serves the business. Actively research and evaluate cutting-edge AI/ML techniques, algorithms, and models to identify opportunities for platform enhancement and new solution development. Experience you'll need:. 10+ years of core Software/Systems Engineering architecture experience, including 4+ years dedicated to building and deploying applied AI/ML systems in production. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (Master's/Ph.D. is a plus). Direct hands-on experience with Generative AI technologies, including LLMs, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), context graphs, memory management, and agentic AI architectures. Strong programming skills in Python, Java, or Go. Deep proficiency with GenAI orchestration frameworks (e.g., LangGraph, LlamaIndex, AutoGen, Semantic Kernel) and a working knowledge of traditional ML frameworks (e.g., PyTorch, TensorFlow). Extensive hands-on experience with the modern AI data ecosystem, including Vector Databases (e.g., Pinecone, Weaviate) and Graph Databases (e.g., Neo4j). Experience with distributed systems architecture, event-driven streaming platforms, and cloud AI/ML platforms (e.g., GCP Vertex AI, AWS SageMaker, Azure OpenAI). Strong ability to work across data, model, application, and infrastructure layers, operating effectively with incomplete information and ambiguous problems. Experience integrating applications, data sources, or internal platforms through APIs, services, event-driven patterns, or workflow tools. Deep understanding of security principles as they apply to AI systems (e.g., prompt injection, data exfiltration, RBAC). Experience in enterprise-scale environments with meaningful privacy or compliance constraints. Experience with telemetry, tracing, and production monitoring for AI systems (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix, Datadog). Experience contributing to open-source AI projects, publications, or active participation in the AI engineering community. Evidence of applied AI building - GitHub contributions, technical writing, demos, or open-source work demonstrating curiosity for emerging AI tooling. Prior experience in a solutions architecture, successfully bridging technical teams and senior business stakeholders.. title: Principal Engineer
description: About the role :. The Principal Engineer role is a highly strategic position, operating at the same level as an Engineering Director. In the Developer Platform organization, you will be responsible for defining and executing the technical strategy for multiple key systems/technical areas that are of significant impact to the company's Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC), developer experience, and core engineering productivity. The scope and impact of your work will span the interactions among multiple complex systems and engineering organizations, focusing on the end-to-end flow of software delivery, scaling Developer Platforms & Infrastructure, and leveraging AI to revolutionize productivity. You will sit at the center of driving these critical improvements, ensuring the platform scales to meet the company's growth. Your primary focus will be problem seeking. This involves not only defining plans for ambiguous problems (e.g., "How do we scale our platform 10x while reducing costs?") but also identifying problems crucial for the future of engineering productivity and proposing plans for their resolution, such as the strategic integration of AI/ML into core developer workflows. What you'll do. Your responsibilities will encompass technical leadership, strategic delivery and people growth with a focus on cross-functional impact across the Developer Platform and the wider Engineering organization:. Platform Strategy and AI-Powered Productivity. Define the long-term technical vision (3+ years) for the Developer Platform, including core infrastructure, CI/CD pipelines, and observability systems, ensuring they are cohesive and sustainable. Pioneer the integration of AI/ML not just for engineering tasks but to drive overall company productivity, transforming internal processes and tools. Identify and translate a future business opportunity or engineering productivity gap into a solvable, multi-quarter technical problem with a clear roadmap. Drive significant improvements in engineering velocity and quality by identifying and solving bottlenecks within the software development process and continually introducing innovation. Technical Leadership and Standards. Apply domain expertise across multiple system domains (e.g., CI/CD, Observability, Cloud Infrastructure, Tooling) to drive future-proof, high-leverage platform solutions. Set standards for quality, structure, and operational excellence across all core platform systems. Be a Consensus Builder, resolving conflicting priorities and mitigating risks across dependent engineering teams. Take end-to-end ownership of complex, cross-cutting projects (10-18 engineers' effort) from inception to operation. Engineering Influence & Growth:. Drive and influence collaboration across the entire Engineering organization, establishing a unified software development vision. Act as a company ambassador through significant external contributions (e.g., open-source, publications, standards committees). Master the craft of coaching, mentoring Staff Engineers for Principal-level impact, and raising the hiring bar. About You. Typically 18+ years of industry experience in Software Engineering, with a significant focus on Developer Platforms, Infrastructure, or Core Tools. Demonstrated ability to function at a level equivalent to an Engineering Director in terms of strategic impact, scope of influence, and technical ownership. A proven track record of identifying, defining, and driving the technical strategy for high-impact initiatives across multiple complex, multi-organizational systems. Deep expertise in a general-purpose programming language (e.g., Go, Java, C/C++, Scala, Python) and mastery in applying first principles thinking-actively questioning assumptions to create new knowledge and solutions for core engineering problems. Exceptional skills as a Consensus Builder and Cross-Functional Leader, adept at navigating conflicting priorities and influencing stakeholders across various teams to achieve a unified vision. Experience in architecting and scaling highly available, fault-tolerant Developer Platforms and Infrastructure. A demonstrable understanding of how to strategically leverage AI/ML to improve software development processes and overall company productivity. Ability to act as an effective coach and mentor, supporting the growth of engineers up to the Staff level. Capable of self-directing, managing time, and advocating for resources for activities that are critical for the company's future engineering velocity and platform stability.. . title: Product Designer
description: Product Designer. Based in the Tel Aviv office, in a hybrid model. . About Rubrik. Join the public powerhouse that is securing the future of AI. Rubrik has officially entered a new era. Fresh off a headline-making successful IPO and boasting over $1.3 Billion in ARR , we have the market stability of a giant and the hunger of a startup. We've already conquered Data Security-now, we are pivoting to our most ambitious mission yet: Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. As a Rubrik designer, you will be pioneering the next generation User Experiences for the enterprise! From AI to air-gapped immutable backups to defending against ransomware, our tech stack is the definition of cyber resilience. We are a Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader and a winner of the Red Dot & iF Design Awards because we believe security and protection should be powerful and usable. Come build the safety net for the AI generation. About Team & About Role:. Our design team is strong and mighty, with about 60 amazing individuals from all walks of the industry and life located worldwide. As our company and our products grow rapidly, it is crucial to scale the experience of our product and our design team in the right way and with the right people. Every hire counts!. title: Regional Manager, Channel Central
description: As the Regional Manager, Channels - Central Region , you will be responsible for leading, scaling, and driving the channel go-to-market (GTM) strategy across a high-growth territory spanning the Central United States. You will recruit, mentor, and elevate a team of Channel Development Managers (CDMs) who cultivate strategic relationships with key regional partners, national solution providers, and elite resellers. In this senior leadership role, you will act as a critical bridge between Rubrik's Central channel ecosystem and internal executive stakeholders across Field Sales, Systems Engineering, Global Alliances, Channel Marketing, and Sales Operations. You will own the Central Region's channel revenue targets, drive joint pipeline generation, and shape high-impact partner strategies that align with Rubrik's long-term enterprise growth objectives. What You'll Be Doing :. Regional Strategy & Ownership: Formulate and execute a comprehensive GTM channel strategy across the Central Region to accelerate revenue growth, expand market share, and maximize partner productivity. Executive Partner Alignment: Establish and nurture deep relationships with executive and C-suite leadership across key regional and national partner organizations to keep Rubrik top-of-mind as a strategic vendor. Field Sales Integration: Partner closely with Central Region Sales Leadership to align channel strategies directly with enterprise account plans, joint account mapping, and field sales engagement. Talent Leadership: Recruit, coach, and develop a team of Channel Development Managers (CDMs). Drive a culture of accountability, operational excellence, and high performance. Execution & Quota Attainment: Guide team execution toward aggressive monthly, quarterly, and annual pipeline generation and revenue targets, stepping in as executive sponsorship on strategic enterprise opportunities. Budget & MDF Optimization: Direct and allocate regional Market Development Funds (MDF) and enablement budgets, prioritizing investments that drive measurable ROI, demand generation, and partner loyalty. Forecasting & Pipeline Rigor: Implement rigorous forecasting, pipeline analytics, and Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) to maintain channel visibility, account coverage, and revenue predictability. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Mobilize internal resources across Systems Engineering, Alliances, Marketing, and Operations to equip partners with technical enablement, co-selling tools, and deal registration support. Experience You'll Need :. Overall Experience: 7-10 years of progressive experience in enterprise IT Channel Sales, Partner Management, or Strategic Alliances within the cybersecurity, data management, cloud, or SaaS sectors. Leadership Experience: 5+ years of direct people management experience leading a team of channel sales professionals (CDMs/CAMs). Proven Performance: A consistent track record of exceeding multi-million-dollar regional quotas, accelerating partner revenue, and driving joint enterprise sales campaigns. Strategic Acumen: Deep expertise in partner business models, GTM planning, target account selling, and consultative solution-selling techniques. Executive Presence: Outstanding written and verbal communication skills with the confidence to influence partner executives and internal cross-functional leaders. Regional Ecosystem Knowledge: Strong familiarization with the Central US partner ecosystem (VARs, MSPs, Systems Integrators, and National Partners). Education: Bachelor's Degree in Business, Marketing, Computer Science, or related field preferred (or equivalent practical experience). Leadership & Values: A strong role model for Rubrik's core values-fostering cross-functional collaboration, strategic thinking, and an inclusive, winning team culture.. #LI-MR2. title: Revenue Accounting Manager
description: Revenue Accounting Manager. . About the team:. We are seeking an experienced Revenue Accounting Manager to join our global Revenue Accounting team. This high-visibility individual contributor role is part of the team that owns the end-to-end revenue recognition lifecycle for a public, multi-entity SaaS business. The successful candidate pairs deep technical command of ASC 606 with strong revenue operations instincts. They are equally comfortable writing a position memo on a non-standard, multi-element arrangement, troubleshooting a revenue arrangement in NetSuite ARM, and partnering with operations on new product introduction (NPI) and UAT for revenue systems. They bring an AI-driven mindset: proactively identifying ways to apply AI and automation to revenue accounting workflows, testing outputs for accuracy, and adopting new tools as the team's capabilities evolve. This role would report into our Palo Alto HQ 3x per week. . Where you can make an impact:. Execute monthly accounting activities in NetSuite, including journal entries and account reconciliations, and deliver close-related items on schedule. Prepare supporting schedules and flux analysis to explain period-over-period revenue and deferred revenue movements. Prepare deal and contract summaries for significant transactions in accordance with ASC 606. Assist with operationalizing new sales models, ensuring revenue accounting implications are addressed ahead of launch. Responsible for Standalone Selling Price (SSP) compliance. Responsible for the NPI process for revenue. Execute SOX controls over revenue. Respond to ad hoc data and analysis requests from cross-functional partners. Support revenue accounting and order-to-cash projects. Assist with User Acceptance Testing (UAT) and post-launch validation to ensure seamless implementation of new products and services. Identify and implement AI and automation opportunities and continuously refine revenue accounting processes and procedures.. Ideal background:. Bachelor's degree with an emphasis in Finance or Accounting preferred; CPA / CA required. 7+ years of combined experience in public accounting and corporate revenue accounting. Hands-on ASC 606 expertise on complex, non-standard deals; strong understanding of revenue operations and the quote-to-revenue process. NetSuite experience required (ARM module preferred); advanced Excel skills. Experience with Salesforce (SFDC) and Tableau a plus. Experience manipulating large data sets to uncover trends and make recommendations. Proven experience executing the revenue close, reconciliations, flux analysis and SOX controls. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with attention to detail, accuracy, and clear verbal and written communication. Self-starter and team player who thrives in a fast-paced, rapidly changing environment. title: Sales Development Representative
description: About Rubrik's Sales Organization. Rubrik's sales team helps enterprises and government entities achieve cyber resilience - protection against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. Our One Rubrik selling approach means you'll have cross-functional support, dedicated enablement resources, and a clear path to exceed your goals and grow your career. All while doing something that matters: protecting the world's data. About This Role. Sales Development Representatives are the engine of Rubrik's go-to-market strategy. Through targeted outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification, you'll generate a high-quality pipeline for our field sales teams. This means researching accounts, crafting personalized outreach, and earning meetings with decision-makers at organizations that need what Rubrik offers. This is a launchpad role - built to develop you into a full-cycle sales professional. Our SDRs receive structured coaching, ongoing training, and a defined career path into closing roles. What You'll Do. Prospecting & Pipeline Generation. Research target accounts, identify high-potential contacts, and craft personalized outreach across email, phone, and social channels to generate qualified meetings for field sales teams. Leverage customer success stories, case studies, and proof points in your outreach to demonstrate real-world impact - connecting a prospect's pain to how Rubrik has already solved it for organizations like theirs. Follow up on marketing-generated inbound leads within established SLA and compliance metrics. Manage your pipeline, leads, and activity data in Salesforce with discipline and accuracy. Track and report on your performance against defined activity and outcome targets. Collaboration & Strategy. Partner with your aligned field sales team to develop account strategies and break into priority accounts. Stay current on cybersecurity trends, the competitive landscape, and industry developments to sharpen your messaging and relevance. Develop deep fluency in Rubrik's products and the business problems we solve for customers. Participate in ongoing coaching sessions, call reviews, pitch competitions, and bootcamps designed to accelerate your sales skills. . What You'll Bring. Required:. 0-2 years of experience in B2B sales, lead generation, or a customer-facing role (internships and non-traditional backgrounds welcome). Strong written and verbal communication skills. Interest and aptitude for learning technical concepts quickly. Comfort working in a metrics-driven environment with clear daily and weekly targets. A genuine desire to build a career in sales and business development. Ability to work out of Rubrik's Austin office a minimum of 4 days a week. Work-authorization: U.S. citizenship and residency on U.S. soil required. Preferred:. Familiarity with Salesforce, Outreach, Orum, or similar sales engagement tools. Exposure to cybersecurity or data management technology. Experience using AI-powered sales tools (e.g., ChatGPT, Gong, Clari, 6sense) to improve prospecting efficiency. What Makes Someone Successful Here. Intellectually Hungry - You ask questions, seek feedback, and treat every conversation as a chance to learn something new. Integrity - You're honest with prospects, teammates, and yourself. You do the right thing even when no one is watching. Execution-Focused - You prioritize ruthlessly, manage your time well, and consistently deliver against your activity and outcome targets. Collaborative - You celebrate team wins, share what's working, and actively contribute to a culture that makes everyone better. Driven - You hold yourself to a higher standard than anyone else would set for you. AI-Tool Fluent - You actively integrate AI and automation into your daily workflow - whether that's using AI-assisted research to build smarter account plans, leveraging tools like conversational intelligence platforms to sharpen call performance, or using generative AI to draft and iterate on personalized outreach at speed. You see AI as a force multiplier, not a shortcut. Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. Through independent outbound hunting and a proportion of inbound leads, the SDR team books high-quality meetings with potential new customers for Rubrik's sales organisation. We do this by having a targeted set of prospects that we research, personalise our messaging to, and influence to evaluate Rubrik. The SDR position teaches All-Star talent what it takes to be successful in the highly lucrative world of enterprise technology. Rubrik has also been recognised as a 2021 LinkedIn Top Company and Forbes Cloud 100 Company and LinkedIn Top Startup five years in a row. This is your opportunity to build a career in one of the world's most challenging and rewarding fields. What you'll do:. Identify high-potential customers, research Rubrik's value fit, personalise messaging to prospects, and generate high-quality new business meetings for the company. Responsible for outbound/inbound activities for our enterprise customer prospecting by contacting via email, social and phone calls to qualify prospects to set meetings. Follow up on inbound leads generated by Marketing and stay within compliance metrics, i.e. timely follow-up and attempts to connect. Collaborate with the field sales team you're aligned with and develop strategies for breaking into new accounts. Stay up-to-date on market trends, competition, and industry developments - we're seeing cybersecurity breaches daily in today's world. Rubrik can make an impact. Be an expert on what we do and how we help our customers keep their businesses up and running. Use customer relationship management (Salesforce & Salesloft) software to manage leads and sales activities. Own your business and your sales targets, and be able to report on your results to your stakeholders. What you put in is what you get out!. Develop how to think on your feet and learn the art of sales through team pitch competitions, boot camps, training, and more - we love friendly competition!. You will receive coaching and development on an ongoing basis, our managers will assist with developing your skills and approach to calls, thus improving Rubrik's service to its customers. ( Note: Telephone calls to and from prospects & customers, may be recorded, depending on region, and listened to from time to time by yourself and management.). If available based on location, you will be working in-office 3-5 days a week for active coaching and peer camaraderie. Interest and ability to learn technical concepts quickly. A valid VISA or right to work in the UK without sponsorship. Desire for a successful career in sales/business development. Written & Verbal Communication succinct & professional email, LinkedIn, phone. What would make you successful in this role?. Curiosity, grit, goal-oriented, growth mindset. Organisation & Time Management ability to structure hours/days/weeks. Research & Business Intuition ability to interpret information and use for prospecting. Active Listening & Adaptability audible ready to carry conversation and react with value. Objection Handling ability to comprehend and overcome objections. Storytelling ability to paint a picture of technical pain & business value. What do our perks look like?. Uncapped commission structure. Competitive pay. Competitive benefits (i.e. medical/dental/vision insurance, 401(k), wellness & mental health resources, etc.). Apple laptop. Fun in-office activities. Rewards and Recognition. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data.. Rubrik is looking for a Sales Engineer to provide technical direction and business guidance to our Enterprise sales team in Germany. What You'll Do. Provide technical leadership and direction to customers and internal staff in the development of fully integrated technology solutions in support of pre-sales activities across your patch. Own discovery, demo, and technical validation (POC or otherwise) largely independently, so opportunities keep moving without waiting on specialist support at every step. Demonstrate technical leadership and subject matter expertise on Rubrik's products and platform, adapting your pitch across on-prem, cloud, SaaS, identity, and increasingly AI-driven customer requirements. Make technical and sales presentations to customers' technical staff and senior management; in person as well as remotely, including travel within Germany for onsite meetings and workshops. title: Security Engineer - Identity and Access
description: About the team. The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.3. About the role. We are looking for an experienced and technically deep Identity and Access Management (IAM) Engineer to execute technical strategy across our entire Identity and Access Security management program. This domain spans a broad and increasingly complex set of disciplines, including Identity Governance & Administration (IGA), Access Management, Privileged Access Management (PAM), Non-Human Identity (NHI) security, and the emerging space of Agentic Identity security. This is fundamentally a hands-on role. You will be expected to personally design systems from the ground up and build automation that scales across a large and diverse application portfolio. At the same time, this role carries significant cross-functional weight: you will be partnering closely and continuously with Information Security, IT, Engineering and the many application-owning teams distributed across the company, driving the identity security initiatives in alignment with the overall business objectives. What you'll do. Solution Design. Design and build IAM solutions - including configurations, integrations, and workflows - that align with evolving business requirements, security policies and regulatory requirements (eg., SOX, GDPR). Application Onboarding & Integration. Lead the onboarding of applications into IAM platforms, integrating across diverse systems including major cloud platforms, SaaS applications, and in-house systems. Build automation and policy-as-code frameworks. Manage identity access policies as versioned, auditable code - using source control, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code to automate identity and access management changes instead of manual, ticket-driven processes. Deepen identity governance platform integrations. Build and extend automated provisioning/deprovisioning, entitlement aggregation, and access certification workflows across the application portfolio. Privileged Access Management. Design privileged access models across applications and endpoints - including session management and just-in-time elevation - to minimize standing access without slowing teams down. Non-human/Agentic identity governance. Build inventory, risk-scoring, runtime policy enforcement and remediation tooling for service accounts, API keys, workload identities, AI agents etc. IAM Platform Auditing & Posture Management. Review and audit identity and access management platforms to identify security misconfigurations, strengthen security policies, and enforce industry best practices. Incident Response & Forensics Support. Provide subject matter expertise during security incidents to support investigations into identity and access related events. On-Call Coverage & Escalations. Engage in on-call rotations and provide technical escalation support outside standard business hours. Technical governance and design reviews. Enforce technical standards across the team, evaluate identity related design proposals, and serve as the main escalation point for complex identity security decisions and integration challenges. Experience you'll need. Minimum of 6 years of experience in Identity and Access Management (IAM), with deep hands-on experience implementing and managing IAM solutions within leading cloud environments such as AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform. They play a large part in ensuring compliance to related regulatory guidance, compliance with accounting policies and standards, practices, and principles. This team owns the process of accurate and timely closure of financial books of accounts, audit of financial statements, and auditing processes. They maintain and improve the overall control environment over reporting. About the role:. As a Senior Accountant role within our International Accounting organisation in Bangalore, India. This position will be part of our International Accounting & Reporting team, supporting Rubrik subsidiary local reporting (Primarily for India). This position will require strong accounting skills, the ability to effectively partner with stakeholders (internal and external) and team members, execute and maintain accounting principles in line with the local accounting framework, regulations and company policies, and the ability to drive issues through to resolution and validation. Support other APAC and EMEA entities in preparing and filing annual financial statements. title: Senior AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
description: About the team:. . Rubrik secures and accelerates the world's AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik's Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We are building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large-scale enterprise transformation. About the role:. We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You'll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real-world data. You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re-scope work that won't deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow. What you'll do:. Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions. Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik's internal agent platform and business systems. Turn complex processes into multi-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire-to-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs. Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling. Leverage full-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high-ownership, user-facing agent systems. Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts. Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human-in-the-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time. Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused. Experience you'll need:. Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes. Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces. A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here. Software engineering skills and best practices:. System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures. Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance. Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec → Plan → Task → Code→ Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents. Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve systems based on issues and signals from production. AI engineering skills and best practices:. Build agents in code using LLM APIs, SDKs, and libraries, not just no code or low code tools, and have shipped agentic systems that real users rely on. Design robust agent harnesses and multi agent orchestrations: model tools and resources, manage context and state, and keep runs reliable under real world data and load. Establish continuous evaluation and safety mechanisms: turn production failures into test cases, gate changes on eval suite results, and enforce guardrails across agent workflows. Exercise clear judgment on AI fit: decide when a problem needs an agent versus a simpler automation or no build, and make tradeoffs around model choice, latency and cost, context strategy, and autonomy using data rather than intuition. Preferred qualifications:. Knowledge/context graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval. Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms. Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks. Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks. Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores. UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description: About the Role. The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks. This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment - ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement. The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines , build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing , and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority. Key Responsibilities. Design and build agent evaluation frameworks - create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate. Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models). Build golden datasets and test harnesses - curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance). Establish eval-as-a-service - build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks. Automate regression and drift detection - implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment. Define eval taxonomies and rubrics - establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery). Instrument production observability - build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns. Benchmark and select models - run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases. Analyze and interpret evaluation results , providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations. Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies - functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) - tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities. Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions. Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects , performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes. Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap. Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements. Provide technical leadership to engineers , including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers. Collaborate cross-functionally - work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle. Required Qualifications. Education & Experience. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience. 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience , with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs). 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building , testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows. 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment. 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model. Technical Skills. Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation - familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses. Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns - tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Production experience with eval pipelines - building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks). Proficiency in Python - strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale. Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows. Statistical literacy - ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming). Enterprise product sensibility - understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs). Excellent communication - ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions. Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows , including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps. Tech Stack:. Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional). Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright. LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models. Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses. Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators. Infrastructure: DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana). Preferred Qualifications. Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge : Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment. Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results. Policy Background: Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development. Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools : Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures. Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows. Experience with prompt injection (Must) and data poisoning skills is a plus. Certifications in AI/ML , cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies. Soft Skills. Proven ability to lead without direct authority , influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy. Experience working in agile environments , collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones. Excellent communication and documentation skills , comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders. Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills , including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions. Nice to have. Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains. Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms. Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability). Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison). Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams. Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology. Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing - design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents. title: Senior Analyst, Global Alliances GTM Operation
description: About the Role. Rubrik is looking for a detail-driven Senior Analyst to join our Cloud GTM Operations team, based in India and supporting our APJ and EMEA regions. This role sits at the intersection of Sales, Finance, Engineering, our cloud partners (Microsoft Azure, AWS, and Google Cloud), and our broader alliance and referral partners.
