title: Senior Software Engineer - Enterprise AI
description: About Rubrik and the team. Rubrik is on a mission to secure the world's data. With our Zero Trust Data Security™ platform, we help organizations achieve business resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. Rubrik protects data wherever it lives-across enterprise, cloud, and SaaS-and delivers data observability, orchestration, and recovery at scale.. The Information Technology team at Rubrik influences business processes, employee experience, and technologies to scale our organization to $1B+. This team creates operational efficiency across the company by centralizing the management of Infrastructure, Technology, and Data. The IT team ensures all stages of the software development lifecycle in a secured environment and scrutinizes the deployment of proper processes along with governance. They champion Rubrik on Rubrik and are the first customers of the Engineering teams at Rubrik. We're transforming global infrastructure, and we're looking for bold thinkers and builders to join us. If you're passionate about making an impact and shaping the future of cloud and platform infrastructure-we'd love to hear from you. About the Role. The Enterprise AI team is Rubrik's internal AI enablement engine. We evaluate where AI can make a real difference, build the platforms and patterns that make adoption easy, and help engineering teams across the organization work smarter and faster. We operate at the intersection of applied AI, distributed systems, and enterprise operations - our job is to make Rubrik more efficient, one AI-powered workflow at a time. This is a high-impact, high-autonomy team where you'll work closely with engineering, product and operations teams across Rubrik to bring AI capabilities to life. We're hiring a Sr. Software Engineer to design, build, and operate the platform and backend systems that power Rubrik at scale. You'll own core infrastructure - from Kubernetes and cloud-native services to APIs and developer tooling - and work closely with product, AI, and security teams. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you write production code, design systems, lead code reviews, and make the engineering organization more effective. Key Responsibilities. Own end-to-end delivery of major platform initiatives, from design through deployment and post-launch success. Own Kubernetes at depth - clusters, networking, operators, container lifecycle, and multi-tenant orchestration. Design, develop, and optimize distributed services and cloud-native infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP for scale, reliability, and performance. Drive engineering excellence through code quality standards, design reviews, automation, and CI/CD best practices. Collaborate across teams - Product, AI, and Security - to align architecture with business objectives. Be a mentor and multiplier, guiding engineers through architecture decisions, trade-offs, and delivery. Partner with leadership to align engineering strategy with product objectives and technical roadmap. What You Bring (Qualifications). Required. 9+ years of software engineering with deep backend and infrastructure focus. Strong programming skills in Python and/or Go - you ship production code, not just scripts and configs. Deep, hands-on Kubernetes experience - building and operating clusters, not just deploying to them. Proven experience designing and operating distributed systems in production. Cloud-native fluency across AWS and/or GCP - compute, storage, IAM, networking and managed services. Experience with infrastructure-as-code (Terraform or similar) and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with applied AI tooling and patterns - agentic AI tools (Claude, LiteLLM), AI gateways, agent frameworks - and being able to build backend services that integrate with them. Strong system design and architectural judgment. Clear communicator who partners well across product, security, and AI teams. Preferred. Observability stacks - Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry. Multi-cloud or hybrid infrastructure experience (AWS, GCP, on-prem). title: Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager, Cloud & Strategic Partnerships
description: Who We Are. Rubrik is one of the fastest-growing companies in Silicon Valley, revolutionizing data protection and management in the multi-cloud IT industry. Our mission is to unlock the power of data by organizing and protecting the world's business information, and we've built a forward-thinking, design-oriented brand that is changing how enterprises think about resilience. We don't wait for someone else to define the industry - we define it ourselves. Rubrik was the first platform to orchestrate data for hybrid and multi-cloud enterprises anytime, anywhere, blending future-proof architecture with consumer-grade simplicity. We're looking for people who produce extraordinary results, who are comfortable in ambiguity, and who are excited by hard problems. If you have a limitless drive and like to win, we want to talk to you. Who You Are. As Rubrik's business increasingly runs on hyperscale cloud infrastructure, we're adding an individual contributor Senior Strategic Sourcing Manager to own the end-to-end, 360° relationship with our most strategic cloud and technology partners - including AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft - as well as other key strategic vendor relationships across the business. While strategic cloud and technology partnerships are the anchor of this position, you'll also flex into broader sourcing deals across the team's portfolio as priorities shift - negotiating agreements, running competitive sourcing events, and partnering cross-functionally wherever the business needs strong commercial leadership. You'll work closely with cross-functional partners including Engineering, IT, InfoSec, Legal, Finance, and Accounting. You're a self-starter who's comfortable operating with limited direction and full ownership of your domain - a pragmatic problem-solver who thrives in a fast-paced environment. You will report to the Head of Global Procurement and be accountable for savings, risk, and relationship health across your portfolio. What You'll Be Doing. Strategic Cloud & Partner Relationship Management. Own the 360° relationship with Rubrik's strategic cloud providers (AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) and other top-tier strategic vendors - spanning commercial negotiations, governance, payment, escalation management, and long-term partnership strategy. Serve as the primary sourcing point of contact for these accounts, coordinating quarterly and annual business reviews, scorecards, and joint roadmap discussions with internal stakeholders and partner account teams. Structure and negotiate complex, multi-year cloud and strategic partnership agreements, including committed-use discounts, credits, co-marketing terms, and other commercial levers that drive measurable value. Build a deep understanding of each strategic partner's roadmap, pricing constructs, and program offerings, and translate that knowledge into strategies that benefit Rubrik's cost position and technical roadmap. Broader Strategic Sourcing Support. Beyond the strategic account portfolio, project-manage additional complex deals across Rubrik's technology sourcing categories - software, hardware, SaaS, cloud, and professional services - driving collaboration among all parties to reach favorable terms. Develop and drive category strategy and optimization opportunities across Engineering, InfoSec, and IT, as capacity and business priorities require. Prepare RFQs and RFPs, evaluate proposals, and administer competitive sourcing events for a range of deals as needed. Manage the commercial aspects of contracts and license agreements, ensuring obligations are met and renewals are tracked in a scalable way. Leadership & Cross-Functional Impact. Act as a thought leader from a sourcing/procurement perspective, partnering with business stakeholders to develop new and creative strategies. Build strategic relationships with both external suppliers and internal business partners to drive results and influence decisions. Contribute to programs that assess and promote supplier performance and development, including goal-setting, business reviews, and formal scorecards. Establish and report on KPIs supporting the procurement team's goals, with particular visibility into strategic cloud spend and value delivered. Experience You'll Need. 8+ years of experience in Indirect or Technology Sourcing, with a strong track record negotiating complex technology, SaaS, or cloud agreements in a fast-paced environment. Direct experience managing strategic relationships with major cloud or technology providers (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft) strongly preferred. Excellent negotiation skills and broad procurement category management experience (Software, Hardware, SaaS, Cloud, and Professional Services). Proven ability to manage a portfolio of both strategic, high-visibility accounts and a rotating set of tactical or ad hoc deals simultaneously. Excellent customer service skills and the ability to partner with key stakeholders and build relationships across multi-functional teams. Experience with supplier scorecards and supplier relationship management. Strong financial and analytical skills to identify cost savings opportunities and support business-case development. Self-starting, entrepreneurial, scrappy, and resourceful, with a strong work ethic and high integrity. Working knowledge of Coupa and NetSuite preferred. Experience in contract negotiation from a legal perspective (e.g., J.D.) a plus. description: About the Role:. We are seeking an accomplished and highly driven Senior Technical Program Manager to lead strategic Sales & Marketing programs in Rubrik IT. Hands-on proficiency with generative AI platforms (e.g., Claude, Gemini, ChatGPT) to automate project documentation, accelerate decision-making, and streamline cross-functional workflows. title: Small Enterprise Account Executive
description: . . Small Enterprise Account Executive, Japan. . Rubrik's Sales organization is a united group of elite cross-functional sales professionals that help companies & government entities achieve resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions. We offer continuous professional growth and opportunity through our world-class sales enablement program. Our One Rubrik selling approach provides all the resources you need to exceed your goals, maximize your earnings potential, and take your career to the next level. All this while doing something truly purposeful, protecting the world's data. . As an Enterprise Account Executive, you'll own new logo growth across Japan's large enterprise market, with the autonomy to shape your territory and the backing of a global team and a world-class enablement program to take your career to the next level. We are seeking a relentless self-starter who is hyper-focused on acquiring new logos by discovering and developing new opportunities, managing pipeline, and executing account strategies, while also encouraging existing customer expansion. The AE must drive pipeline generation daily while working with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik Channel Partners to exceed sales quotas. . Rubrikのセールス組織は、企業や政府機関がサイバー攻撃、悪意ある内部関係者、事業中断に対するレジリエンスを実現できるよう支援する、部門横断型のエリートセールス・プロフェッショナルの集団です。世界トップレベルのセールス・イネーブルメント・プログラムを通じて、継続的な成長の機会を提供します。「One Rubrik」セリングアプローチにより、目標達成、収入の最大化、そしてキャリアの飛躍に必要なあらゆるリソースをご活用いただけます。そしてそれは、世界のデータを守るという、真に意義のある仕事を通じて実現できます。. エンタープライズ・アカウント・エグゼクティブとして、あなたは日本の大企業市場における新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得を担います。テリトリーを自らの裁量で切り拓くことができ、グローバルチームと世界トップレベルのイネーブルメント・プログラムがあなたのキャリアの飛躍を支えます。私たちが求めているのは、新たな商機の発掘と育成、パイプライン管理、アカウント戦略の実行を通じて新規顧客の獲得に徹底的にこだわり、同時に既存顧客の拡大も推進できる、粘り強く自律的な方です。AEは、セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのチャネルパートナーと連携しながら、日々パイプライン創出に取り組み、セールスクォータの達成を目指します。. . What You'll Do. Define and execute a territory plan for Japan's large enterprise accounts, owning bookings growth from first conversation to close. Generate net new pipeline through your own prospecting and outreach, opening doors at accounts that have never worked with Rubrik. Lead complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles, using a disciplined qualification methodology to forecast accurately and win. Present Rubrik's cyber resilience solutions in complex data center and cloud environments, helping customers see how fast they can recover when it matters most. Partner with Sales Engineers, Sales Development, Channel Development, and Rubrik partners to co-sell and scale your territory. Share local market insight with Rubrik leadership, helping shape how we grow in Japan. Collaborate with and learn from a high-performing One Rubrik sales team that invests in your continued growth. 主な業務内容. 日本の大企業アカウントを対象としたテリトリープランを策定・実行し、最初の商談からクローズまで、ブッキングの成長に責任を持つ. 自らのプロスペクティングとアウトリーチを通じて新規パイプラインを創出し、Rubrikとこれまで取引のなかった企業との接点を開拓する. 複数のステークホルダーが関わる複雑な営業サイクルをリードし、規律ある案件評価(クオリフィケーション)の手法を用いて、正確な予測と受注を実現する. 複雑なデータセンターおよびクラウド環境において、Rubrikのサイバーレジリエンス・ソリューションを提案し、いざという時にどれだけ迅速に復旧できるかをお客様に示す. セールスエンジニア、セールス・デベロップメント、チャネル・デベロップメント、Rubrikのパートナーと連携し、共同で販売を進めながらテリトリーを拡大する. 現地市場に関する知見をRubrikのリーダーシップと共有し、日本での成長戦略の策定に貢献する. 継続的な成長を支援する、高いパフォーマンスを誇る「One Rubrik」セールスチームと協働し、互いに学び合う. Experience You'll Need. 8+ years of enterprise Account Executive experience selling Security, Infrastructure, Data, or SaaS solutions. A track record of landing net new logos in large enterprise accounts, with at least 3 years at a large company (1,000+ employees) and experience in a hypergrowth environment (ideally large company followed by startup or scale-up). Strong, consistent achievement as an AE, evidenced by President's Club, top-performer awards, or sustained quota attainment. Proven ability to self-source deals and build pipeline from scratch through your own outbound prospecting, rather than relying on customer or partner referrals. A repeatable new logo pipeline generation process you can walk us through, from cold account to qualified opportunity. Hands-on experience with MEDDIC or MEDDPICC, or another proven enterprise qualification methodology. A stable career with meaningful tenure and measurable impact in each role. Experience working with channel partners and selling complex solutions. 求めるご経験. セキュリティ、インフラ、データ、またはSaaSソリューションを扱うエンタープライズ・アカウントエグゼクティブとしての10年以上の経験. 大企業アカウントにおける新規顧客(ニューロゴ)獲得の実績。大手企業(従業員1,000名以上)での3年以上の勤務経験、およびハイパーグロース環境での経験(大手企業からスタートアップ、スケールアップへというキャリアが望ましい). MEDDICまたはMEDDPICC、もしくはそれに準ずる実績のあるエンタープライズ向け案件評価手法の実務経験. 各職務において意義ある在籍期間と測定可能な成果を残してきた、安定したキャリア. チャネルパートナーとの協業経験、および複雑なソリューションの販売経験. Above all, you will have the ability to operate in a fast-paced, changing environment, self-starter, and operate in a highly matrixed organization. Demonstrate Rubrik's RIVET values and be a role model, collaborating effectively and creating a positive environment. . 何よりも、変化の激しい環境で成果を出せること、自ら率先して行動できること、そしてマトリックス型の組織で円滑に仕事を進められることが重要です。RubrikのRIVETバリューを体現し、ロールモデルとして、周囲と効果的に協働しながら、前向きな職場環境を築いていただける方を求めています。. #LI-FT1. . . title: Software Engineer, Atlas Distributed Systems
description: About Team. Rubrik Atlas is the core data path for all Rubrik products, whether in the data center, at the edge, or in the cloud. It is a distributed, scale-out, fault tolerant, performant, deduplicated user-space filesystem that uniquely combines block device (ext4/NFS/SMB) and S3 backend storage interfaces. It has been the cornerstone of Rubrik's innovative tech stack since Day 1. Since inception this team has attracted some of our strongest technical talent with a very high bar for quality and velocity. We are looking for motivated engineers, who can complement this rockstar team!. About Role. Rubrik is expanding at a rapid pace in all directions, from supporting various applications (like Kubernetes, Oracle, EC2, and RDS protection) to hardware storage platforms (like SSD, HDD, S3, Azure Blob, and EBS), to revolutionizing cloud protection (such as SaaS protection, data security, and immutability). At the heart of this transformation is our Atlas platform. We are looking for an experienced distributed systems engineer to guide us through the next stage of the evolution of our data platform. As an engineer in the team, you'll design, develop and deliver cutting-edge solutions for the tectonic shifts mentioned above. You will be responsible for outlining the architectural principles we should build towards, prototyping changes, and working with the team to realize the vision in a production-quality system. Your technical direction will also impact multiple teams across Rubrik, as we will need to guide them on how to best build on top of Atlas. There will be a wide range of features to work on, including cloud storage-backed file systems with effective cost analysis, building data formats optimized for read and write performance for all workloads, deduplication and compression, reliability, resiliency, infinite scalability, performance tooling using eBPF, asynchronous programming, various read-ahead techniques, snapshotting, data integrity, data security, data immutability in the cloud, and many more. This opportunity provides a potent mix of dynamism, fast startup-like culture, serious technical challenges, and influence across many teams and leaders. If all this sounds interesting, or if you want to know more, please reach out.. What are we looking for?. Bachelor's and/or Master's degree in Computer Science or equivalent. 3+ years of experience in Distributed File System. Strong fundamentals in distributed systems design and development. Experience in building systems at scale and backend development. Hands on with the code and have hands-on coding skills in C++. Preferred Qualifications. Experience with storage solutions or data protection is a huge plus. Experience with nuances public cloud features and costs (like compute, storage, networking, data services) on public clouds (AWS, Azure, GCP). The minimum and maximum base salaries for this role are posted below; additionally, the role is eligible for bonus potential, equity and benefits. The range displayed reflects the minimum and maximum target for new hire salaries for the role based on U.S. location. Within the range, the salary offered will be determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. title: Software Engineer - IAM
description: Location : Pune. About Team & About Role:. . As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org. You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture - particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains. We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform - reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.. . Responsibilities. . Design, build, and harden identity and access flows - OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations - that sit in front of mission-critical systems. Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions. Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought. Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic. Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly. Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed. Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET. Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.). Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature. Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.. Requirements. . Must-have. Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang . Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 - including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes. Working knowledge of Active Directory . Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS . Strong security engineering discipline - comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work. Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency. Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts. Simple, effective written and verbal communication. Nice-to-have. Directory internals (schema, bind operations). HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection). Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI). Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines. Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).. . . . . . . . . Join Us in Securing and Accelerating the World's AI Transformation. title: Software Engineer - Product Platform Security
description: About the Team & Role. The Platform Security Engineering team builds the security features and frameworks that every Rubrik product runs on protecting hundreds of petabytes of data across thousands of enterprise customers globally , from encryption and certificate management to access control and platform hardening at scale. We're a small team with massive impact: the problem space covers the entire Rubrik portfolio, from performant core backend architecture to the AI-powered engineering workflows we and the rest of Rubrik now build with daily. This is a strong opportunity for new grads and early-career engineers who want real ownership on security-critical systems. You'll help solve problems like:. How do we roll out post-quantum cryptography across the backup data path before it's an industry requirement?. How do we let customers manage sessions and access against compromise, at enterprise scale?. How do we build an access control engine that holds up against dynamic, customer-defined policies unique to a data management platform?. How do we secure the AI agents and agentic developer workflows that are now embedded in how Rubrik engineers ship code?. You'll work alongside experienced engineers and deeply technical managers who will mentor you as you grow, on a roadmap with genuine business impact.. What You'll Do. Security feature development. Design and steer AI to write clean, well-tested code in Go, Scala, or Python for scalable, secure platform services. Collaborate with senior engineers on system design and architecture decisions. Identify attack surfaces and build solutions to harden Rubrik products. Triage, debug, and drive product/system issues to resolution with clear ownership. Use AI coding assistants and agentic workflows as a core part of your daily engineering, while learning to treat AI-generated code as untrusted input that gets the same security scrutiny as any other contribution. Security code and design reviews. Review code and design docs from other teams to flag security concerns before they ship. Help extend our review practices to cover AI-powered features and AI agents as they become part of Rubrik's product surface. Contribute to secure coding guidelines and evangelize them across engineering. Team collaboration. Partner with Product Management, UI/UX, docs, InfoSec, and support to turn security requirements into shipped features. Participate in planning, design reviews, and knowledge sharing.. How We Build and Secure with AI. AI isn't a side note for this team, it's part of the job on both sides:. As builders: you'll use AI coding assistants and agentic tools as part of your normal workflow, the same way the rest of Rubrik engineering does. As security engineers: you'll help define what "secure" means for AI-generated code, AI-powered features, and autonomous agents acting inside Rubrik's infrastructure, an active, fast-moving part of our roadmap.. What We're Looking For. Required. Bachelor's degree in CS, Software Engineering, or related field, or equivalent practical experience. 0-2 years of software development experience (internships, personal projects, and bootcamps count). Strong fundamentals in at least one language (Go, Java, Python, C++, or similar) and in data structures, algorithms, and testing. Genuine interest in security, curious about how systems break and motivated to build things that don't. A proactive, self-directed learning style; comfortable asking questions and diving into ambiguity.. Preferred. Coursework, personal projects, or internships in cybersecurity, cryptography, or systems security. Comfort with Linux/Unix, Git, and basic networking (TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS, DNS). Exposure to cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, GCP). Hands-on experience with AI coding assistants or agentic dev tools (Claude Code, Copilot, or similar). Interest in open-source security tooling or the broader security community. What Makes a Great Candidate. Beyond the qualifications above, the traits that predict success on this team:. Thinks critically - can analyze problems and reason through potential security implications, not just implement what's asked. Collaborates well - enjoys working with others and learning from teammates across disciplines. Pays attention to detail - understands that small details matter in security.. Growth & Mentorship. You'll be paired with senior engineers who invest directly in your growth. Over time, expect to build real depth in:. Applied cryptography, secure protocol design, and threat modeling. Distributed systems, API design, and system-level security testing. Security code review - spotting vulnerability patterns in both human- and AI-written code. Technical communication, documentation, and (as you grow) mentoring others yourself.. We back this with a dedicated mentorship program, regular tech talks and learning sessions, and support for security conferences and training. Why Join Shield Platform?. The best entry point into security engineering we know of: direct ownership on mission-critical production systems that safeguard Fortune 500 enterprises and critical infrastructure worldwide , mentorship from veteran security architects, and a forward-looking roadmap spanning post-quantum cryptography to AI agent security that puts you at the absolute forefront of enterprise security engineering.. title: Sr Finance Manager, GTM
description: We are currently hiring for 2 Sr Finance Manager roles. These roles sit at the center of a fast-scaling GTM org on an AI-native transformation journey. You'll be expected to keep pace with rapid growth, bring order to ambiguity, and continuously challenge how the finance function operates - not just run the existing playbook. Reporting to the Director of Finance, one role will own and drive the business partnering for Americas and PLS sales organizations and the other will be focused on the presales and Alliances organizations delivering RoI framework, strategic insights and other financial reporting. We are looking for an AI-native leader who treats AI as a default part of their workflow - automating recurring reporting, building self-serve analytics, and using LLM-based tools to move faster and go deeper than a traditional finance function.Their work will have high visibility and impact on senior leadership at Rubrik. These positions will be based in Palo Alto, California and will require in-office attendance 3 days a week. Responsibilities. Global ACV, Opex and RoI Insights - deliver monthly presentations and drive strategic recommendations related to:. Impact of Productivity, Attrition and Hiring on ACV Plan/Quota. Observed RoI in various sales segments based on all direct/indirect costs supporting those segments. Effectiveness of the Product Sales Teams across each product-line. Business Partnering with Americas Sales and Global Product Sales. A trusted business and analytical partner to Sales and Finance leaders - translates data into clear recommendations and influences decisions, not just reports on them. Construct & present monthly and quarterly review of Americas Sales, Global Product Sales, and its supporting organizations to Sales and Finance Executive Leaders. title: Staff Cloud Security Architect
description: About the team. The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information. About the role. The Staff Cloud Security Architect will serve as a critical subject matter expert, responsible for defining, designing, and implementing secure cloud architectures and solutions across our enterprise environments. As a key technical leader, you will collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams across Rubrik to integrate security across all aspects of cloud deployment, operations, and management. Your strategic insights will help shape cloud security strategies, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Your deep technical expertise, ability to influence, build and establish best practices, and thought leadership will ensure the secure enablement of our cloud technologies across our hybrid and public cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role, and you will be expected to rely on your extensive cloud expertise to make an immediate impact on existing and new initiatives. What you'll do. Define and implement cloud security architecture frameworks, principles, and guidelines to secure enterprise cloud environments and workloads. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure security maturity initiatives are prioritized effectively and addressed in a timely and sustainable manner. Partner with cloud security architects, developers, and engineers to design scalable solutions addressing complex infrastructure-related security challenges. Design, build proof of concept, tools, and platforms to proactively address and resolve security issues at scale. Conduct architecture reviews, security assessments, threat modeling, and risk analysis of cloud-native services and infrastructure. Establish secure reference architectures, reusable cloud security patterns, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency in cloud deployments at scale. Lead efforts related to strategic planning and continuous improvement of cloud security capabilities, including public cloud native security products and third-party cloud security tools. Partner with incident response teams and SOC analysts to ensure effective processes and technology are in place to quickly detect, investigate, and mitigate cloud security incidents. Experience you'll need. Bachelor's or Master's degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related fields. 15+ Years of experience securing complex on-prem or cloud deployments with a minimum of 6+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security architecture and design, including significant experience across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure environments. Deep technical understanding of core cloud service models, including compute, network, and storage technologies on AWS, GCP, and/or Azure platforms. Proficiency in at least one programming language or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Java for automating and managing security tools and processes. Extensive working experience with containerized applications (Kubernetes, Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architectures. 5+ years of experience with IAC (Infrastructure as a Code) deployments for complex systems [Terraform, Ansible etc]. Demonstrated expertise in articulating complex technical issues clearly to both security specialists and non-technical stakeholders. Additional skills. Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaborations and drive technical security initiatives. description: Staff Platform Product Manager, Cloud Security Architecture. Location: Palo Alto, CA (also open to other locations). The Staff Product Manager for Cloud Security Architecture is a strategic role responsible for ensuring that Rubrik's cloud product offerings meet enterprise expectations for security and are secured from cyber-attacks. This technical role combines deep security expertise with strong product instincts and competitor awareness to translate customers' security challenges and concerns into actionable product requirements for Rubrik's cloud product and cloud platform security roadmap. Our product stands on a foundation of "Zero Trust" security and this role is critical in driving the long-term security vision and roadmap with a focus on identifying product gaps, market opportunities, developing long-term strategic plans, and implementing enhancements that drive industry-leading security standards and best practices into Rubrik products. Specific Responsibilities:. Works closely with cloud product and engineering teams to develop a deep understanding of the Rubrik cloud product architecture. Ability to articulate and defend our architectural decisions cross functionally and to customers. Contribute to cloud product and cloud platform security roadmap and execute for multiple, related security domains within the Rubrik offering, ensuring alignment and coherence across the portfolio. Scan and keep abreast ofcustomer expectations and evolving hyperscaler best practices. Act as a primary evangelist for the cloud product security and work with customers and account teams to define and evolve the roadmap across multiple dimensions (UX, technology, business) and deliver commercially viable security features and integrations across the Rubrik cloud portfolio. Lead cross-functional strategic initiatives and manage the execution across all cloud products, ensuring they meet platform security standards. Lead and develop product risk identification, assessment, and resolution prioritization for high-impact platform vulnerabilities. Partner with and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders-including InfoSec, Engineering, User Experience, Sales, Marketing, Operations, and Support-to align vision across business units and secure project approval and resources. Communicate concisely and clearly to diverse audiences, including presenting compelling business cases to executive leadership and representing Rubrik as a security expert to external audiences, customers, and ecosystem partners. Drive significant business impact by identifying market opportunities and leading new product developments that contribute measurable increases to quarterly revenue, profitability, and customer trust. Act as a mentor and role model for other Product Managers, sharing best practices, driving clarity in the face of ambiguity cross-functionally, and fostering strong partnerships with engineering teams. Required Skills:. Experience or desire to be in Product Management, with at least 3 years focused on enterprise cloud product development with hyperscalers, ideally in a hands-on technical or architecture role. Prior experience as a Security Architect, Solutions Architect, or Senior/Staff Engineer is highly desirable. Expertise in cloud security and threat modeling and working knowledge of big 3 hyperscalers with specific experience in cloud security posture management or secure cloud integration and defining secure architectures for solutions built on hyperscaler infrastructure. Practical experience with API security, microservices architecture, and container security (e.g., Kubernetes). Demonstrated success in owning and managing the strategy and execution of multiple, high-impact products simultaneously, leveraging a deep understanding of the underlying technology stack. Proven ability to define, scope, and deliver large, complex features, leveraging deep technical acumen to define architecture, requirements, and measurable KPIs/goals while engaging effectively with cross-functional teams. Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to clearly articulate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences. Experience in the following security domains:. Zero Trust architecture and security principles, including experience translating those principles into product requirements. Authentication and authorization (SSO, SAML, OpenID, RBAC), for both human and non-human (API) actions. Data protection, immutable storage, and encryption technologies, including understanding of cryptographic primitives and key management architectures. Bachelor's degree in a technical field (e.g., Computer Science, Engineering) or equivalent work experience; advanced degree and/or relevant cybersecurity certifications (e.g., CCSP, CISSP, CCSK) highly desired. title: Staff Product Manager, IT - GTM
description: About the team:. Rubrik secures and accelerates the world's AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, we're again defining what comes next, and Rubrik IT's job is to prove it on Rubrik itself. We're building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision.We want AI practitioners who know B2B go-to-market from the inside, whether you've built it across a scaled enterprise or inside the Salesforce platform. You're ready to move the work itself, from manual and judgment-heavy to agent-run and agent-assisted. About the role:. You'll own GTM AI end to end and are accountable for its outcomes, building agents and internal products that carry the work in production alongside GTM leaders, engineers, and sellers. You don't just use tools. You treat AI as a high-trust collaborator, core to how you solve problems. You're low-ego, thrive in fast-moving environments, and test emerging capabilities to find simpler, more powerful ways to deliver. What you'll do:. Define the vision, strategy, and roadmap for AI-powered products that support the end-to-end seller journey. Conduct thorough needs assessments, gather requirements from sellers and stakeholders, and use data-driven insights to prioritize AI/ML features with the highest ROI and business impact. Ship agents and AI tools in production that lift seller productivity across account planning, pipeline, prospecting, acquisition, and relationship management. Prototype quickly with AI tools, validating logic and data flows before engineering engages. Partner with Engineers, AI architects and sales operations to turn models into scalable products, and with Enablement to drive adoption. Stay current with the latest trends in AI/ML, B2B sales technology, and the competitive landscape to identify new digital product opportunities. How you operate. You can pitch, and you unblock. You walk into a room of Sales, and CX leaders, sell the bet on the product and why it matters, and walk out with alignment. You resolve misalignment up to exec-level partners, communicate with no ambiguity, and remove blockers for the people around you, not just yourself. You understand how revenue actually moves across CRM (Salesforce), PRM, CPQ, and billing, and how sellers and CX teams work minute to minute. That domain fluency is what you pour into the agents. You think from first principles and challenge the status quo. You look at a legacy process, ask why it exists at all, and build the thing that replaces it. You're data-savvy by reflex. You don't wait for a dashboard; you go into the data yourself, find where the deal cycle leaks, and let the numbers frame the argument. You read pipeline velocity, close rates, and escalation paths the way a good rep reads a room. Experience you'll need:. 8+ years across product management, building and managing GTM systems in enterprise, or a body of work that speaks louder than the year count. A track record of shipping production AI/ML products, both generative and agentic, knowing where the model earned its keep and where it didn't. Real transformation at scale in fast-moving environments, with impact you can point to in revenue operations. Strong understanding of the B2B sales process, seller pain points, and the technology ecosystem that supports them (e.g., Salesforce, Clari, CPQ). Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to to pitch product strategy to Executive leadership(including C-Suite). title: Staff Software Engineer - Reliability (US Citizen Only)
description: About Team & About Role. The Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) team at Rubrik ensures the absolute reliability, availability, performance, and security of our enterprise infrastructure services, spanning both global SaaS platforms and government-compliant environments. We operate at the intersection of software development and systems engineering, prioritizing hyperscale platform automation, self-healing architectures, and structural resiliency. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will serve as a primary technical leader and architect across our broader distributed cloud systems. You will drive long-term technical roadmaps, establish cross-organizational reliability standards, and solve complex distributed systems challenges that safeguard both enterprise and public sector environments. Beyond the core SRE charter, this Staff role also leads the Application-SRE team - a US-based group that partners closely with engineering, Sales, and Support to unblock POCs, drive complex customer escalations to resolution, and convert recurring field signals into engineering and reliability roadmap items. You will be the technical leader and project owner for Application-SRE: setting direction, tracking commitments, and ensuring the team operates as a high-leverage bridge between the field and the broader engineering org.. What You'll Do. As a Staff Site Reliability Engineer, you will possess engineering-wide influence and take ownership of the following critical areas:. Infrastructure Strategy & Architecture: Formulate and execute the architectural vision for Rubrik's Cloud Platform, optimizing backend infrastructure systems like Kubernetes, MySQL, and cloud-native services for performance, security, and multi-region scale. Hyperscale Automation & Platform Tooling: Build, scale, and maintain sophisticated custom internal tools, platform controllers, and automation frameworks in Go or Python to systematically eliminate operational toil. AI Infrastructure for SaaS: Deploy, scale, and operate the AI infrastructure that powers Rubrik's SaaS offerings, owning the reliability, performance, cost, and security controls required to run AI workloads in multi-tenant, compliance-bound environments. AI for SRE & Engineering Productivity : Drive the adoption of AI-driven solutions across the SRE charter to compress toil and multiply the org - applying agentic and LLM-based approaches to automated triage, incident response, operational analysis, and developer productivity. AI Adoption Guardrails for SaaS Reliability : Build the guardrails, controls, and platform patterns that keep Rubrik's SaaS reliable as AI adoption accelerates across product and engineering, ensuring new AI capabilities ship without eroding availability, performance, security, or cost posture. Cross-Functional Leadership: Wield engineering-wide influence to create technical consensus among component, platform, and security engineering teams, effectively "shifting left" to embed structural resilience, capacity guards, and compliance from initial feature designs. Reliability Governance: Define, audit, and enforce robust Service Level Indicators (SLIs), Service Level Objectives (SLOs), and Error Budgets across all critical enterprise platform services, translating telemetry insights into actionable product roadmaps during executive reviews. Incident Command & Operations Review: Serve as a primary Incident Commander for high-severity cloud outages, establishing roles, directing mitigation vectors under pressure, and orchestrating comprehensive, blameless post-mortems that drive durable systemic fixes. Cost Governance & Capacity Modeling: Architect cost-observability tools and attribution frameworks, leading cloud infrastructure capacity forecasting, resource quota optimization, and vendor SLA management. Application-SRE Leadership : Set the technical direction for the Application-SRE team, raising the bar on how the team diagnoses, mitigates, and durably resolves the most complex customer-impacting issues across our platform. Technical Multiplier & Mentorship: Champion SRE best practices, mentoring senior and junior individual contributors across the organization, participating in interview frameworks, and actively raising the collective technical bar. On-Call Rotations: Participate in on-call rotations. Experience You'll Need. Citizenship & Residency: Must be a US Citizen currently residing on CONUS soil (strict regulatory requirement to enable support for federal and FedRAMP environments when required). Education: BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a highly related technical discipline. Industry Experience: A minimum of 8-12+ years of software engineering and production cloud infrastructure experience, with at least 5+ years dedicated to a formal SRE, DevOps, or Platform engineering role operating hyperscale SaaS products. Technical Depth: Comprehensive, hands-on programming expertise in Golang, Python, or Java with a deep grasp of concurrency models, data structures, and test-driven software design patterns. Distributed Systems Expertise: Proven proficiency designing, deploying, analyzing, and auditing complex, large-scale distributed systems, database topologies, and high-availability public cloud meshes. Systems Internals: Authoritative operational command of Unix/Linux operating system environments (process models, file systems, kernels), systems administration, and advanced L4/L7 networking protocols. AI Systems Fluency : Working knowledge of operating AI systems in production - including model serving, cost trade-offs, and the reliability and safety considerations of LLM- and agent-based workloads. Practical judgment on when AI is the right tool versus deterministic automation. Field-to-Product Feedback Loop : Institutionalize the channel that converts patterns from customer escalations and POCs into prioritized product and reliability feedback, partnering directly with Product, Sales Engineering and Support leadership. Customer & Field Fluency : Track record of partnering directly with Sales, Support, and customers on escalations and POCs, and translating field signals into engineering action. Leadership Capability: Demonstrated history of technical leadership, mapping architectural dependencies, managing multi-team technical projects, and guiding organizations through critical platform shifts with high technical judgment. Preferred Qualifications. Extensive production experience provisioning, lifecycle-managing, and recovering enterprise-scale Kubernetes (GKE, EKS) deployments and large-scale relational/non-relational databases (MySQL). Prior experience building, certifying, or auditing infrastructure environments under compliance structures such as FedRAMP (High/Moderate), SOC 2, ISO 27001, or CJIS. Fluency in Infrastructure-as-Code (Terraform, Pulumi) module design, multi-tenant state isolation, and enterprise observability fabrics (Prometheus, Grafana, OpenTelemetry). Exposure to building AI- or LLM-powered internal tooling and applying it to SRE, operations, or engineering productivity use cases. Familiarity with the operational considerations of running AI workloads on cloud and Kubernetes platforms. The regular hours for this position are day shift. . Job Description:. The New Product Introduction (NPI) Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) Coordinator is the primary operational link between Engineering, the Integration Team, and Manufacturing during the introduction of new products and first articles. The role owns the coordination and accurate setup of new products in PROMIS, Agile, Oracle, and related factory applications; drives the cross-functional readiness and factory-acceptance process; supports engineers in converting technical requirements into executable manufacturing flows and documentation; and trains the Manufacturing organization before product release. You will be responsible for managing system configuration, troubleshooting IT issues, and supporting the implementation of MES solutions. . Key Responsibilities:. . Factory Application and Product Setup. Own the end-to-end creation, maintenance, validation, and release of new-product and first-article setup in PROMIS, Agile, Oracle, and other manufacturing applications. Receive new-product introductions from the business unit and coordinate the initial review of existing designs, demand, product requirements, and source-factory information. Coordinate the creation and validation of manufacturing routings, operation sequences, part numbers, bills of material, product structures, revision levels, and supporting master data. Work with Process and Equipment Engineering by manufacturing area to define process steps, equipment requirements, toolsets, recipes, and required controls before creating the factory flow. Verify that each manufacturing operation references the correct work instruction, drawing, specification, recipe, material, tooling, inspection, and quality requirement. Coordinate required application changes with Engineering, Planning, Quality, Supply Chain, IT/Business Systems, and Manufacturing. Deliver high-level training and support end users, ensuring they are equipped to fully leverage the MES system. Serve as the Manufacturing interface with IT and business-system owners for PROMIS, Xsite, INFICON, and other systems needed to execute and monitor the product flow. Perform readiness checks and resolve or escalate system and data gaps before first-article or production execution. Maintain configuration alignment across PROMIS, Agile, Oracle, released engineering documentation, and the approved factory flow. . NPI Coordination and Factory Readiness. Coordinate the cross-functional introduction of new products from initial planning through first article, learning cycles, and manufacturing release. Develop and maintain NPI readiness plans, milestones, action registers, risk lists, and launch schedules. Facilitate NPI readiness reviews and ensure clear ownership, due dates, follow-up, and escalation of open actions. Coordinate design-for-manufacturability review and confirm that requirements are addressed before material is run. Lead the preliminary review and secure formal factory acceptance of the proposed product flow before first-article material is released. Confirm readiness of applications, materials, tooling, equipment, documentation, quality requirements, production controls, and trained personnel before execution. Coordinate first-article builds, learning cycles, and early production activity; document issues, decisions, and lessons learned and drive actions to closure. Finalize and release the approved PROMIS flow after factory acceptance and completion of required changes. Provide clear status communication to functional leaders and stakeholders. . Product Data and Material Readiness. Coordinate new-product bill-of-material introduction and ensure required components, consumables, and materials are identified before execution. Coordinate material changes and verify that approved revisions are reflected consistently in Oracle, Agile, PROMIS, work instructions, and production planning. Track material-readiness risks and escalate shortages, master-data gaps, or ordering constraints that could delay first articles or production release. . Engineering and Documentation Support. Assist engineers in preparing, formatting, routing, and releasing manufacturing work instructions and supporting documentation. Translate released engineering requirements into clear, operator-ready execution steps while preserving engineering ownership of technical content and approval. Coordinate reviews to ensure work instructions accurately reflect process sequence, recipes, materials, tooling, safety requirements, inspection criteria, queue-time limits, and reaction plans. Identify inconsistencies among engineering specifications, application data, work instructions, and actual factory execution and coordinate correction. Support document and configuration change control throughout NPI and production release. . Manufacturing Training and Launch Support. Develop and coordinate training plans for manufacturing supervisors, technicians, and operators prior to product release. Train the Manufacturing organization on new-product flows, application transactions, work instructions, documentation requirements, and critical quality expectations. Partner with Engineering and subject-matter experts to ensure technical training content is accurate and complete. Maintain training materials, attendance records, qualification checklists, and completion status. Provide hands-on floor support during first articles, learning cycles, and early production until the product is transferred to routine manufacturing ownership. Gather operator feedback and coordinate improvements to documentation, systems, and training. . Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:. Bachelor's degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology or related field, or equivalent experience. Experience in IT, PROMIS systems, or a related industry, with hands-on experience using PROMIS MES systems. Experience creating or maintaining product data, manufacturing routings, bills of material, work instructions, or factory master data. Demonstrated ability to coordinate work across multiple functions and drive actions to completion without direct authority. Strong attention to detail, organization, follow-through, written communication, and verbal communication. Ability to understand technical information and translate it into clear manufacturing execution and training content. Ability to work effectively with engineers, technicians, supervisors, operators, planners, quality personnel, and business-system teams. Experience with PROMIS or another manufacturing execution system (MES). Experience with Agile PLM, Oracle ERP, or comparable product-lifecycle and enterprise-resource systems. Experience with Xsite, INFICON, or comparable factory monitoring and manufacturing support applications. Experience supporting first articles, engineering builds, product transfers, or factory launches. Experience in semiconductor, probe-card, electronics, medical-device, aerospace, or another controlled manufacturing environment. Experience developing or delivering manufacturing training. Working knowledge of configuration control, engineering change control, quality systems, and document-release processes. . Farmers Branch, TX. The regular hours for this position are day shift. . Job Description:. The Incoming Quality Technician performs incoming quality inspection of printed circuit boards (PCBs), PCB substrates, wafers, mechanical components, and electrical parts to verify conformance to engineering drawings, specifications, quality standards, and documented inspection requirements. . Working in a laboratory or controlled inspection environment, this role independently conducts visual, dimensional, and basic electrical inspections using precision metrology tools, microscopes, electrical test equipment, and inspection systems. The technician identifies and documents defects, maintains traceable inspection records, and supports containment of nonconforming material. . The position partners with Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, and related functions to communicate inspection results, escalate quality concerns, support material disposition, and provide accurate data for supplier and process improvement activities. . Key Responsibilities :. Perform incoming inspection of PCBs, PCB substrates, wafers, mechanical parts, electrical components, and other critical materials using approved procedures, drawings, specifications, and sampling plans. Conduct visual inspections for scratches, cracks, delamination, corrosion, voids, contamination, cosmetic nonconformances, and PCB/SMT workmanship defects, including tombstoned components; cold, bridged, cracked, or disturbed solder joints; excess or insufficient solder; solder icicles or spikes; lifted pads; land damage; and conductor nicks, cuts, or thinning. Use low- and high-magnification microscopy to inspect bonding pads, traces, vias, and surface features for conditions such as annular ring breakout, delamination or blistering, over- or under-etching, via plating voids, PCB warpage, component misalignment, solder balls, and solder splatter. Perform mechanical and dimensional inspections with calibrated measurement tools; compare results with engineering drawings, tolerances, and acceptance criteria. Perform basic electrical checks using oscilloscopes, digital multimeters, power supplies, and related test equipment to verify voltage, frequency, continuity, and specified circuit-board test points. Review Certificates of Conformance, inspection reports, drawings, and other incoming documentation for completeness, traceability, and compliance with requirements. Record inspection results accurately, capture clear defect images, and maintain required data and material traceability in applicable quality systems. Identify, segregate, and escalate nonconforming material; initiate NCMRs or related records and support Quality Engineering with containment and disposition activities. Communicate inspection findings and recurring defect trends to Quality Engineering, Supplier Quality, Manufacturing, and other stakeholders. Support updates to inspection methods, work instructions, defect standards, and continuous improvement activities under guidance from Quality Engineering. . Preferred Qualifications & Experience:. High school diploma or equivalent required; associate degree or technical certification in electronics, metrology, manufacturing, quality, or a related discipline preferred. Two to four years of relevant quality experience in incoming inspection, quality inspection, or a comparable role within electronics, semiconductor, or high-precision manufacturing. Demonstrated experience inspecting PCBs, PCB substrates, wafers, precision mechanical components, and/or electrical components using the tools and methods described in this posting. Experience with nonconforming material documentation, inspection data entry, defect imaging, and material traceability. Experience working as an electronics technician, quality technician, inspector, or technician assistant is beneficial. An equivalent combination of relevant education, technical training, and experience will be considered. . Skills:. Calipers, Cleanroom Operations, Communication, Defect Identification, Detail-Oriented, Dial Indicators, Electrical Testing Equipments, Interpret Engineering Drawings, Materials Control, Micrometers, Microscope, Quality Inspections. . Education & Experience:. Minimum of 2 - 4 years of related experience | Required. . FormFactor Benefits:. Benefits offered for this role include medical, dental, vision, EAP, short-term and long-term disability, life insurance, flexible spending and savings accounts, 401(k), ESPP and paid time off. . The Sr. Staff Reliability Engineer provides recognized technical leadership in reliability engineering, failure analysis, product qualification, and process quality assurance. Operating as a subject matter expert, this role leads complex technical investigations, develops reliability strategies for advanced semiconductor and MEMS technologies, and influences product and process decisions across multiple engineering disciplines.. This individual independently drives high-impact initiatives that improve product robustness, accelerate new product introductions, enhance failure analysis capabilities, and support long-term reliability and quality objectives. The regular hours for this position are Thursday, Friday, Saturday and every other Wednesday from 6:00am to 6:15pm. . Job Description:. The Manufacturing Technician 3 is responsible for performing advanced manufacturing and assembly tasks in a cleanroom environment, ensuring strict adherence to safety, quality, and production standards. This role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a shift team to meet daily production goals.. . Key Responsibilities:. . Safety & Quality Compliance. Maintain strict adherence to all safety protocols and quality standards within the manufacturing area.. Follow cleanroom procedures and ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) guidelines.. . Assembly & Mechanical Work. Perform mechanical assembly of stiffeners, PCBAs, interposers, and associated hardware and electrical components.. Execute mechanical adjustments using hand tools, tweezers, dial indicators, handheld digital meters, torque verification, and microscopes.. Read and follow detailed mechanical work instructions and engineering documentation.. . Testing & Troubleshooting. Set up testers for electrical testing and conduct electronic casualty analysis of probe cards.. Perform adjustments to probe cards to achieve planarity (flatness) of the array.. Conduct microscope inspections of components and hardware.. Apply knowledge of electronic theory and components to resolve test failures.. Perform basic troubleshooting down to component level using ohm/cap/voltage meters.. . Data Analysis & Documentation. Perform data analysis and understand SPC (Statistical Process Control) processes for all processing steps.. Record and enter test results accurately into designated systems.. . Collaboration & Production Support. Work within a shift team to support operations and engineering tasks.. Contribute as an individual to meet daily production quotas.. . Work Environment & Physical Requirements:. Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components. . Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures. . May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment. . Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time. . Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs. . . . . . . Skills:. Circuit Analysis, Data Acquisition Software, Electrical Schematics, Electronic Circuitry, Materials Handling, Mechanical Assemblies, Mechanical CAD, Metrology Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Time Management. . Education & Experience:. Minimum of 2 - 4 years of related experience | Required. . Pay Range:. $25.80 - $33.86. . Pay Range Explained:. (NASDAQ: FORM), is a leading provider of essential test and measurement technologies along the full semiconductor product life cycle - from characterization, modeling, reliability, and design de-bug, to qualification and production test. Semiconductor companies rely upon FormFactor's products and services to accelerate profitability by optimizing device performance and advancing yield knowledge. The company serves customers through its network of facilities in Asia, Europe, and North America. . Rooted in our core values - Focus on the Customer, Ownership & Accountability, Respectfully & Effectively Communicate, and Motivate & Develop People - we foster an environment where diverse perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated. Everyone can make an impact here. Whether it's improving products, supporting customers, or positively influencing peers and the community, the contributions of our people matter.. . Shift:. The regular hours for this position are Sunday, Monday, Tuesday and every other Saturday from 6:00pm to 6:15am. You will receive a 15% shift differential for working on the night shift. . Job Description:. The Manufacturing Technician 3 is responsible for performing advanced manufacturing and assembly tasks in a cleanroom environment, ensuring strict adherence to safety, quality, and production standards. This role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work both independently and collaboratively within a shift team to meet daily production goals.. . Key Responsibilities:. . Safety & Quality Compliance. Maintain strict adherence to all safety protocols and quality standards within the manufacturing area.. Follow cleanroom procedures and ESD (Electrostatic Discharge) guidelines.. . Assembly & Mechanical Work. Perform mechanical assembly of stiffeners, PCBAs, interposers, and associated hardware and electrical components.. Execute mechanical adjustments using hand tools, tweezers, dial indicators, handheld digital meters, torque verification, and microscopes.. Read and follow detailed mechanical work instructions and engineering documentation.. . Testing & Troubleshooting. Set up testers for electrical testing and conduct electronic casualty analysis of probe cards.. Perform adjustments to probe cards to achieve planarity (flatness) of the array.. Conduct microscope inspections of components and hardware.. Apply knowledge of electronic theory and components to resolve test failures.. Perform basic troubleshooting down to component level using ohm/cap/voltage meters.. . Data Analysis & Documentation. Perform data analysis and understand SPC (Statistical Process Control) processes for all processing steps.. Record and enter test results accurately into designated systems.. . Collaboration & Production Support. Work within a shift team to support operations and engineering tasks.. Contribute as an individual to meet daily production quotas.. . Work Environment & Physical Requirements:. Role may involve frequent standing, repetitive hand motions, and handling small or delicate components. . Work performed primarily in a clean‑room manufacturing setting, requiring adherence to gowning and contamination‑control procedures. . May require exposure to chemicals, specialty tools, microscopes, or precision measurement equipment. . Must follow all required safety protocols, wear appropriate PPE and clean‑room attire (full coverall suit, hairnet, mask, gloves, etc.) for extended periods of time. . Must be able to lift up to 30 lbs. . . . . . . Skills:. Circuit Analysis, Data Acquisition Software, Electrical Schematics, Electronic Circuitry, Materials Handling, Mechanical Assemblies, Mechanical CAD, Metrology Equipment, Semiconductor Manufacturing, Time Management. . Education & Experience:. Minimum of 2 - 4 years of related experience | Required. . Pay Range:. $25.80 - $33.86. . Pay Range Explained:. This role in Livermore, California pays between $25.80 and $33.86 per hour, depending on your experience, skills, and background. Pay may vary in other locations. We offer a full benefits package, including medical, dental, vision, life insurance, disability coverage, a 401(k) with company match, employee stock purchase plan (ESPP), and paid time off. You'll also be eligible for quarterly profit-sharing bonuses and flexible spending or savings accounts. . Equal Employment Opportunity Statement. FormFactor is an equal opportunity employer. The regular hours for this position are day shift. . Job Description:. FormFactor is seeking a Senior Principal Applications Engineer / Technical Lead to serve as a senior customer-facing technical leader supporting strategic semiconductor customers and advanced wafer probe solutions.. This role is responsible for driving customer success across the entire customer lifecycle, from early technology evaluation through qualification, deployment, production release, High Volume Manufacturing (HVM), and long-term production support. The position is a key element of FormFactor's evolving Customer Solutions Team , focused on improving the end-to-end customer experience, increasing customer intimacy, and accelerating adoption of FormFactor technologies. The successful candidate will be recognized as a technical authority in semiconductor test and characterization and will work closely with customers, Engineering, Product Management, Marketing, Service, and Sales to support advanced applications including Silicon Photonics (SiPh), Co-Packaged Optics (CPO), AI/HPC, Advanced Packaging, Memory, Foundry, Logic, RF, and High-Speed Digital technologies.. This individual must excel in highly complex and ambiguous situations, provide leadership during customer escalations, and independently drive cross-functional teams to resolution while serving as a trusted advisor to strategic customers.. Key Responsibilities:. . Strategic Customer Leadership. Serve as the primary technical advisor for strategic semiconductor customers.. Build trusted relationships with customer engineering, manufacturing, operations, and executive teams.. Lead customer engagements from evaluation through qualification, production release, and HVM ramp.. Conduct on-site customer technical reviews, production readiness reviews, roadmap discussions, and executive briefings.. Present FormFactor's technology roadmap, product capabilities, and application solutions to customers and industry stakeholders.. Support product demonstrations, benchmarking activities, acceptance testing, and customer evaluations.. Partner with customers to improve yield, throughput, measurement accuracy, and manufacturing productivity.. Act as the senior technical escalation point for business-critical customer issues.. . Applications Engineering Leadership. Develop and deploy advanced application methodologies for semiconductor probe and test solutions.. Support electrical, parametric, RF, optical, photonics, and high-speed device characterization.. Drive successful adoption of new products and advanced technologies.. Develop technical documentation, application notes, best practices, and customer training materials.. Analyze customer application challenges and recommend optimized solutions.. Support beta evaluations, technology transfers, qualification programs, and production ramps.. . Technical Leadership. Serve as a recognized subject matter expert in semiconductor test, wafer probing, and device characterization.. Lead complex root cause investigations involving product, process, applications, and manufacturing issues.. Provide technical leadership across Applications, Engineering, Product Management, Service, and Manufacturing teams.. Mentor and coach Applications Engineers and other technical team members.. Establish best practices and drive knowledge sharing across global organizations.. Influence technical direction and contribute to the development of future customer solutions.. . Leadership in Ambiguous Environments. Lead cross-functional teams in highly dynamic and ambiguous situations where ownership, requirements, or technical direction may not be fully defined.. Drive clarity, accountability, and execution during customer escalations and critical business situations.. Balance customer requirements, business priorities, and technical constraints to achieve successful outcomes.. Make sound technical and business decisions under pressure and with limited information.. Create momentum and organizational alignment when addressing high-impact customer challenges.. . Product & Market Leadership. Serve as the Voice of Customer to Product Management and Engineering organizations.. Identify emerging technology trends and customer requirements.. Influence product roadmaps through customer feedback and market insights.. Support strategic growth initiatives in Silicon Photonics, Co-Packaged Optics, AI/HPC, Foundry, Memory, and Advanced Packaging markets.. Assist Sales and Business Development teams with technical strategy and growth opportunities.. . Preferred Qualifications & Experiences:. Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Physics, Photonics, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical discipline.. Experience in semiconductor test, semiconductor capital equipment, probe card technologies, wafer probe systems, device characterization, or related fields.. Demonstrated success supporting strategic semiconductor customers in both development and production environments.. Proven ability to lead complex technical engagements and customer escalations.. Strong communication and presentation skills with the ability to communicate effectively at both engineering and executive levels.. Ability to travel domestically and internationally as required.. . Preferred Technical Experience:. Automated Test Equipment (ATE). Wafer Probe Systems. Probe Cards. Semiconductor Test. Device Characterization. Parametric Test. Wafer Sort. Production Test. RF and Microwave Measurements. High-Speed Digital Testing. Signal Integrity. Silicon Photonics. Optical Characterization. Co-Packaged Optics (CPO). Advanced Packaging. Heterogeneous Integration. Yield Improvement. Product Qualification. New Product Introduction (NPI). Failure Analysis. High Volume Manufacturing (HVM). . Success Profile:. The Senior Principal Applications Engineer / Technical Lead is a highly visible technical leader responsible for strengthening customer intimacy, improving the customer experience, accelerating technology adoption, and enabling successful production ramps at strategic semiconductor customers.. Success in this role requires deep semiconductor test expertise, strong business acumen, exceptional customer-facing capabilities, and the ability to lead organizations through complex and ambiguous situations. The individual will serve as a cornerstone of FormFactor's Customer Solutions Team and will directly contribute to customer satisfaction, market share growth, and the successful expansion of FormFactor's Silicon Photonics and advanced semiconductor business.. . Skills:. Automated Test Equipment (ATE), Automated Test Equipment (ATE), Business Acumen, Cross-Functional Leadership, Data Analytics, Decision Making, Escalation Management, Executive Communications, High Volume Manufacturing, JMP Scripting Language (JSL), MATLAB, Mentorship, Probe Cards, Process Optimization, Python (Programming Language), RF Testing, Risk Management, Root Cause Analysis (RCA), Semiconductor Manufacturing, Semiconductor Testers, Signal Integrity, Silicon Photonics, Strategic Customer Management, Strategic Thinking, Technical Leadership {+ 1 more}. .
