title: Field Engineer: Cryogenics & RF Hardware
description: About Rigetti. Rigetti Computing is building the world's most powerful computers to help solve humanity's most pressing problems. Our quantum computing technology has the potential to transform nearly every industry over the coming decades. As a public company with deep roots in research and engineering, we are expanding our Engineering Operations team to support rapid advances in quantum hardware. Role Overview. We are seeking an experienced Cryogenics and RF Field Engineer to support Rigetti systems deployed at customer facilities around the world. This is a hands-on, operations-focused role that travels to customer sites globally, working closely with both Rigetti teams and customer stakeholders in a highly collaborative, research-driven environment. The role is not tied to a single site - you'll be deployed to wherever Rigetti systems are installed, with assignments varying in length and location based on program needs. In this role, you will work closely with physicists, engineers, and technicians to operate, maintain, and troubleshoot advanced RF and cryogenic systems that enable next-generation quantum processors. You will be responsible for ensuring reliable system performance in a production-like environment, including direct ownership of cryogenic infrastructure, RF hardware validation, and rapid debugging of complex, cross-disciplinary issues spanning RF, vacuum, cryogenics, and electronics. The ideal candidate brings deep laboratory experience with R&D hardware, has worked in customer-facing or field-deployed environments, is comfortable with international travel and working across time zones and cultures, and has direct hands-on experience operating and debugging dilution refrigerators.. What You'll Be Doing. Test, validate, and debug custom RF control systems using advanced electronic test equipment such as network analyzers, oscilloscopes, DMMs, and internally developed tools. Operate, monitor, and debug dilution refrigerators, including cooldowns, steady-state operation, and fault diagnosis. Operate, troubleshoot and service cryogenic and vacuum systems, including scroll pumps, turbo pumps, cryo compressors, high-vacuum components, and cold traps. Perform helium leak detection, pump rebuilds, and thermal system management. Assemble, validate, and install complex electro-mechanical, cryogenic, vacuum, and RF assemblies with exceptional attention to detail. Contribute to test plan development and execute validation testing for next-generation RF hardware. Participate in an on-call rotation to support system uptime in a customer-facing environment, potentially spanning multiple time zones. Prepare, inspect, and package quantum chip assemblies for testing. Follow established procedures and contribute to the creation and improvement of standard operating procedures and best practices. Read and interpret CAD drawings, schematics, and engineering specifications. Work directly with customer teams across different regions to support system operation, issue resolution, and ongoing optimization. Navigate logistics of international travel, including customs/import considerations for tools and equipment, visas, and site-specific access requirements. 35+% travel required, including international travel to customer sites; frequency and destinations will vary by program. . What You Bring. Technical background in Physics, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent industrial experience (MS or PhD a plus). Strong proficiency with general-purpose electronic test equipment (oscilloscopes, network analyzers, multimeters, DC power supplies, etc.). Direct, hands-on experience operating and troubleshooting dilution refrigerators (required). Substantial hands-on experience working with sub-Kelvin cryogenic systems. Experience operating and maintaining high-availability laboratory or industrial equipment. Experience assembling, servicing, and maintaining scientific instruments or complex electro-mechanical systems. Familiarity with vacuum systems, vacuum plumbing, P&IDs, and standard fittings and practices; strong experience in vacuum equipment assembly and debug using helium leak detection. Working knowledge of statistical methods for test and validation (e.g., DOE, Six Sigma, simulation). Attention to detail in documentation (writing and following Work Instructions and Standard Operating Procedures) plus excellent written and verbal communication skills. Experience working with external vendors, partners, or customers across different regions and cultural contexts. title: Quality Control Technician

This role is heavily execution-focused: measuring parts, evaluating conformance, and working with engineering to resolve issues on components ranging from high-tolerance machined hardware to PCBAs and RF/microwave assemblies used in cryogenic environments. You'll work within a QMS framework defined by Quality Engineering, applying inspection plans and acceptance criteria consistently and flagging gaps or improvement opportunities as they come up. The ideal candidate is meticulous, comfortable with precision measurement equipment, and enjoys digging into a nonconforming part to figure out what happened and what to do about it.. What You'll Be Doing. Perform Incoming Quality Control (IQC) inspection on a daily basis, including:. Defining and executing inspection plans and sampling per defined acceptance criteria. Measuring and documenting results using CMM, calipers, micrometers, optical comparators, and other precision tools. Flagging discrepancies and escalating as needed. Inspect high-precision components across multiple hardware types:. Tight-tolerance machined parts. PCBAs. RF/microwave hardware. Execute Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs):. Document findings with clear, thorough records. Support root cause investigation. Track through to resolution and closure. Support material review board (MRB) activities - gather data and recommend disposition (use-as-is, rework, scrap) for engineering and supply chain sign-off. Assist with Corrective and Preventive Action (CAPA) follow-through, including verifying implementation and effectiveness. Maintain accurate, organized inspection records and traceability documentation. Support supplier-related quality issues by preparing data packages, measurement evidence, and inspection reports. Help track incoming yield, defect trends, and other quality metrics. Support New Product Introduction (NPI) by performing first-article inspections and validating new inspection methods. Continuously look for ways to improve inspection efficiency, tooling, and documentation. Work with data systems including Arena, CAD drawings, Excel, and internal databases. . title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Cryogenic
description: Rigetti Computing builds full-stack quantum computers - from superconducting qubit devices fabricated in our own foundry to cloud-accessible quantum processors. We are seeking a Senior Mechanical/Cryogenic Engineer to own the mechanical architecture of our quantum hardware systems, from room-temperature infrastructure down to the millikelvin core of our dilution refrigerators. You will lead the design of the cryogenic signal chain, define mechanical interfaces across thermal stages, and work directly alongside quantum physicists, RF engineers, and systems teams. This is a high-ownership role: you will drive design decisions end-to-end, from concept through qualification, on some of the most technically demanding hardware in the industry. Key Responsibilities. Cryogenic Hardware Design. ▸ Own the mechanical design of cryogenic hardware from 300 K to millikelvin - thermal anchoring, RF wiring, flex interconnects, coaxial routing, filter housings, and connector packaging across all temperature stages. ▸ Lead the full design lifecycle: concept, CAD, GD&T drawings, BOMs, tolerance analysis, prototype builds, qualification testing, and manufacturing release. ▸ Define cryogenic mechanical interfaces and thermal conduction budgets; drive design-for-manufacturability with external machine shops and precision vendors. Simulation & Analysis. ▸ Perform mechanical, thermal, and vibration analyses independently using COMSOL, ANSYS, or equivalent; use simulation results to drive design decisions and iteration. ▸ Conduct tolerance stack-up analyses for multi-component assemblies in constrained cryostat environments. Integration, Leadership & Collaboration. ▸ Lead prototype builds, system integration, and cryogenic bring-up; diagnose integration failures and drive root cause analysis. ▸ Serve as the mechanical lead in cross-functional programs alongside quantum physicists, RF engineers, and systems teams, mentor junior engineers and lead design reviews. ▸ Maintain rigorous documentation - CAD models, drawings, BOMs, and revision-controlled design records - within the company PLM system. title: Senior Quantum Engineer, Gate Calibration
description: We are looking for an experienced Quantum Engineer to drive the two-qubit gate performance of our tunable-coupler superconducting quantum processors. Two-qubit gate fidelity is one of the most consequential challenges in quantum computing, and it sits at the center of our roadmap toward error correction. In this role, you will design, execute, and interpret the experiments that propel our near- and long-term gate performance at scale. You will identify the dominant sources of two-qubit gate error on our processors, isolate their physical origin, and eliminate them - through pulse engineering, calibration methodology, error suppression strategies, or feedback to design and fabrication. Your conclusions will directly inform device design, control strategy, and platform-level decisions. This is a role with substantial autonomy and ownership. You will directly influence the technical direction for gate performance work through the rigorous design and execution of your test plans, measurement and improvement of relevant metrics and error budgeting, and shaping of research priorities. You will do this in a deeply collaborative environment spanning device design, fabrication, control systems, software, theory and R&D, turning proofs of concept into robust procedures that hold up across hundreds of qubit pairs.. Key Responsibilities. Lead experimental programs to characterize, calibrate, and optimize two-qubit gates on tunable-coupler devices, from single-pair physics investigations to full-processor deployment.. Identify gate-error bottlenecks (e.g., coherent control error, decoherence, leakage, crosstalk, TLS interactions) for single-pair as well as large-scale systems and isolate their physical origin through targeted experiments, benchmarking, and simulation.. Develop and harden calibration methods using techniques such as optimal pulse shaping, dynamical decoupling, and other error suppression strategies, with an emphasis on robustness and automation at scale.. Develop and improve metrology for full-processor Hamiltonian and characteristic extraction and correlate with gate performance. Turn that knowledge into actionable feedback for device design, fabrication, and control hardware teams, and drive those changes to closure.. Prepare novel Rigetti devices for use by internal applications development teams and external deployment.. Stay current with the literature and convert state-of-the-art techniques into working capability on production hardware.. Contribute to the field of superconducting quantum computing by converting relevant findings into high-quality publications.. . Required Qualifications. PhD in Physics, Applied Physics, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.. Significant hands-on experience calibrating and characterizing two-qubit gates on superconducting quantum devices; direct experience with tunable couplers is a strong plus.. Deep understanding of gate design, pulse engineering, and decoherence mechanisms, with a track record of connecting error diagnostics to concrete fidelity improvements.. Demonstrated ability to independently execute complex experimental efforts from concept to validated result.. Strong Python skills in a scientific context, and comfort building tools that others rely on.. Dogged experimental determination, with the judgment to balance depth of investigation against speed of iteration.. Excellent communication skills and a team-first mindset in a strongly collaborative environment.. . Nice to Have. Experience with quantum simulation frameworks such as QuTiP for gate and noise modeling.. Experience deploying calibration or benchmarking procedures across large multi-qubit processors in an industrial or startup setting.. Familiarity with randomized benchmarking variants, gate set tomography, cycle benchmarking, or other scalable error diagnostics.. Publication record or demonstrated results in high-fidelity entangling gates, error suppression, or quantum control.. Experience mentoring junior scientists or leading small technical teams.. . Special focus on fostering relationships with local leaders in NCR VOYIX Japan and Global Headquarters. Indirect category management experience (either as a sourcing manager or as a business unit manager); strong understanding of Hardware Maintenance, Professional Services, IT and Software including software licensing, cloud architecture, IT labor SOWs, and software-as-a-service. Strong negotiation, and contract management skills; including a working understanding of contractual terms and conditions and risk mitigation. description: About NCR VOYIX. . NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.. . . . Title: L1 Support. Job Profile: SUP-B1-001 - L1 Support. Location : CEBU CITY-EBLOC TWR. Compensation Grade : B1. . Position will provide support for NCR's Clients, Customer Engineers and partners; Support will include problem identification, analysis, diagnosis and resolution;. Answer incoming phone calls, emails or tickets from clients and field engineers; Monitor the notification and ticket queue screens; Remotely resolve tickets with a remote resolution opportunity; Dispatch to the appropriate teams for resolution;. Manages incidents to ensure contractual SLAs are met, if SLA is in danger follows the agreed escalation path;. Follow defined escalation process for P1 tickets;. Utilize Knowledge Systems provided by NCR and other vendors as appropriate to identify solutions to known problems; Responsible for ensuring that solutions provided are successful;. When no known solution can be identified, responsible for the escalation of issues to other support centers where deeper level skilled personnel are available; Position retains ownership of all escalated problems/issues through to resolution and is responsible for ensuring that NCR Management is informed if resolution to a problem will take longer than contractual;. Contribute as a team member; Support less experienced colleagues through joint work, monitoring and knowledge sharing;. Work to anticipate internal and external client needs and commitment to customer satisfaction;. Employees will receive a special project from supervisor/teal leader based on business needs (may come from supervisor directly or COL / customer);. Ensure proper ticket classification and provide gapless troubleshooting steps to ensure higher support levels do not need to repeat the work done;. Create and Share knowledge in the designated Team knowledge base including usage of the existing knowledge base documents;. 24/7 operations (all 3 shifts) that include weekend support;. . The Incident Manager owns the end-to-end incident lifecycle for NCR Voyix's Retail customers, acting as the central point of coordination whenever service is disrupted. This role operates within an ITIL-aligned incident management framework, with success measured by speed of resolution, quality of stakeholder communication, and the customer experience delivered throughout every incident. Wrapped around the Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 technical support tiers, the Incident Manager provides coordination, escalation ownership, and stakeholder management for incidents that require cross-team engagement, major incident handling, or executive visibility. The role blends ITIL process discipline with strong leadership and communication skills to keep incidents moving toward resolution and to protect the customer experience even under pressure. The role covers incidents across (although not limited to):. Retail and SCO devices. Payment, cloud, and web services. Store systems applications. Windows and Linux operating systems. Ensure comprehensive incident documentation, including timelines, actions taken, and root cause where known, to support audits, trend analysis, and reporting. Maintain the incident management knowledge base, escalation matrices, and major incident runbooks so they remain accurate and fit for purpose. Support the creation and refinement of knowledge base articles to enable faster diagnosis and resolution by support tiers. Team Support & Continuous Development. Coach and support Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 colleagues through direct feedback, joint working, and knowledge sharing to strengthen overall incident handling capability. Participate in team meetings, objective setting, performance management, and recognition programs, contributing to a strong team culture. Support 24x7 operational coverage as required, including participation in on-call and major incident rotations. Participate in special projects to continuously improve incident management processes, tools, and organisational maturity. Career Progression. This role operates within a structured support model:. title: L1 Support
description: About NCR VOYIX. . NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.. . . Title: Technical support representative. Location: Cebu, Philippines. . Summary. Join NCR Voyix's Technical Assistance Center (TAC) and be the first line of support for our customers. You'll troubleshoot technical issues, provide exceptional customer care, and help keep our retail, hospitality, financial, and cloud solutions running smoothly.. Key Responsibilities. Provide Level 1 technical troubleshooting for POS devices and other supported equipment. Remotely diagnose issues, provide accurate solutions, and dispatch field technicians when required. Communicate with customers via phone, email, chat, and remote tools to resolve incidents. Follow defined Remote Incident Management processes and document all activities in the incident tracking system. Review incident history and identify recurring issues. Escalate incidents according to established escalation paths when necessary. Contribute to knowledge articles and maintain accurate customer/system documentation. Participate in team meetings, coaching, performance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives. Support less experienced colleagues through knowledge sharing and joint work sessions. Conduct incident quality audits and call monitoring activities.. Required Qualifications. 1-2 years of experience in technical support or similar role. Strong communication, customer service, and customer‑handling skills. Functional proficiency in required foreign languages based on customer needs. Solid technical aptitude and problem‑solving ability. Ability to learn and apply new technical knowledge through training.. Shift & Work Arrangement. 24/7 shift coverage (rotational shifts). SaaS導入・実装. テクニカルPMには、SaaSデリバリーモデルに関する深い理解と実践経験が求められます。. 求められる知識・経験. . 継続的デリバリー（Continuous Delivery）および段階的リリースを前提としたリリースマネジメント. 要件が未確定、変化中、または定義途中であってもプロジェクトを推進する能力. 拡張性の高いプラットフォーム設計と個別顧客要件・カスタマイズ要望とのバランスを取る能力. サブスクリプションビジネスのライフサイクルに対する理解. . サブスクリプションライフサイクル. . オンボーディング（導入）. 利用定着・ユーザーエンゲージメント向上. . 3. ステークホルダーおよび顧客リーダーシップ. 求められる行動. . 非現実的なスコープやスケジュール要求に対して、データと論理に基づき建設的な提言・調整ができること. Sales、Product Management、Engineering、および顧客の橋渡し役として機能すること. 必要に応じてエグゼクティブレベルの顧客対応を行うこと. 不確実性や課題が発生した状況においても、顧客からの信頼を維持し続けること. . 4. ビジネスおよび商業的視点. 直接的なP&L責任がない場合でも、プロジェクトマネージャーには高いビジネス判断力が求められます。. 求められる理解・能力. . ROI（投資対効果）の観点から、投入工数とビジネス価値を評価できること. 収益性、拡張性、長期的な持続可能性に悪影響を与えるスコープ拡大を見極められること. 契約内要件と契約外要件を適切に区別できること. 将来的なプロダクト負債や運用負債につながる顧客要求を見極められること. . NCR Voyixの共有価値観には、多様性とインクルージョンへの強いコミットメントが組み込まれています。私たちは、すべての従業員が公平に扱われ、それぞれの個性が尊重され、成果に基づいて評価・昇進され、自らの能力を最大限に発揮できる環境づくりに取り組んでいます。. また、性別、年齢、人種、肌の色、信条、宗教、国籍、障害、性的指向、退役軍人資格、兵役経験、遺伝情報、その他法令により保護される属性や行動を理由とした差別を行いません。. NCR Voyixのすべての従業員は、多様性を尊重し、グローバルでインクルーシブな職場環境を支援する責任を担っています。. 注: 役割間の社内異動に関するガイドラインについては、HR CMPポリシー420をご参照ください。. . EEO ステートメント. 私たちの共通の価値観に統合されているのは、 NCR の多様性への取り組みです。 NCR は、すべての人々が公正に扱われ、個性があると認められ、業績に基づいて推進され、最大限の可能性に達するよう努力することを奨励される、グローバルに包括的な企業であることを約束します。私たちはすべての人々の違いを理解し、尊重することを信じています。 NCR は、性別、年齢、人種、肌の色、信条、宗教、出身国、身体障害、性的指向、ベテランの地位、兵役、遺伝情報、または法律で保護されているその他の特性に基づいて雇用を差別しません。 NCR の各個人は、世界的に多様な環境を尊重し支援する継続的な責任を負っています。. . 第三者機関への声明. すべての人材紹介会社に： NCR は、 NCR 優先サプライヤーリストに記載されている企業からの履歴書のみを受け付けます。履歴書を応募者追跡システム、 NCR の従業員、または NCR の施設に転送しないでください。 NCR は、求められていない履歴書に関連する料金または費用について一切責任を負いません。. . . . . .

title: ServiceNow Developer

Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.. . . Will be responsible to develop and implement different ServiceNow applications and integrations from initiation to completion, tailored to the customer requirements. Creation/implementation/modification of ServiceNow ITSM/CSM/others components. Maintain technical documentation and assist/participate in QA and user training activities. Understanding of the project delivery lifecycle and processes and their implementation. Scripting (JavaScript) for different modules for writing Rules, Updating/creating workflows, APIs etc. Understand detailed requirements and own your code from design, implementation, test automation, and delivery of high-quality solutions to our customers. Solving complex problems in a highly dynamic and agile environment. Having a strong focus on code quality and reusability. . title: L3 Technical SUpport
description: About NCR VOYIX. . NCR Voyix Corporation (NYSE: VYX) is a global platform-powered leader in unified commerce for shopping and dining. Combining a flexible, intelligent platform with end-to-end payments capabilities and services developed through its deep industry experience, NCR Voyix empowers retailers and restaurants to accelerate new possibilities for their operations, experiences and business outcomes. NCR Voyix is headquartered in Atlanta, Georgia, and serves customers in more than 35 countries worldwide.. . . . NCR's self-service, assisted-service and point-of-sale solutions are found in over 150 countries across the globe. Our core industries are financial and retail. The extensive NCR solutions portfolio also serves travel, healthcare, food and hospitality. . Summary:. . Level 3 Support Analyst is responsible for providing technical support and troubleshooting services for Retail systems and infrastructure. This includes diagnosing and resolving complex technical issues, managing and monitoring systems, provide guidance and support to end-users.. Responsibilities. Monitor Service Request System (SRS) incident management queue. Analyzes incidents to identify service restoration actions to be taken. Incident investigation and diagnosis (including resolution where possible ). Create problem records and perform root cause analysis. Takes incident resolution actions to restore service to customers. Performs complex problem solving and assistance on diverse software applications and hardware systems for department users and/or the university community. Provides in-depth individual and/or group instruction and training to faculty, staff, and/or students on new or updated technologies. Performs advanced technological systems support, maintenance, and testing for proper upkeep of systems; troubleshoots and resolves complex system hardware, software, and network failures and conflicts. Oversees and performs the installation, configuration and maintenance of computers, networks, workstations and/or other related equipment and devices. Performs miscellaneous job-related duties as assigned.. . Qualifications and Experience. . Diploma or Degree in Information Technology or related discipline. Minimum 4years of hands-on experience working in support environment providing Level 2 and Level 3 support. Database management - Microsoft SQL Server, SQL Queries. PowerShell scripting. Object Oriented and .NET Programming (advantage). Knowledge of a wide range of computer systems software, applications, hardware, networking, and communications. Ability to perform advanced preventive maintenance on systems software, applications, hardware, networking, and communications. Strong interpersonal and communication skills. Ability to determine computer problems and to coordinate hardware, software, and/or network solutions. Ability to analyze and resolve moderately complex computer and network problems. Ability to communicate technical guidance and instruction to users on the use of PC and/or mainframe applications and systems. Good interpersonal and customer relation skills.. Offers of employment are conditional upon passage of screening criteria applicable to the job. EEO Statement. The role is part of the regional Pre-Sales team focused on NCR Voyix's next-generation platform strategy, implementing global best practices, capabilities and standards, and leveraging them across key customer engagements in the region. Technical Expertise - Strong background in enterprise architecture, integration patterns, and cloud technologies. Experience with SaaS and cloud services.. title: Account Executive
description: Role Description. As an Account Executive on the Growth team, you will help Dropbox expand how we bring our Product Suite and emerging AI products to new customers. In this role, you'll focus on identifying, engaging, and developing opportunities with net new customers. You'll work with prospects to understand their needs, learn which use cases resonate, and help create successful outcomes. You'll be expected to execute consistently, manage your pipeline effectively, and contribute feedback that helps improve our sales motion, messaging, and approach over time. This is an opportunity to build strong sales experience across a growing portfolio of products while contributing to Dropbox's next phase of growth. Responsibilities. Own the full sales cycle from pipeline generation through close and renewal within your territory. Build pipeline from scratch by prospecting into new teams, departments, and executive stakeholders. Expand beyond existing motions to uncover new use cases and opportunities. Consistently generate pipeline through outbound efforts, account mapping, events, and partner collaboration. Forecast accurately and manage pipeline to consistently meet or exceed revenue targets. Lead strong discovery to uncover customer challenges, priorities, and desired outcomes. Apply structured qualification and value-selling frameworks (e.g., MEDDICC, SPICED) to advance deals. Clearly articulate business impact and position Dropbox solutions around outcomes, not features. Drive deal momentum by building urgency, aligning stakeholders, and establishing clear next steps. Contribute to evolving GTM strategy by refining ICP, messaging, and use cases (e.g., Dash). Collaborate cross-functionally and bring insights from the field to influence Product and GTM. Requirements. 4 + years of B2B SaaS sales experience, ideally including time in early-stage, new product, or evolving GTM environments. Proven ability to generate pipeline and close deals in ambiguous or evolving markets. Strong experience with qualification frameworks such as MEDDICC, SPICED, or similar. Demonstrated use of value selling methodologies such as Command of the Message or equivalent. Experience selling to mid-market and enterprise customers, including executive stakeholders. Consistent track record of meeting or exceeding sales targets. High ownership mentality - you take initiative and move things forward without waiting for direction. Thrive in ambiguity and are comfortable operating without a fully defined playbook. Curious and business-oriented, with the ability to connect customer problems to solutions. Resourceful and adaptable - you figure things out and adjust quickly. Strong collaborator who contributes positively to team culture. Experience using Salesforce or similar CRM tools to manage pipeline and forecast. Strong organizational skills and ability to manage multiple complex deals. Preferred Qualifications. Experience selling a new or emerging product within an existing portfolio. Experience working in high-change or transformation environments. BA/BS degree or equivalent experience. General familiarity with AI or productivity tools. Durable Skills. AI fluency means using these tools to amplify human judgment, not replace it. Judgment: E valuat e information and mak e decisions in complex situations. . Adaptability: L earn, adjust, and stay effective through change. . Connection: C ommunicat e , collaborat e , and build trust. . To learn more about why these skills matter and what the data shows about thriving through change, read this blog post from our Chief People Officer, Melanie Rosenwasser. Compensation. US Zone 1. title: Business Development Manager, Strategic Partnerships
description: Role Description. The Dropbox Business Development team builds and grows strategic partnerships that expand Dropbox's reach, deepen product adoption, and drive long-term customer and revenue growth. As a Business Development Manager, you will own a portfolio spanning AI, platform/developer, hardware, AI, and SaaS ecosystems. You will manage the full partnership lifecycle-from opportunity identification and commercial strategy through launch, ongoing growth, and partner success. You will play a key role in shaping Dropbox's partnership strategy by identifying growth opportunities, evaluating business cases, and translating partner needs into integrated customer experiences. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Sales to execute partnerships across device distribution and AI agent ecosystems. This role offers significant exposure to senior leaders and external executives while owning partnerships with meaningful strategic and commercial impact. AI and automation are increasingly embedded in our workflows, accelerating research, partner preparation, and administrative work. Success in this role comes from using these capabilities to increase efficiency while focusing your time on strategic decision-making, commercial negotiations, and relationship management. Responsibilities. Own and grow strategic distribution and ecosystem partnerships to drive customer acquisition, product adoption, and revenue growth. Identify, evaluate, and develop commercial opportunities with existing and prospective partners. Build business cases and financial models that inform partnership strategy and investment decisions. Lead or support commercial negotiations while balancing strategic objectives, customer value, and financial outcomes. Build trusted executive relationships through regular business reviews, strategic planning, and cross-functional collaboration. Analyze partner performance and leverage data, experimentation, and AI-enabled tools to optimize commercial outcomes. Partner effectively across Product, Engineering, Finance, Legal, Marketing, and Sales to execute complex partnership initiatives. Ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders and navigate ambiguity in fast-paced environments. title: Customer Evidence Manager
description: Role Description. Dropbox is hiring a Customer Evidence Manager to own and drive the customer-proof infrastructure that powers our managed sales motion. This is a senior individual-contributor role for a commercially minded, creatively grounded customer marketer who understands that the value of a customer story is not that it gets published - it is that it protects customer trust, gives buyers credible, accurate proof and moves a deal forward. You are the editorial authority on what good looks like, not the person writing every script: execution (writing, video, design) is delivered through agency partners you brief and direct. Enterprise buyers do not decide on brand claims. They decide on credible proof from organizations like theirs: customer stories, ROI evidence, video testimonials, peer reviews, and competitive validation. In this role, you will produce that evidence and ensure it reaches sellers and customers at the moments it can have the greatest commercial impact. This is a hands-on role combining Windows technical ownership with the development of a more code-managed endpoint platform. You will help evaluate and adopt FleetDM, osquery, infrastructure-as-code, and GitOps practices where they improve reliability, visibility, and maintainability. You will strengthen the current environment while building and validating the path forward-not assume that replacing a tool is the answer. You will work with CorpInfra, IAM, Security, and support teams to make practical technical decisions, lead multi-phase improvements, and clarify ownership. You will also mentor teammates through pairing, code review, and shared operational practices. This is an individual-contributor role, not a people-management position. Responsibilities. Own endpoint reliability and lifecycle management. Improve provisioning, application delivery, updates, security configuration, and troubleshooting across the endpoint environment. Make patching predictable and safe. Strengthen update workflows through testing, controlled rollouts, and remediation. Make fleet health trustworthy and actionable. Improve reporting on device health, patching, and configuration, with clear ownership for resolving issues. Build maintainable automation. Turn recurring work into reliable, tested workflows that other engineers can operate. Advance code-managed endpoint operations. Adopt tools and practices that improve configuration management, validation, and deployment. Lead cross-functional platform improvements. Define practical roadmaps, resolve dependencies, and balance security, reliability, employee experience, and team capacity. Strengthen the team's capability. Mentor teammates, review code and designs, and document reusable practices that improve coverage across the endpoint team. Requirements. Significant experience engineering and operating Windows endpoint environments, with personal ownership beyond ticket handling or routine console administration. Deep hands-on Intune experience across device lifecycle, configuration and compliance policies, application management, update workflows, and relevant Entra ID dependencies. Strong Windows troubleshooting skills across operating-system behavior, services, logs, networking, certificates, identity, and security controls. Able to distinguish reported management status from actual endpoint health. Recent ownership of Windows and third-party application patching, including staged deployment, user-impact validation, failed-device handling, exceptions, and recovery. Strong practical PowerShell skills and familiarity with at least one additional programming language, such as Python, Go, or C#. Experience building and maintaining production automation or systems integrations. Demonstrated use of version control, code review, automated checks, and controlled deployment for operational changes. Able to explain safe retries, failure handling, secrets management, and configuration drift. Ability to independently define and deliver multi-phase work, prioritize under ambiguity, partner across teams, and mentor other engineers. Clear written and verbal communication, including concise technical decisions, incident updates, runbooks, and effective asynchronous collaboration. Preferred Qualifications. Production experience with FleetDM on Windows , including agent operations, policies, queries, targeting, API integrations, or configuration managed through GitOps. Practical osquery and SQL experience for endpoint inventory, health, or security use cases, including query validation, performance considerations, and handling stale or missing results. Experience with infrastructure-as-code or declarative configuration, continuous integration and delivery, and migration or coexistence between endpoint-management platforms. Experience with Automox, Patch My PC, or comparable tools , and with endpoint privilege management, application control, encryption, or other security controls. Experience supporting developer-heavy, distributed environments and contributing reusable automation across Windows, macOS, or Linux. Durable Skills. title: Senior Financial Planning & Analysis Partner - Product & Growth
description: Role Description. We are seeking a Senior FP&A Partner to help shape and accelerate growth across our core business. This highly visible role will serve as a strategic thought partner to Product leadership, using financial analysis, business insights, and structured problem-solving to influence both near-term priorities and long-term strategy. The ideal candidate combines strong financial acumen with a deep understanding of SaaS business models and growth drivers. They will translate complex data into clear insights, identify opportunities to improve business performance, and help leaders evaluate investments and strategic tradeoffs. Success in this role requires a self-starter who is comfortable navigating ambiguity, building structure where it does not yet exist, and collaborating across Product, Finance, Data Science, Marketing, and other cross-functional teams. This individual will also be expected to embrace AI-enabled ways of working, using modern tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of financial analysis and decision support. Responsibilities. Serve as a strategic thought partner to Product leadership, helping shape short-term priorities and long-term direction for the core business. Build driver-based financial models that connect product performance and customer behavior to revenue, ARR, retention, and profitability. Evaluate growth initiatives, product investments, pricing strategies, and resource allocation decisions through rigorous financial and strategic analysis. Develop business cases and scenario analyses that clearly articulate expected returns, risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs. Partner across Product, Finance, Data Science, and Marketing to establish targets, define success metrics, and evaluate business performance. Identify emerging trends, performance gaps, and growth opportunities, translating complex data into clear, actionable recommendations for senior leadership. Improve the speed, quality, and scalability of financial analysis through automation, standardized processes, and AI-enabled workflows. Requirements. Bachelor's or advanced degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or a related quantitative field, with e ight or more years of relevant experience in FP&A, strategic finance, corporate finance, investment banking, consulting, or a similarly analytical role. Advanced financial modeling skills, including experience building driver-based forecasts, scenario analyses, and investment cases. Experience supporting Product, Growth, or Monetization teams within a subscription-based or SaaS company. Strong understanding of SaaS business models and metrics, including ARR, conversion, retention, churn, customer lifetime value , marketing customer acquisition metrics, and unit economics. Demonstrated ability to translate complex data and open-ended business questions into clear insights and actionable recommendations. Proven ability to work independently, take ownership, and create structure in fast-moving or ambiguous situations. Excellent communication and cross-functional partnership skills, including the ability to influence senior leaders and non-finance stakeholders. Practical experience using AI tools to improve analysis, modeling, automation, communication, or other daily workflows. Preferred Qualifications. Experience evaluating product-led growth initiatives, pricing and packaging decisions, customer funnel performance, or retention strategies. Experience developing long-range plans and strategic financial models for a scaled technology business. Familiarity with SQL, data visualization platforms, or other tools for independently accessing and analyzing business data. Experience partnering with Data Science, Analytics, Product Development or Engineering teams to define metrics and measure product performance. Durable Skills. title: Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing
description: Role Description. As Senior Manager, APJ Field & Channel Marketing, you will lead the development and execution of Dropbox's regional marketing strategy across the entire Asia-Pacific and Japan region. You will bring the greatest depth of focus to Dropbox's Tier 1 markets-Australia/New Zealand, Singapore, Korea, India, and Japan-while building fit-for-market programs for Tier 2 markets including Vietnam, Hong Kong, and Taiwan. Reporting to the Chief Marketing Officer, you will work in close partnership with the Regional VP of Sales to translate business priorities into integrated marketing strategies and campaigns that create pipeline, accelerate opportunities, and support regional sales growth. This is a strategic and hands-on leadership role at the intersection of field marketing, channel marketing, sales, and Dropbox's global marketing organization. Field and channel marketing will be equally important as Dropbox evolves toward a hybrid go-to-market model in ANZ and adapts its approach across APJ. You will build the regional marketing plan, manage the regional budget, and measure performance against clear business outcomes. You will also manage and develop our Japan Marketing team, ensuring our regional approach combines consistent strategy and operating discipline with strong local-market relevance. . You will be Dropbox Marketing's senior voice in the region-bringing APJ customer, partner, and market insights into global planning while adapting global campaigns for local audiences. The ideal candidate is a collaborative, commercially minded leader who can move comfortably between executive-level strategy, people leadership, and hands-on campaign execution. Responsibilities. Develop and own the integrated field and channel marketing strategy for APJ, aligned with regional sales priorities and Dropbox's global marketing strategy. Partner closely with the Regional VP of Sales and sales leadership to develop regional and country-level plans that create qualified pipeline, accelerate priority opportunities, and support revenue growth. Lead the planning and execution of regional marketing programs across field events, executive experiences, account-based initiatives, integrated campaigns, partner and channel activations, webinars, and other locally relevant tactics. Build an equally strong field and channel marketing motion, balancing direct-to-customer and partner-led investments by market using customer insight, sales priorities, partner opportunity, and performance data. Lead, coach, and develop the Japan Marketing team by establishing clear goals, operating rhythms, and opportunities for growth while enabling strong local execution. Build strong relationships with regional sales, partner sales, and channel leaders; create joint plans with priority partners and develop co-marketing programs that extend Dropbox's market reach and generate partner-sourced or partner-influenced demand. Translate global campaigns, positioning, and content into regionally relevant programs, partnering with global Campaigns, Product Marketing, Brand, Digital, Communications, Marketing Operations, and other teams. Own the regional marketing budget, agency and vendor relationships, program calendar, forecasting, and performance reporting; continuously optimize investments based on pipeline impact and ROI. Establish clear KPIs and operating cadences with Sales and Marketing Operations, including regular planning sessions and business reviews that connect marketing activity to pipeline creation and opportunity progression. Represent APJ within the global marketing organization, sharing market intelligence, customer and partner feedback, competitive insight, and regional best practices to improve company-wide strategy and execution. Build a scalable regional marketing playbook that balances consistency across APJ with the distinct needs, cultures, routes to market, and buying behaviors of individual countries. Travel within the region and internationally as needed to support team leadership, sales planning, partner engagement, and key programs-approximately 20%. Requirements. 10+ years of progressive B2B marketing experience, including significant experience in regional, field, demand generation, and/or channel marketing within enterprise software, SaaS, or another technology environment. Demonstrated experience developing and executing multi-country APJ marketing strategies that produced measurable pipeline and sales impact. People-management experience, including coaching and developing marketers working across different countries, cultures, or time zones. Proven ability to operate as a strategic partner to senior sales leaders, translate sales priorities into marketing plans, and build alignment through planning and business reviews. Experience leading an integrated mix of field and channel programs, including events, account-based programs, partner co-marketing, campaigns, and pipeline-acceleration initiatives. Strong commercial and analytical skills, including experience managing regional budgets, setting program KPIs, evaluating pipeline contribution, and using performance data to optimize investment. Excellent executive communication, cross-functional leadership, and influencing skills, with the ability to operate effectively in a global, distributed, and highly collaborative organization. Preferred Qualifications. Deep familiarity with the APJ technology market, with experience developing differentiated strategies across mature and emerging markets; direct experience in several of Dropbox's Tier 1 markets is strongly preferred. Experience in a channel-led or partner-influenced go-to-market model, including co-marketing with resellers, distributors, alliances, or technology partners. Experience building or evolving a regional marketing function, operating model, or playbook in a growing or changing business. Strong understanding of enterprise and commercial buying journeys, account-based marketing, opportunity acceleration, and regional event strategy. title: Vice President, Revenue Operations
description: Role Description. Dropbox is seeking a Vice President of Revenue Operations to define and lead the operating strategy for the company's global B2B go-to-market organization. This executive will be responsible for building a high-performing, scalable revenue engine that enables predictable and efficient growth across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise segments while supporting Dropbox's evolution across product-led, sales-assisted, and enterprise motions. . This leader will serve as a key strategic partner to the Chief Business Officer and broader executive leadership team, translating company strategy into the operating model, planning frameworks, systems, insights, and execution mechanisms required to deliver durable growth. The role will own Revenue Operations and Marketing Operations across the customer lifecycle, ensuring tight alignment between demand generation, pipeline creation, sales execution, retention, expansion, and overall revenue performance. . The VP of Revenue Operations will have enterprise-wide accountability for revenue planning, forecasting, segmentation, capacity and coverage strategy, incentives, GTM systems, analytics, operating cadence, and revenue productivity. This leader will play a central role in shaping how Dropbox allocates resources, evaluates performance, scales new products and motions, and modernizes its GTM organization through data, automation, and AI. . Responsibilities. Define and lead Dropbox's global revenue operating strategy, ensuring the company's GTM model is designed to support long-term growth, efficiency, and increasing enterprise complexity. Serve as a strategic advisor to the Chief Business Officer and executive leadership team, bringing data-driven insights and recommendations to critical decisions around growth, investment, resource allocation, organizational design, and GTM strategy. Own the end-to-end revenue operating model across Sales, Marketing, Customer Success, and Support, including segmentation, coverage models, territory architecture, role design, operating rhythms, and cross-functional accountability. Lead company-wide annual and long-range revenue planning, including bookings targets, quota strategy, capacity and workforce planning, territory design, productivity assumptions, investment scenarios, and resource allocation. Establish a best-in-class forecasting and pipeline management framework that increases predictability, strengthens executive visibility, and enables earlier intervention against business performance risks. Define and evolve the company's revenue performance architecture, including the KPIs, operating cadences, inspection mechanisms, and executive business reviews used to assess growth, productivity, efficiency, retention, and expansion. Lead Revenue Operations across the full customer lifecycle, creating scalable and integrated processes from demand generation and lead management through opportunity conversion, renewal, expansion, and customer growth. Partner with Marketing leadership to oversee Marketing Operations and ensure strong alignment between demand generation investments, pipeline creation, segmentation, campaign performance, and downstream revenue outcomes. Partner closely with Finance on revenue strategy and planning, pricing and packaging operations, investment allocation, deal governance, incentive compensation, and performance management. Partner with Product and GTM leadership to define the operating strategy for new products, new customer segments, pricing changes, packaging evolution, and emerging sales motions. Own the strategy and evolution of Dropbox's GTM technology ecosystem, ensuring systems, data architecture, automation, and workflows scale effectively with the business. Lead the adoption of AI across Revenue Operations and the broader GTM organization, identifying opportunities to fundamentally improve seller productivity, forecasting, customer targeting, planning, decision-making, and operational efficiency. Simplify legacy processes, systems, and organizational structures where needed, driving enterprise-wide transformation and change management across a complex stakeholder environment. Build, lead, and develop a world-class Revenue Operations organization, including strong leadership succession, organizational design, talent development, and clear accountability across teams. Represent Revenue Operations in executive-level and company-wide planning forums, serving as a trusted voice on GTM performance, risks, opportunities, and operating priorities. Requirements. 15+ years of experience in Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, GTM Operations, Finance, or related functions within a scaled SaaS or product-led growth company. Proven experience leading revenue operations for multi-segment B2B organizations across SMB, Mid-Market, and Enterprise customer segments. Deep expertise in forecasting, revenue planning, territory design, quota management, sales productivity, incentive compensation, and pipeline management. Strong understanding of SaaS business models, revenue motions, and key operational drivers across acquisition, expansion, and retention. Demonstrated ability to identify operational challenges and implement scalable, data-driven solutions that improve business performance. Strong cross-functional leadership skills with the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Sales, Finance, Product, Marketing, and Customer organizations. Experience supporting organizations through significant growth and GTM evolution, including PLG, sales-assisted, and enterprise motions. Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with extensive experience leveraging data to drive operational and business decisions. Track record of building, developing, and leading high-performing revenue operations teams in a fast-paced, evolving environment. Preferred Qualifications. Proven track record implementing AI-enabled revenue solutions that deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, productivity, and business outcomes. Demonstrated experience owning and scaling GTM technology ecosystems, with deep expertise in Salesforce and related revenue platforms. Durable Skills. title: Account Executive
description: Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world's largest in-line cloud security platform. We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world's hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.. Account Executive: Federal Government. The Zscaler Sales and Go-to-Market team is a global group of professionals who are passionate about delighting our customers, nurturing trusted partnerships, and sharing their expertise to drive a secure, cloud-enabled digital future and further cement our position as the world leader in cloud security. Sales, Customer Success, Sales Enablement, Solution Architects, Business Development, Transformation, and Technology Partnerships all work together to demonstrate the power and agility of Zscaler cloud transformation to the world. We're looking for an experienced Account Executive to join our Federal Government Sales team. Reporting to the Managing Director, Public Sector, you will be responsible for:. Handle the differences between Chrome, Firefox, and Safari behind clean abstractions the rest of the team can rely on. Strong understanding of experimental design, failure analysis, regression testing, and quantitative evaluation. . This is a high-visibility, individual contributor role for a professional who thrives on product ownership, and high-stakes execution and works relentlessly to provide operations and engineering with 'best in class quality' and commercial terms, while also leveraging emerging AI tools and technologies. This position reports to the Director of Supply Base Management and will be based at our corporate headquarters in Santa Clara, CA. . Key Responsibilities. Supplier & Relationship Management: Lead executive-level commercial engagements, contract negotiations, and quarterly business reviews (QBRs) with key semiconductor suppliers in IC Switch, CPUs, FPGAs and other key silicon. Strategic Cost Architecture: Structure high-impact pricing models, should-cost roadmaps, and NRE investments to optimize total cost of ownership. Supply Continuity & Risk Mitigation: Partner with supply planning to secure long-term allocation, drive alternate-sourcing strategies and strategic inventory initiatives to ensure supply resiliency. Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate closely with hardware engineering, silicon engineering, quality, and legal teams on leading silicon sourcing strategies that align to our next-generation hardware roadmap and the overall semiconductor market. Market Intelligence: Serve as the subject matter expert for industry technology roadmaps and emerging technologies (e.g. advanced silicon nodes and 2.5D/3D packaging), geopolitical risks, and industry capacity trends, and advise leadership on sourcing risks and opportunities. . As a Principal AI Researcher, you will advance the cybersecurity capabilities of large language models and autonomous AI agents by combining security research, rigorous evaluation, and applied LLM post-training. . You will develop high-quality security data, realistic training and evaluation environments, reliable graders, and post-training methods for complex cybersecurity tasks spanning vulnerability research, threat analysis, detection, investigation, remediation, secure coding, and autonomous security workflows. . You will work across security research, machine learning, and research engineering to identify model capability gaps and translate real-world cybersecurity problems into measurable model improvements. . Your Impact. Design reproducible training and evaluation environments for complex cybersecurity tasks, including vulnerability research, threat analysis, detection, investigation, remediation, secure coding, and autonomous security workflows. . Transform source-code repositories, vulnerabilities, security incidents, malware samples, threat intelligence, detection logic, patches, test harnesses, and security tools into structured tasks for LLMs and AI agents. . Build reliable graders, verifiers, and reward signals using tests, compilation, runtime behavior, security-tool outputs, detection results, vulnerability reproduction, and other domain-specific validation methods. . Design evaluations for security reasoning, code understanding, threat analysis, root-cause analysis, tool use, long-horizon execution, and autonomous task completion. . Analyze model failures, data quality issues, grader weaknesses, reward hacking, benchmark overfitting, and capability regressions. . Develop and evaluate post-training methods, including supervised fine-tuning, preference optimization, reinforcement learning, reward modeling, rejection sampling, and distillation. . Build iterative model-improvement loops using model rollouts, verifier feedback, expert review, synthetic data generation, and failure-driven data collection. . Conduct controlled experiments with appropriate baselines, ablations, and regression testing. . Collaborate with Security Researchers, ML Engineers, infrastructure teams, and product teams to move research into production capabilities. . Qualifications. Your Experience. . Licensing Engineering & Technical Integration Strategy - an organization within IT Business Applications responsible for Palo Alto Networks' end-to-end licensing, entitlement, and integration engineering programs. We own the systems and architecture that power how our products are monetized, provisioned, and delivered across our entire Quote-to-Cash and Opportunity-to-Cash lifecycle. . Job Summary. As the Principal IT Solution Architect - NPI & Integration, you will be one of two principal architects responsible for the technical integration architecture across our entire Opportunity-to-Cash (O2C) flow. Working alongside your peer architect, you will own the solution strategy, L2 architectural design, and intelligent automation of our E2E NPI processes spanning Salesforce CPQ, SAP, and custom provisioning/licensing engines. . This is not a traditional architecture role. You will apply a "Design-First" first-principles mindset to embed intelligent automation, predictive analytics, and generative AI/LLM agentic workflows into our core Configure, Price, Quote (CPQ), billing, and licensing pipelines. You will own end-to-end technical execution of complex NPI monetization models, producing formal architecture artifacts that the execution team builds from. . You will serve as the strategic and technical bridge between core business monetization strategies and engineering execution - designing how our enterprise systems cohesively integrate and exchange data, while ensuring every integration pattern is reusable, scalable, and machine-readable for our AI SDLC framework. . This is an in office role in our HQ, Santa Clara, CA 3 days/week. . Key Responsibilities. . Integration Architecture & NPI Design. - Own end-to-end L2 technical system architecture for complex New Product Introductions across the full O2C flow (SFDC CPQ, SAP, licensing, provisioning, billing). - Produce formal, reviewable architecture diagrams (Business, Data, Application, Physical layers) that engineering teams build from. - Design scalable integrations that balance business velocity with rigorous financial and technical standards. - Establish and maintain architecture-as-code practices so designs remain current and machine-readable. . AI & Intelligent Automation. - Architect the transformation of E2E Q2C workflows using emerging AI capabilities. - Design architectures utilizing Large Language Models (LLMs) and Agentic frameworks to automate complex validations, data transformations, and process orchestration. - Contribute to the organization's AI Context Brain - embedding architecture knowledge into our AI SDLC framework. - Prototype AI-driven contract testing approaches to decouple dev-integration testing from upstream dependencies. . Enterprise Integration & Cross-Team Orchestration. - Design holistic integration strategies across our enterprise software stack (Salesforce, SAP, custom engines). - Define API contracts and interface specifications with upstream/downstream systems. - Work with NPI execution teams to ensure designs are executable, testable, and meet readiness gates. - Coordinate with external teams (SFDC, SAP, other IT orgs) on dependencies and integration patterns. . Data Modeling & Financial Integrity. - Map complex, multi-tiered data flows across systems. - Design data validation and reconciliation patterns across system boundaries. . Technical Leadership. - Lead technical design reviews with engineering and development teams. - Proactively identify dependencies, risks, and synergies across technical domains. - Elevate the technical capabilities of engineers on the NPI execution team through design guidance and architectural mentorship. - Develop proof-of-concepts for novel technical integrations and automation workflows. . . Qualifications. Required Qualifications. . Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical discipline. . 10+ years of professional experience in enterprise solution architecture, integration architecture, or technical product development. . Deep technical understanding of Quote-to-Cash (Q2C) and Opportunity-to-Cash (O2C) lifecycles with hands-on experience designing integrations across these domains. . Strong technical proficiency in Salesforce CRM/CPQ - understanding data models, API patterns, triggers, and complex configuration/amendment scenarios. . Demonstrated experience producing formal L2 architecture documentation (not just whiteboard sketches - artifacts that engineering teams build from). . Deep expertise in API architectures (RESTful, GraphQL, event-driven), JSON/XML, and modern integration patterns. . Strong background in database design, data modeling, and multi-system data flow mapping. . Ability to read, write, and debug code (Python, Java, Node.js, or Apex) to lead hands-on technical design sessions and build working prototypes. . Exceptional analytical skills with demonstrated comfort navigating ambiguity and converting abstract product monetization concepts into robust system architectures. . Highly self-directed - proven ability to independently own complex technical workstreams without close supervision. . Preferred Qualifications. Experience with AI/ML technologies, particularly LLMs and agentic frameworks, applied to enterprise process automation. . Experience with SAP integration patterns (billing, revenue recognition, financial flows). . Background in SaaS/subscription business models, cybersecurity, or enterprise software companies. . Experience with FedRAMP or compliance-regulated environments. . Familiarity with architecture-as-code practices and keeping designs in sync with running systems. . Experience mentoring or technically guiding teams of 5-15 engineers on architectural decisions. . Compensation Disclosure. . You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Summary. . As a member of the Cloud Native Security Services team you'll work directly with Idira (formerly CyberArk) customers to understand, plan, and implement complex product use cases across business critical environments.. Our team has a long history as Cloud and Kubernetes consultants, with our customers' needs central to our success. Today we continue that work within Idira, bringing our industry expertise to help customers realise the value they need from our products, whilst informing future releases with direct insights from the field.. We are a remote first team with no current expectation to travel on a regular basis. We like to meet in-person as often as we can, with opportunities to come to the London office roughly once a month, and bigger team meet-ups planned a few times a year.. Currently we're working with Idira Secrets Management, Workload Identity, and Agentic Security product teams; developing custom integrations and navigating complex deployment environments, whilst acting as the customers embedded product and domain subject matter experts.. Where others specialise in fast and efficient product enablement, we target the most complex customer environments and use cases, requiring both broad and deep industry and domain experience. We prefer to work directly with customer teams, collaborating with stakeholders across operations, security and engineering teams.. We care deeply about fostering a diverse team of individuals and encourage all to apply, even if you're unsure of your qualifications or fit. We would love to hear from you and appreciate you taking the time to apply.. The Role. As a Senior Cloud Native Security Architect you will repeatedly face new and difficult challenges. Your ability to remain composed and collaborative, whilst you work with your team to find solutions will be the biggest determining factor in your success in the role. Perfect execution is never our target; instead we aim to leave the customer closer to their goals and further from ambiguity, all whilst providing an exceptional customer experience.. You will be expected to:. Lead customer engagements incl. scoping work, directing other team members, acting as the primary point of contact for project stakeholders, running calls and workshops, and providing regular project updates.. Pro-actively initiate and contribute to internal initiatives.. Consistently apply (and confidently speak on) cloud security best practices. Actively engage in team/group level strategy and goal setting activities.. Act as a peer mentor to your fellow team members. incl. providing regular feedback for personal and professional development.. . You will succeed in this role if you:. Are comfortable working directly with customer stakeholders at all levels (i.e. senior management - individual contributors). . Are able to effectively empathise with and translate between stakeholders across different domains (i.e. infosec, operations, product R&D, senior leadership). . Enjoy working in complex (and often ambiguous) problem domains. Helping customers determine what they actually want and need, then designing and implementing pragmatic solutions to get them there. . Show up to calls with empathy, patience, positivity, and the desire to collaborate towards shared goals. . Easily move between different levels of abstraction (high level architecture and solution design - implementation detail and configuration). . Enjoy learning and can quickly become a subject matter expert in previously unfamiliar domains. . Inspire confidence and restore calm in otherwise tense or strained situations (i.e. managing unhappy customer stakeholders and high impact service outages). . Approach challenges pragmatically, preferring actions that produce meaningful customer value over polish and philosophical alignment. . Qualifications. . The Tech. . We work with an extremely broad range of tools and technologies, mostly cloud centric, and often open source (i.e. CNCF projects). As such, we often take on work in domains where we're not yet experts, and instead must learn what's needed in the moment, relying on a set of foundational best practices to guide us. . That said, there are a few technologies that come up time and time again for which hands-on experience and a good understanding proves extremely valuable. . These are in approximate order of importance:. Kubernetes - self-managed (Openshift, K3s, etc.) and cloud managed (GKE, Autopilot, EKS, etc.). . Container runtimes (Docker / containerd / podman). . SPIFFE / SPIRE (for workload identity). . Linux / Unix operating systems (RHEL / Rocky Linux / Ubuntu / Debian). . Cloud networking (VPCs, firewalls,network peering, VPNs). . Cloud IAM (predominantly GCP and AWS). . Cloud databases (Cloud SQL, Spanner, DynamoDB, Bigtable, etc.). . Golang / Python (for gluing services and deployment scripting). . Terraform / Crossplane / Config Connector (GCP) / CloudFormation (AWS) (for deploying and managing cloud infrastructure). . Git (for source control). . Github Actions / Jenkins (for CI). . Argo CD / Flux (for CD). . Vault / Conjur (for secrets management). . We don't expect candidates to be experts in all of these, but a strong foundation of security best practices, and a working knowledge of Kubernetes and the major cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, etc.) will be essential. Experience with any of the others is a huge advantage. . Once again, we encourage you to apply if this work sounds at all interesting to you. We have the ability to offer positions at lower levels if we think the fit is good but your experience needs development. We have capacity in the team to mentor and would always prefer an enthusiastic candidate and a great team fit than lots of experience but a poor fit. . We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you're ready to do the most meaningful work of your career alongside people who are just as passionate as you are, you're in the right place.. Who We Are. . In order to be the cybersecurity partner of choice, we must trailblaze the path and shape the future of our industry. This is something our employees work at each day and is defined by our values: Disruption, Collaboration, Execution, Integrity, and Inclusion. We weave AI into the fabric of everything we do and use it to augment the impact every individual can have. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!. This role is remote, but distance is no barrier to impact. Our hybrid teams collaborate across geographies to solve big problems, stay close to our customers, and grow together. You will be part of a culture that values trust, accountability, and shared success where your work truly matters. Job Summary. . Our Mission. At Palo Alto Networks® everything starts and ends with our mission:. Being the cybersecurity partner of choice, protecting our digital way of life. We have the vision of a world where each day is safer and more secure than the one before. These aren't easy goals to accomplish - but we're not here for easy. We're here for better. We are a company built on the foundation of challenging and disrupting the way things are done, and we're looking for innovators who are as committed to shaping the future of cybersecurity as we are. We're changing the nature of work. Palo Alto Networks is evolving to meet the needs of our employees now and in the future through FLEXWORK, our approach to how we work. From benefits to learning, location to leadership, we've rethought and recreated every aspect of the employee experience at Palo Alto Networks. And because it FLEXes around each individual employee based on their individual choices, employees are empowered to push boundaries and help us all evolve, together. . Your Career. . The Major Account Manager partners with our customers to secure their entire digital experience. You're motivated by the desire to solve critical challenges facing our customer's secure environment, so you're prepared to connect them with a solution for every stage of threat prevention. This role is a significant driver of company revenue and growth. As an experienced and dynamic sales professional, you're responsible for leading and driving sales engagements. Palo Alto Networks is leading the charge in platformization, offering best-in-breed solutions that enable customers to build a truly zero-trust security architecture and navigate critical transformations. To ensure our sales team is equipped to guide customers, we've developed FLIGHT, an immersive onboarding program. Flight blends virtual and in-person learning at our headquarters, where new sales hires will participate in dynamic cohorts, fully dedicated to their training without customer distractions. This focused approach ensures they emerge as well-prepared sales professionals, ready to help customers leverage our comprehensive portfolio. . Your Impact. As a Major Account Manager, you will drive and orchestrate large complex sales cycles and work with our internal partners and teams to best serve the customer. . Your consultative selling experience will identify business challenges and create solutions for prospects and our customers. Understand the competitive landscape and customer needs so you can effectively position the portfolio of Palo Alto Networks solutions. . Create clear goals and complete accurate forecasting through developing a detailed territory plan. . Leverage prospect stories to create a compelling value proposition with insights into value for that specific account. . Stay updated on industry news and trends, and how they affect Palo Alto Networks products and services. . Travel as necessary within your territory, and to company-wide meetings. . Qualifications. Your Experience. Experience and knowledge of SaaS-based architectures, ideally in a networking and/or security industry. . Demonstrated experience selling complex solutions, value selling, and/or consultative sales techniques. . Technical aptitude for understanding how technology products and solutions solve business problems. . Identifies problems, reviews data, determines the root causes, and provides scalable solutions. . Cultivate relationships with our channel partners to bring channel-centric go-to-market approach for our customers. . Demonstrates in depth knowledge of the full sales cycle and the ability to follow a structured sales process. . Ability to take a holistic approach to problem solving by understanding the bigger picture, and considering complex interrelationships and outcomes. . Excellent time management skills, and work with high levels of autonomy and self-direction. . Compensation Disclosure. . The compensation offered for this position will depend on qualifications, experience, and work location. For candidates who receive an offer at the posted level, the starting base salary (for non-sales roles) or base salary + commission target (for sales/com-missioned roles) is expected to be the annual range listed below. The offered compensation may also include restricted stock units and a bonus. A description of our employee benefits may be found here .. $264,000.00 - $363,000.00/yr. Our Commitment. . We're trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity's status quo. It's simple: we can't accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.. We are committed to providing reasonable accommodations for all qualified individuals with a disability. If you require assistance or accommodation due to a disability or special need, please contact us at accommodations@paloaltonetworks.com .. Palo Alto Networks is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity in our workplace, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran status, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or other legally protected characteristics.. All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.. Is role eligible for Immigration Sponsorship? No. Please note that we will not sponsor applicants for work visas for this position. . Motor-Vehicle Requirement: This role may require travel to and from Palo Alto Networks, Inc. business meetings and events and requires reliable transportation to do so. If a hire chooses to drive in connection with company business, the hire for this role must maintain a valid driver's license.

This is a highly visible, senior level position in the customer engineering team that will benefit from out of box thinking and technical insight.
