Principal Mobile Engineer. AI-Native Cloud Platform. Team: Mobile Platform Team. Reports to: Sr. Director of R&D, Cloud Platform. Location: [Gurgaon / Hybrid]. About the role. Payoneer is investing in the next generation of its mobile application: lightweight, high-performance, and designed as a platform that lets product teams contribute features independently while the app remains coherent, fast, and stable as a whole. The host application will provide the common foundations - observability, logging, navigation, identity, networking, feature flags, release tooling, automation - and product teams will plug into it through a clear contribution model. We are hiring two Principal Mobile Engineers to define and build this foundation alongside the existing mobile team. Together you will own the tech stack decision - native iOS and Android, Flutter, React Native or a hybrid - and you will shape the platform every product team at Payoneer ships mobile features on top of. The two-Principal structure gives us the capacity to build the platform properly, and the optionality to specialize one Principal per native platform if we go that route. What you'll own. You will own the tech stack decision and the rationale behind it. You will run the evaluation - native (Swift / Kotlin) vs Flutter vs React Native vs hybrid - against real constraints: performance, binary size, hiring market, team contribution model, build and release velocity, long-term maintenance cost. You will make the call jointly with your peer Principal and you will be expected to defend it under scrutiny from engineering, product, and executive leadership. You will build the host application foundation. The architecture, the module boundaries, the navigation and lifecycle model, the dependency injection approach, the state management patterns, the threading and concurrency model, the network stack, the persistence layer, the observability and logging backbone, the release and rollout machinery, the testing strategy at every level of the pyramid. Every product team's first impression of mobile at Payoneer will be the abstractions you ship. You will define the contribution model that product teams use to deliver features into the host app. Module boundaries, public API surface, lifecycle hooks, dependency policy, build and integration patterns, version compatibility, and the developer experience that makes contributing a feature fast and contributing a bad one hard. You will own the standards every contributing team writes against. You will own performance, binary size, startup time, frame rate, memory, and battery as first-class engineering disciplines with measured budgets and gates. You will own crash-free rate and stability as platform commitments. You will own the CI/CD, signing, release, and rollout pipeline for the app, and the observability that makes a production issue debuggable in minutes rather than days. You will partner with the Application Foundations Crew and the Cloud Platform Base, DevEx, and Network and Security teams to make sure mobile integrates cleanly with the platform - APIs, events, identity, secrets, automation and the shift-left controls that apply on the mobile side as much as the server side. You will partner with product engineering across the company to bring contributing teams into the platform and keep them productive in it. What we're looking for. You have ten or more years of mobile engineering experience and you have built mobile applications from the ground up - not joined them, not iterated on them, but defined the foundation and shipped it to production at scale. You have an honest, scarred view of what mobile platform decisions cost three years after you make them. You are deeply expert in at least one of iOS or Android, and seriously fluent in the other. On iOS that means Swift, the Swift concurrency model, UIKit and SwiftUI, the Apple toolchain and release process, and the parts of the ecosystem most engineers learn the hard way. On Android that means Kotlin, coroutines and Flow, the Android lifecycle, Jetpack and Compose, Gradle in earnest, RxJava where it still lives, and the same hard-won understanding of the ecosystem. You understand the cross-platform landscape with the same honesty. You have an opinion on Flutter, KMP, and React Native that goes beyond preference - performance characteristics, ceiling, where each shines, where each fails - and you can defend the recommendation you would make for a fintech app at Payoneer's scale. You have built and operated a modular mobile platform before, or something close enough that you understand the trade-offs: how to define module boundaries that survive ten product teams contributing in parallel, how to keep the host app coherent when contributors disagree, how to version a contribution model without breaking everyone, and how to keep the binary lean as the surface grows. You think in budgets and measurements. You have driven startup time, frame rate, binary size, and crash-free rate as numbers on a dashboard. You understand mobile observability at a level beyond crash reporting, and you have shipped the instrumentation needed to debug productio. You communicate clearly with engineers, product partners, and executives. You can write a one-page architecture proposal, run an RFC that actually converges, demo what you built so other engineers want to use it, and explain a stack decision to a CPO in language they care about. You handle disagreement well - including with your peer Principal - and you know how to land a joint decision. Nice to have. Experience integrating AI capabilities into mobile applications - on-device models, conversational and agent UI patterns, latency-sensitive AI features, and the privacy and offline considerations that come with them - is a strong plus, given Payoneer's AI-native platform direction. Why this role matters. The mobile app is the surface Payoneer customers touch after Web. The foundation you build will compound for years. You will have unusual scope to define what good looks like for Payoneer, and credibly for the industry, at the point where regulated payments, mobile engineering at scale, and AI-native development converge. About Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM). Payoneer Workforce Management (WFM) is Payoneer's global workforce solutions business, helping companies hire, onboard, pay, and manage talent anywhere in the world. The business enables organizations to build international teams quickly and compliantly without the need to establish legal entities in every country where they hire. As remote and distributed workforces become increasingly common, companies face challenges related to employment compliance, payroll, benefits administration, contractor management, and local labor regulations. Payoneer WFM simplifies these complexities through technology-enabled workforce solutions and in-country expertise. What We Do: Payoneer WFM provides end-to-end solutions that help businesses:. Employer of Record (EOR): A key offering within WFM is Employer of Record (EOR). Under the EOR model, Payoneer WFM becomes the legal employer of an individual in their local country while the client company manages the employee's day-to-day responsibilities, goals, and performance. The Strategic Account Director is a new-business, quota-carrying hunter responsible for landing the largest, most complex enterprise logos in the market. You own the full pursuit - from target identification and outbound generation through multi-threaded, committee-driven sales cycles to signed, revenue-producing contracts. Your prospects run cross-border volume at scale, they are today served by incumbent banks or specialist fintechs, and displacing that incumbent is the job. This is a role for someone who is energized by the chase: building conviction where none exists, getting into the CFO's and Treasurer's office cold, orchestrating a pursuit team through a long and technical evaluation, and closing seven-figure relationships. You set the bar for how strategic new business gets won at Payoneer. This is a strategic role. It is deliberately seated centrally under Global Sales so the strategic-accounts motion can be built, proven, and standardized before ownership is distributed to the regions. You will work hand in hand with regional heads of sales for in-market coordination and, over time, help shape how this function scales across the field.. What You'll Do. . Hunt and land net-new strategic accounts. Own a new-business quota. Identify, prioritize, and pursue the highest-value target accounts in your territory (typically $500K+/month cross-border volume, up to $10M+/month strategic targets) and convert them into signed, funded customers. Generate your own pipeline. Build top-of-funnel through disciplined, research-led outbound - direct executive outreach, referrals, partner and ecosystem channels, and events. Do not wait for leads; create them. Break into the buying committee cold. Get in front of and build conviction with CFOs, Treasurers, Finance Operations, and Compliance/Risk leaders at target accounts. Multi-thread deliberately so a deal never rests on a single contact. Displace the incumbent. Position Payoneer's speed, global coverage, economics, and platform breadth to unseat incumbent banks and specialist competitors. Run competitive displacement plays and build the business case that moves an entrenched buyer. Own complex, long-cycle deals end to end. Drive multi-stakeholder, technical, compliance-sensitive evaluations from first meeting to close. Own the mutual close plan, procurement, legal, and commercial negotiation. Sell the platform. Lead with value, not features. Land the entry wedge and architect the deal to open cross-border payments plus high-value services (Capital, Treasury/FX, Embedded/Platform Payments, Workforce/EOR, and emerging rails) - maximizing initial contract value and expansion potential. Qualify with discipline. Apply Payoneer's Sandler-based methodology - Up-Front Contracts, Pain Funnel, budget and decision qualification - to every pursuit so you invest team resources only in winnable, real deals. Orchestrate the pursuit team. Direct Solutions/Pre-Sales, Product Specialists, Compliance, and RevOps as a coordinated deal team through the sales cycle, and quarterback executive sponsorship where needed. Forecast honestly and close on time. Own a credible, hygienic pipeline and forecast in CRM. Drive deals to close dates and call your number straight. Set up the win for the long term. Land with a clean handoff to Customer Success and a clear expansion thesis, so every logo you close becomes a growth account.. . Who You Are. 8+ years in enterprise B2B sales with a strong bias toward new business / new logo acquisition - not primarily account management or renewals. Consistent, demonstrable record of hitting or exceeding a new-business quota on complex, high-value deals. Proven ability to self-generate pipeline through outbound and to break into cold enterprise accounts at the executive level. Experience closing long-cycle, multi-stakeholder deals with meaningful (six- to seven-figure) contract value. Category and Keyword Performance: Build the category-level data model across Thomas's industrial verticals and identify under-monetized keyword inventory. Translate findings into expansion and pricing recommendations. Retention, Churn, and Win-Back Analytics: Build predictive churn models using propensity and velocity scoring. Develop cohort analyses to surface early retention signals and provide prioritized recommendations to sales, customer success, and product. AI-Powered Analytics and Experimentation: Apply AI and machine learning to build smarter pricing and retention models. Design and execute A/B tests across pricing and supplier engagement interventions. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. Bachelor's degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Statistics, Data Science, Applied Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering) with 7+ years of experience, OR Master's degree with 5+ years. 6 or more years in pricing analytics, yield management, or growth analytics at a marketplace, ad platform, or performance-based business. Direct experience with lead-gen, pay-per-lead, or auction-based pricing models is strongly preferred. Background in ad tech, programmatic advertising, marketplace monetization, or two-sided platform economics. Hands-on machine learning experience in a production environment, including classification, regression, and time series forecasting. You have built models that shipped, not just prototypes. Demonstrated experience building churn propensity models, velocity scoring, and cohort retention analysis. You know how to find risk early and translate it into action. Documented, specific revenue impact from analytical work you personally owned and delivered. description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is seeking a talented Mechanical Engineer to join our Generative AI and Geometric Integration team. In this role, you will apply your foundational knowledge of mechanical design, manufacturing processes, and 3D CAD data to support high-stakes strategic initiatives-specifically DFM AI + IQE integration. Working closely with our Data Science and Product teams, you will act as a hands-on domain expert to translate physical manufacturing constraints, 2D technical drawings, and 3D geometry into structured inputs that train and improve Xometry's proprietary AI engine. This position bridges the gap between traditional mechanical engineering and modern software automation, helping build a real-time digital thread directly inside our partner's ecosystem (NX, Designcenter, and Teamcenter). This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our Waltham, MA or North Bethesda, MD office location. How You'll Contribute. 1. Partnership Execution (DFM/IQE). Geometric Feature Analysis: Analyze native 3D CAD models to identify complex geometric topologies, specific features (such as deep pockets, complex threads, thin walls), and GD&T annotations to verify that Xometry's automated engine is reading them accurately. Integration Support: Assist in testing and validating the real-time manufacturability (DFM) and pricing feedback loops embedded directly within Siemens NX and Teamcenter workflows. 2. Hands-on AI Collaboration & Data Labeling. Engineering Ground-Truth: Partner daily with Data Scientists and Machine Learning engineers to provide the "ground-truth" engineering logic required to train Generative AI models. Multimodal Data Processing: Assist in creating, reviewing, and structured-labeling datasets from 2D technical drawings, PDFs, and purchase orders so the AI can learn to extract engineering data flawlessly. 3. DFM Rule Mapping & Testing. Manufacturing Logic Mapping: Help document and map standardized manufacturing constraints across various processes (CNC machining, sheet metal, 3D printing) into discrete rules for software consumption. Continuous Testing: Conduct regression testing on software outputs, comparing AI-generated pricing and lead times against real-world manufacturing metrics to spot errors and improve performance. 4. Cross-Functional Coordination. Day-to-Day Alignment: Work as a reliable technical point of contact across internal engineering, operations, and external partner development tracks to keep the integration milestones on schedule. What You'll Bring to Xometry. Experience & Education. Experience: 2-5+ years of hands-on experience in mechanical design, manufacturing engineering, or a closely related industrial environment. Education: Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical discipline is required. Technical Skills. CAD Proficiency: Solid working knowledge of enterprise CAD/PLM systems. Direct experience using Siemens NX and Teamcenter is a major plus. Manufacturing & GD&T Basics: Strong foundational understanding of standard manufacturing methods (particularly multi-axis CNC milling/turning and sheet metal fabrication) and a clear ability to interpret ASME Y14.5 GD&T prints. Software/Scripting Familiarity: Comfortable working in a tech-forward software environment. Basic proficiency in Python or a strong willingness to learn it for automated data analysis and geometric manipulation is highly desired. Communication & Interpersonal Skills. Collaboration: Strong capability to communicate technical engineering concepts clearly to non-mechanical peers, such as software developers and data scientists. title: Procurement Analyst
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is seeking a detail-oriented, technically skilled Procurement Analyst to support our Procurement Excellence team in executing the Partner RFQ (Request for Quote) initiative. This role is critical to converting strategic, high-value manufacturing opportunities into orders by identifying the optimal partners, negotiating competitive pricing, and driving continuous improvement in the Partner RFQ process. As Procurement Analyst, you will be the technical executor behind our pre-sourcing strategy. You'll analyze customer engineering drawings and CAD files to determine manufacturing feasibility, identify the best-fit partners from our pre-vetted network (50+ partners), and negotiate competitive pricing that balances partner margins with Xometry's profitability goals. Your technical manufacturing knowledge, analytical skills, and strategic business acumen will directly impact cost reduction, margin improvement, and revenue capture on strategic opportunities. How You'll Contribute. RFQ Execution & Technical Partner Selection:. Execute the operational end-to-end Partner RFQ process, from opportunity identification through bid collection, award decision, and relay of feedback to partners. Analyze customer engineering drawings, CAD files, and step files to assess manufacturability and identify technical requirements (e.g. tolerances, materials, finishes, inspections, etc.). Evaluate partner capabilities against specific job requirements and determine which pre-vetted partners are best-fit candidates (e.g. capability, capacity, lead time, and strategic fit). Distribute RFQs to identified partners with clear specifications, technical drawings, and quote requirements. Track bid submissions and manage communication with partners to ensure timely response and clarification of technical or commercial questions. Technical Analysis & Manufacturing Strategy:. Leverage your manufacturing and engineering expertise to evaluate design feasibility and assess manufacturability of customer parts. Apply knowledge of CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication processes (including capabilities, material selections, post-processing options, and cost drivers) to work collaboratively with manufacturing partners in identifying cost-reduction strategies and manufacturing alternatives. Partner with manufacturers to explore process options, material substitutions, or manufacturing approaches that can lower total cost while meeting customer specifications and quality requirements. Communicate technical requirements and design constraints clearly to partner manufacturers to ensure accurate quoting and reduce back-and-forth iterations. Review partner technical proposals and manufacturing approaches to validate capability and identify any manufacturability risks or concerns. Bid Evaluation & Award Strategy. Evaluate and compare partner bids across multiple dimensions: cost competitiveness, technical capability, capacity, lead time, quality track record, and strategic fit with Xometry's goals. Analyze competitive bids to identify pricing outliers, validate cost assumptions, and challenge high quotes with technical or strategic alternatives. Negotiate pricing and commercial terms directly with partners to optimize Xometry margins while maintaining competitive partner pricing and partner satisfaction. Award bids to selected partners based on total value analysis to maximize profitability and strategic benefit for Xometry. Build and maintain strong relationships with partners, positioning yourself as a trusted technical resource and fair negotiator. Bid Analysis & Data-Driven Insights:. Track and maintain comprehensive bid data for all RFQs, including bid count, pricing by partner, win rates, and lead times. Leverage analytics dashboards and reports created by our Analytics counterparts to monitor partner performance trends, identify underperforming partners, and recognize market opportunities. Generate insights from bid analysis to inform partner strategy, negotiate improved pricing, and identify partners best suited for specific opportunity types. Monitor key performance indicators (bid participation rate, win rate, cost reduction achieved, margin improvement) to assess program health and individual partner contribution. Process Improvement & Optimization:. Identify bottlenecks, inefficiencies, and friction points in the RFQ process based on day-to-day execution and partner feedback. Gather partner feedback on process pain points, turnaround times, clarity of RFQ submissions, and technical requirements. Collaborate with product, operations, and finance teams to test and implement process improvements that accelerate RFQ bid cycles, improve bid quality, and enhance partner experience. Document and standardize best practices, quoting approaches, and negotiation strategies to ensure consistency and scalability across the partner network. What You Bring To Xometry. Bachelor's degree required in Manufacturing Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related technical field. 3-5 years of professional experience in manufacturing engineering, manufacturing operations, supply chain, or procurement roles. Strong technical foundation in manufacturing processes, specifically CNC machining and sheet metal fabrication (tolerances, material selection, equipment capabilities, process sequencing, cost drivers). Proficiency reading and interpreting engineering drawings, CAD models, and step files; understanding of GD&T (Geometric Dimensioning & Tolerancing) required. Experience with CAD software (SolidWorks preferred) or CAM software is a plus. Design for Manufacturability (DFM) experience is a plus but not required. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with comfort working with data, spreadsheets, and metrics. Advanced proficiency in Excel, including pivot tables, VLOOKUP, and data visualization. Excellent negotiation skills and ability to balance business objectives with partner relationships. Strong organizational and project management skills with ability to manage multiple RFQs and partners concurrently. Clear written and verbal communication skills with ability to present technical and commercial recommendations to diverse audiences. Detail-oriented with strong attention to accuracy and data integrity in a fast-paced, high-volume environment. Ability to work collaboratively across functions (Sales, Finance, Operations, Analytics) and with external partners. Familiarity with procurement or supplier relationship management systems is a plus. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $89,000 to $118,000 annually depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. #LI-Hybrid. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . At Thomas, we're revolutionizing the manufacturing industry with our cutting-edge omni-channel growth marketing strategies. With a remarkable 125-year legacy in the business, we're now expanding our client-facing Growth Marketing team to serve our most upper-tier customers. As a Senior Digital Marketing Account Manager you will serve as the primary POC for our mid market clients to develop full funnel growth strategies with a focus on user acquisition, attribution and nurturing. How You'll Contribute:. Serve as the primary point of contact for a portfolio of clients and cultivate strong and trusted partnerships with each of them. Develop, present, and implement holistic growth marketing strategies that align with client goals, covering aspects like user acquisition, conversion, and revenue growth. Partner with cross-functional teams to execute multi channel marketing campaigns that ensure alignment with client expectations, and deliver on ROI. Define lead scoring attributes and identify opportunities for our customers to capitalize on. Lead weekly or biweekly client calls to review program KPIs, deliverable updates, and program progress. Leverage data analytics to uncover actionable insights, identify trends, and make informed recommendations to optimize marketing campaigns continually. Address clients' questions or concerns about the performance of their program and provide strategic and tactical solutions. Partner with Sales to offer a holistic service that can lead to increased revenue. Travel to meet with clients in-person to strengthen partnerships and gain a deeper understanding of their business. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. Proven experience (4+ years) in a growth marketing or digital strategy role. 2+ years experience in a client-facing position or agency experience. Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business or related field preferred. In-depth knowledge of digital marketing best practices (organic, paid, social email, ABM), analytics tools (GA4, GSC, HubSpot), and how to leverage a marketing technology stack. Outstanding communication and people skills. Some nice-to-have experience:. B2B and/or industrial/manufacturing industry knowledge. Experience using SEO tools (e.g., SEMRush, AHRefs, Google Ads, Optmyzer, Google Search Console), LinkedIn analytics, Data Studio reporting from Google, A/B testing software, and/or chatbot plugins. Experience using marketing automation platform tools (e.g., HubSpot, Pardot, etc.). Certifications: Hubspot (email, Inbound), Google Analytics, Google Ads, and/or project management. . #LI-Hybrid. . The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $87,000 - $97,000 annually depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more.. title: Senior Manager, Automotive Programs
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Automotive is one of the most demanding and most valuable segments Xometry serves. Programs in this space carry multi-year horizons, unforgiving launch timing, and a quality bar defined by APQP, PPAP, and IATF-aligned customer requirements. Getting them right builds durable, high-volume production relationships. Getting them wrong is visible immediately. The Senior Manager, Automotive Programs owns Xometry's automotive program portfolio end to end. This leader is accountable both for growing the automotive book of business within existing accounts and for the disciplined execution of those programs from award through launch, PPAP, and steady-state supply. It is a dual mandate: build the pipeline and deliver on it. This role leads a team of program managers and works closely with the field-deployed engineering team, the Partner Network, Sales, and Quality. Success requires an automotive-native operator who can hold a customer program review on Monday, drive a supplier 8D on Tuesday, and coach a program manager through a launch risk on Wednesday. This role reports to the Director, Strategic Program Operations. How You'll Contribute:. Own the Automotive Program Portfolio. Own performance across Xometry's portfolio of automotive production programs against cost, quality, delivery, and growth objectives. Establish program governance, operating cadences, and customer review rhythms appropriate to automotive expectations. Maintain a consolidated view of automotive program loading, capacity commitments, and launch timing across the partner network. Lead risk identification, escalation, and mitigation across customer, partner, and internal teams. Report portfolio health to Xometry leadership and to customer program teams. Grow the Automotive Book of Business. Identify and develop new production program opportunities within existing automotive accounts, including OEMs and Tier 1 and Tier 2 suppliers. Partner with Sales and the field engineering team to qualify opportunities, shape the technical and commercial approach, and win awards. Build senior-level relationships with customer purchasing, program management, and supplier quality organizations. Translate customer sourcing roadmaps into a forward pipeline of Xometry opportunities. Own a defined growth target for the automotive segment. Drive Launch and Quality Execution. Own the APQP process from program award through tooling, validation, PPAP submission, run-at-rate, and customer start of production. Build and maintain program timelines covering tooling, sampling, tool tryout, validation, PPAP, and SOP milestones. Partner with Quality to execute PPAP requirements including PSW, control plans, process flow, PFMEA, MSA, and capability studies. Plan and manage safe-launch and GP12 requirements, customer-controlled shipping where applicable, and 8D corrective actions through closure. Support Xometry's quality management system obligations and participate in customer QMS audits and supplier assessments. Ensure operational readiness for production ramps, program transfers, and engineering change execution. Develop the Partner Base for Automotive Work. Work with the Partner Network and field engineering teams to identify and qualify partners capable of meeting automotive quality and volume requirements. Assess partner production readiness, capacity, and quality systems ahead of program placement. Drive partner performance against on-time delivery, PPM, and cost targets on automotive programs. Lead escalation and recovery when partner performance puts a customer commitment at risk. Build contingency and dual-source strategies for critical automotive programs. Lead and Develop the Team. Manage, coach, and develop a team of program managers supporting automotive programs. Set clear performance expectations, accountability frameworks, and development plans. Balance program assignments against team capacity and program criticality. Coach the team on customer management, launch discipline, and structured problem solving. Standardize automotive program management practices and build repeatable playbooks as the portfolio scales. What You'll Bring To Xometry:. Core Qualifications. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Business, or a related field. 8+ years of experience in automotive program management, launch, supplier quality, or manufacturing operations. 2+ years of direct people leadership experience, or demonstrated leadership of program teams. Working expertise in APQP, PPAP, PFMEA, control plans, MSA, SPC, and 8D problem solving. Strong understanding of IATF 16949 and customer-specific requirements. Demonstrated track record launching automotive programs from award through SOP. Experience managing supplier or contract manufacturer relationships and performance. How You Work. Credible with both a customer program director and a supplier's plant manager. Structured and data-driven, converting program signals into decisions before issues become escalations. Comfortable owning both a growth number and an execution scorecard without trading one for the other. Strong written and verbal communication, including executive-level presentation skills. Able to build the operating model while running it in a fast-moving environment. Location and Travel. Remote, with preference for candidates based in the Midwest or Southeast automotive corridors. Approximately 30-40% travel to customer and partner facilities. Must be a citizen or legal resident of the United States, or hold a visa that allows you to work in the United States without sponsorship. Preferred Qualifications. Prior experience at an automotive OEM or Tier 1 supplier. Experience with EV, battery, or lightweighting programs. Familiarity with ERP systems, PLM, and supply chain analytics tools. PMP, Six Sigma, or Lean certification. Experience in a high-mix contract manufacturing or manufacturing marketplace environment. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $108,000 - $140,000 annually + annual bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. #LI-Hybrid. Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. title: Senior Principal, ML/AI
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is seeking a Senior Principal, Machine Learning & Artificial Intelligence to join our team. You will serve as a technical leader for large, cross-functional ML/AI initiatives that have significant and lasting business impact. You will own and drive an 18- to 24-month technical roadmap that balances innovation with business value delivery. You will work closely with engineering, product, design, manufacturing operations, and business leadership to influence partner roadmaps and resourcing. You will be a respected subject-matter expert, proactively removing roadblocks for teams and tackling problems beyond your immediate scope. You will identify and lead on opportunities to drive revenue growth, cost reduction, efficiency improvement, and competitive differentiation - especially in areas involving 2D/3D part understanding, generative AI, and advanced machine-learning platforms. How You'll Contribute:. Serve as the technical leader of multiple large, cross-functional ML/AI solutions with significant, lasting impact across Xometry's business. Define, and drive the 18-24-month ML/AI technical roadmap - balancing breakthrough innovation (e.g., generative 3D, foundation models, large-scale vision/3D pipelines) with reliable business value delivery (e.g., quoting accuracy, lead-time reduction, defect detection, cost optimization. Influence partner roadmaps across engineering, product, operations, and business teams: align priorities, advise on resourcing, champion ML/AI best practices. Proactively identify and remove roadblocks for teams and projects - whether technical, operational, data-related, or resource constraints. Mentorship of individuals and technical teams. Act as a trusted SME with strong cross-functional partnerships: your insights and guidance will shape ML/AI infrastructure, data, model, infrastructure, and tooling decisions. Play a leadership role in identifying areas of opportunity - e.g., using ML/AI to unlock new revenue streams (e.g., rapid quoting for new manufacturing modalities, generative design for customers), reduce cost (e.g., automated quality inspection), or optimize efficiency (e.g., 3D-geometry classification, defect detection, generating manufacturing ready models). Address problems adjacent to your sphere of immediate influence: proactively tackle challenges outside direct scope and champion holistic solutions. Stay ahead of industry developments in ML, AI, generative AI, 2D/3D modeling and manufacturing tech; translate insights into the improvement of internal best practices, tooling, frameworks, model governance, data pipelines, and operationalization. Consistently scrutinize existing work, identify opportunities for incremental growth and efficiency optimization - whether in inference latency, model retraining intervals, feature pipelines, cost of compute, or automation of manual tasks. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. Master's or PhD in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Electrical Engineering or related field (PhD preferred for deep generative/3D modeling emphasis). 12+ years of professional experience in machine learning, artificial intelligence, or data science roles - with several years in senior or principal capacity leading major programs. Demonstrated experience architecting and delivering large scale ML/AI solutions - end-to-end from data ingestion, feature engineering, model training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring & operations. Deep expertise in machine learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch), data engineering, model infrastructure, MLOps, cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure), and scalable production systems. Experience in 3D modeling / geometry / computer vision / generative models (e.g., point-cloud processing, mesh processing, text23D, image23D, CAD/CAM integration) is highly desirable. Strong exposure to generative AI techniques (large language models, multimodal models, diffusion, GANs) and translating them into business use-cases. Excellent cross-functional collaboration skills: you can partner with product, engineering, ops, manufacturing, design, business leadership and translate technical concepts into business language. Proven ability to influence without direct authority and drive change across organizations. Strong communication and presentation skills; you can articulate technical vision, roadmap, trade-offs and outcomes to senior leadership. Track record of identifying and delivering measurable business impact via ML/AI - e.g., revenue growth, cost savings, improved efficiency. Experience mentoring and guiding teams of ML engineers / data scientists / AI researchers, shaping team culture, practices, and career growth. title: Senior Sales Operations Analyst
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Thomas, a Xometry company, is the leading platform for industrial sourcing and digital marketing. We help manufacturers grow their businesses through high-impact digital advertising, SEO, and content marketing services. This role is critical to maintaining the data integrity and lead flow that keeps our Sales and Marketing engines running at scale.. We're looking for a seasoned analytics leader to serve as a strategic partner to Sales leadership and the broader executive team, turning complex, ambiguous data into the insight that drives revenue decisions. In this role, you'll own the Sales analytics function end-to-end - architecting the dashboard and data ecosystem, building the quota and forecasting models the business runs on, and setting the standards other analysts follow. You'll operate with significant autonomy, work directly with VP- and C-level stakeholders, and be trusted to define what "the right metric" even is when the business question is still fuzzy. This is a high-visibility, high-ownership role for someone who pairs deep technical fluency with sharp business judgment and the gravitas to influence senior decision-makers.. How You'll Contribute:. Act as the primary analytics partner to Sales leadership and senior executives - proactively defining key metrics, surfacing strategic insights, and shaping decisions on quota, territory, headcount, and pipeline strategy. Independently translate ambiguous, open-ended business questions into structured analyses; identify the right question to ask when leadership hasn't fully defined it themselves. Own the architecture, roadmap, and governance of Sales dashboards and reporting infrastructure - not just maintenance, but decisions on what gets built, deprecated, or redesigned as the business scales. Design and continuously refine sales performance and quota models, incorporating historical trends, pipeline data, seasonality, and rep-level variance to drive quota setting, attainment tracking, and revenue forecasting at the leadership and board level. Build and evolve forecasting methodology, bringing statistical rigor (trend analysis, cohort analysis, scenario/sensitivity modeling) to what has historically been a more manual or gut-driven process. Set reporting standards and analytic best practices across the Sales analytics function; review and improve the work of other analysts, and mentor junior team members on technique, tooling, and stakeholder management. Proactively identify risks, anomalies, and opportunities in the data - surfacing them to leadership before they're asked for, not just answering the questions in front of you. Serve as the escalation point and liaison across Product, Marketing, Data Engineering, and Finance to resolve data discrepancies, align on definitions, and ensure a single source of truth across systems. Lead or significantly contribute to cross-functional data cleansing and data quality initiatives, including diagnosing root causes upstream in the CRM and data pipeline. Represent analytics in planning cycles (annual quota setting, territory design, comp plan discussions), advising on trade-offs with data-backed recommendations. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 5+ years of experience in Sales/Revenue Operations, Business Analytics, or a related analytics function, with a strong focus on sales analytics, forecasting, or GTM strategy. Advanced proficiency in SQL (complex joins, window functions, query optimization) and hands-on expertise in Looker and LookML, including data modeling and semantic layer design (not Looker Studio). Advanced Excel/Sheets skills for modeling - able to build and audit complex, multi-scenario financial and quota models from scratch. Deep familiarity with CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce) and a strong working knowledge of how sales data flows, breaks, and gets misreported across systems. Demonstrated track record of advising and influencing senior (VP/C-level) stakeholders using data - including pushing back constructively when the data tells a different story than leadership expects. Exceptional storytelling and executive communication skills; able to distill complex, multi-variable analysis into a clear narrative and recommendation for non-technical audiences. Strong statistical literacy - trend analysis, forecasting methods, and cohort analysis - with the judgment to know which technique fits which business question. Proven ability to independently source, assess, and prioritize data and competing asks in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment with shifting requirements. Experience owning an analytics roadmap or reporting infrastructure end-to-end, including making build-vs-deprecate decisions. Experience reviewing or mentoring the work of other analysts. Nice to Have:. Experience with dbt or a similar data transformation/modeling tool. Working knowledge of Python or R for statistical modeling beyond what Excel/SQL can support. Direct experience with sales quota design or compensation plan design. Experience presenting directly to executive leadership or a board. Experience partnering with Finance on revenue forecasting or annual planning cycles. Prior experience managing or dotted-line mentoring junior analysts. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $110,000- $120,000 annually + annual bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. #LI-Hybrid. #Promoted. . . . . . . AI Fluency: You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . The Senior Solutions Engineer, Injection Molding is a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, pairing technical depth with business acumen to propose solutions to real manufacturing problems. Working in tandem with the Sales team, you'll be the technical voice in the room - anticipating objections, building confidence in Xometry's capabilities, and helping customers get to the right manufacturing solution faster. How You'll Contribute:. Lead discovery conversations with Sales to uncover business and technical requirements and map them to Xometry solutions. Be the technical liaison between molding teams and the customer. Consult directly with prospects and customers to identify the right applications of Xometry's technology and build the business case. Demonstrate Xometry's capabilities, including our software quoting platform, in a way that resonates with both engineers and executives. Partner with product, sales, quoting, and engineering teams - feeding customer insight back into the business and contributing to case studies and marketing collateral. Represent Xometry as an industry thought leader at events, webinars, and in the injection molding community. Serve as the internal go-to expert on injection molding and related processes, helping the broader team speak credibly to customers about tooling, mold design, and process capability. Provide project management and oversight on complex opportunities. What You Bring To Xometry:. A genuine manufacturing and process background in injection molding, compression molding, overmolding, and insert molding - with hands-on, floor-level experience strongly preferred. An outgoing, personable communicator who's equally comfortable in a deep technical discussion with a mold designer and presenting to a room of executives. Technical empathy: the instinct to listen first, understand a customer's real problem (not just their stated request), and translate between technical and business language without losing either audience. Consultative by nature - always asking "why" before proposing "what". Experience preparing and presenting technical solutions within business proposals. Self-motivated and comfortable managing multiple long-term projects with minimal oversight in a fast-paced startup environment. Strong interpersonal skills and a natural relationship-builder. Engineering degree (Mechanical or Plastics preferred) or related technical degree. 5-7+ years of experience in an engineering, manufacturing, or technical field. Demonstrated project management and presentation skills. CAD and technical drawing experience. Demonstrated Expertise in some of the following areas: New Product Development, Materials Science, Plastics Engineering, GD&T, Mold Design, ISO Certifications, PPAP & Inspection. Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including mastery of English. Willingness to travel up to 20%. . #LI-Hybrid. Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. For US based roles: Xometry participates in E-Verify and after a job offer is accepted, will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S. .

title: Senior Technical Program Manager - Pricing and Manufacturability
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Role Overview. As the first individual-contributor hire in our nascent TPM organization, you will set the bar for program excellence across Product & Technology. You will architect, run, and continuously improve the operational frameworks that keep our highest-value initiatives on track from roadmap definition and cross-team execution to release management and post-launch optimization. Partnering closely with Engineering, Product, Design, Data Science / ML, and Business Operations, you will both deliver complex programs and shape what it means to be a TPM at the company. Initial Project. Xometry's Instant Quoting platform is the core of how buyers get a price, lead time, and manufacturability signal on a part. Pricing & Manufacturability (P&M) owns the engines and models behind that experience: Auto-Quote pricing and cost, Design for Manufacturability (DFM) / geometry analysis, Drawing AI (CAD and 2D drawing interpretation), and the ML models that predict cost, lead time, and drawing intelligence. The Sr. Technical Program Manager will work with senior leadership, engineering, product, data science, and business teams to deliver these capabilities end to end from model and service work through product integration, operations, and post-launch improvement. That includes coordinating how CAD models and drawings move through geometry, DFM, and Drawing AI services, how ML models are trained, evaluated, productionized, and monitored, and how those outputs show up as price, DFM feedback, and quoting decisions for buyers and staff. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our North Bethesda, MD or Waltham, MA office location. How You'll Contribute. Own end-to-end program management for the Pricing & Manufacturability portfolio, with initial focus on Auto-Quote pricing/cost, DFM, Drawing AI, and related ML model work. Drive program planning from concept through execution and post-launch analysis, including model evaluation, staged rollouts, and production monitoring. Partner with Engineering, Product, Data Science / ML, Operations, Sales, and Finance to set realistic goals, timelines, and milestones across engine, model, and product workstreams. Translate CAD/geometry, DFM, and Drawing AI work into a single sequenced plan clarifying what the models own, what product/UX owns, and where Buyer Experience, Pricing Experience, and P&M must handshake. Implement lightweight, rigorous project management processes that increase execution speed, transparency, and accountability across multi-squad, model-plus-product delivery. Lead risk management and mitigation model quality, data/labeling capacity, service latency, integration dependencies, and go-live readiness so blockers are visible before they slip dates. Collaborate with senior leadership to prioritize initiatives, sequence model vs. product work, and manage stakeholder expectations. Provide clear, concise, actionable communication on progress, risks, model/product trade-offs, and outcomes to executive teams. Drive continuous improvement in execution and process, using quoting, DFM, and model-quality data to inform decisions. Foster a high-performance culture across teams, keeping delivery aligned to company goals in a fast-paced, high-stakes environment. What You'll Bring to Xometry. Design and institutionalize lightweight but rigorous operating rhythms (intake, planning, risk management, status reporting, post-mortems) that scale with the business. Drive end-to-end execution of strategic, multi-team programs clarifying scope, aligning stakeholders, forecasting resources, and unblocking delivery. Serve as a senior thought partner to the Director of Technology Operations, codifying TPM best practices, mentoring future hires, and evolving the career ladder for the function. Act as a trusted communications hub, producing crisp executive readouts and facilitating decision-making forums that keep leadership focused on the right trade-offs. Champion continuous improvement by synthesizing lessons learned into updated playbooks, tooling, and training. You Would Be A Great Fit With. 10+ years of progressive experience in technical program management, engineering management, or product management, with at least three years leading cross-functional software initiatives of material business impact. Proven ability to create and scale operational processes in high-growth or transformation environments; start-up or "first-TPM-in" experience strongly preferred. Experience delivering programs that combine software platforms with ML/AI models in production (training, evaluation, deployment, monitoring, and product integration) or a demonstrated ability to partner closely with data science and ML engineering on that lifecycle. Deep understanding of modern SDLC practices (Agile, CI/CD, DevOps) and how to tailor them for speed, quality, and compliance; familiarity with ML delivery practices (experimentation, evaluation sets, staged rollout) is a plus. Exceptional stakeholder-management and influence skills from engineers, ML scientists, and product managers to C-level executives. Demonstrated mastery of program tooling (e.g., Jira, Google Sheets) and data-driven decision-making. Adept at balancing strategic thinking with hands-on execution; comfortable rolling up sleeves to remove blockers. Clear, concise communicator with a track record of producing executive-ready artifacts and leading high-stakes discussions. Experience with pricing engines, DFM / manufacturability, CAD/drawing intelligence, quoting platforms, or marketplace/adjacencies is a plus. Compensation & Benefits. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $135,000-$155,000 annually + bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. #LI-Hybrid. #Promoted. Xometry is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran, or disability status. You will own the design and engineering of our Isolated Recovery Environment, set the standard for Infrastructure as Code across the organization, and ensure that if our AWS environment is ever compromised, we can restore operations with certainty and speed. You will work with a high-caliber engineering team, have direct influence on our security architecture, and lead recovery exercises that test the organization end-to-end. How You'll Contribute:. Own Our Recovery Architecture. Design and build our Isolated Recovery Environment - a hardened AWS account with immutable vaults that break the attacker's kill chain before it reaches our data. Threat model our environment with a deep understanding of cloud-native attack patterns: IAM privilege escalation, backup deletion, ransomware persistence, and lateral movement across accounts. Validate and continuously improve backup configurations to ensure recoverability, not just existence. Standardize and Automate Infrastructure. Lead our transition to 100% Infrastructure as Code. Every asset (VPCs, IAM roles, security groups) must be defined in Terraform so we can redeploy the entire stack into a clean account via automated pipeline. Build automated recovery workflows that can tear down a compromised environment and bootstrap a fresh, hardened one from verified code and clean data. Write and maintain executable recovery playbooks that detail the exact API calls and CLI commands needed to restore the application - tested, versioned, and runnable, not static documents. Validate, Test, and Lead Exercises. Develop automated scripts (Python or Go) to smoke test recovered data and validate integrity post-restoration. Lead regular hands-on recovery drills that simulate total loss of a critical environment and full recovery into a secondary clean account. Own the after-action process and drive improvements. Drive Engineering Standards. Act as the resilience authority for the engineering organization - shaping high-availability architecture decisions, influencing design reviews, and raising the floor on how we think about recoverability. Partner with the Site Reliability Engineering team on multi-region deployments and high-availability design, ensuring cyber resilience is embedded in architecture from the start. Champion IaC and immutable infrastructure practices across teams, not just within your own workstream. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 8+ years of experience in complex cloud environments (any of AWS/GCP/Azure), including at least 3 years in AWS. EKS/Kubernetes experience is a strong plus. Strong Terraform skills. You should be able to modularize complex environments so they are environment-agnostic. Hands-on familiarity with the Secure Vault pattern: protecting data in a separate, highly restricted AWS account with tight network controls. Advanced shell scripting and proficiency in either Python or Go to automate restoration tasks that native AWS tooling doesn't cover. Experience with CI/CD tooling (Scalr, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) to enable broad adoption of recovery pipelines across the organization. Proven ability to engineer and automate end-to-end restoration workflows. Preferred:. Hands-on experience leading technical recovery efforts from an actual cyber attack or destructive incident. AWS Security Specialty certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise. title: Staff Cyber Resilience Engineer
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . We're looking for a Staff Cyber Resilience Engineer to lead our defense against the attacks that matter most: ransomware, destructive wipes, and data loss at scale. This is a hands-on technical leadership role. You will own the design and engineering of our Isolated Recovery Environment, set the standard for Infrastructure as Code across the organization, and ensure that if our AWS environment is ever compromised, we can restore operations with certainty and speed. You will work with a high-caliber engineering team, have direct influence on our security architecture, and lead recovery exercises that test the organization end-to-end. How You'll Contribute:. Own Our Recovery Architecture. Design and build our Isolated Recovery Environment - a hardened AWS account with immutable vaults that break the attacker's kill chain before it reaches our data. Threat model our environment with a deep understanding of cloud-native attack patterns: IAM privilege escalation, backup deletion, ransomware persistence, and lateral movement across accounts. Validate and continuously improve backup configurations to ensure recoverability, not just existence. Standardize and Automate Infrastructure. Lead our transition to 100% Infrastructure as Code. Every asset (VPCs, IAM roles, security groups) must be defined in Terraform so we can redeploy the entire stack into a clean account via automated pipeline. Build automated recovery workflows that can tear down a compromised environment and bootstrap a fresh, hardened one from verified code and clean data. Write and maintain executable recovery playbooks that detail the exact API calls and CLI commands needed to restore the application - tested, versioned, and runnable, not static documents. Validate, Test, and Lead Exercises. Develop automated scripts (Python or Go) to smoke test recovered data and validate integrity post-restoration. Lead regular hands-on recovery drills that simulate total loss of a critical environment and full recovery into a secondary clean account. Own the after-action process and drive improvements. Drive Engineering Standards. Act as the resilience authority for the engineering organization - shaping high-availability architecture decisions, influencing design reviews, and raising the floor on how we think about recoverability. Partner with the Site Reliability Engineering team on multi-region deployments and high-availability design, ensuring cyber resilience is embedded in architecture from the start. Champion IaC and immutable infrastructure practices across teams, not just within your own workstream. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 8+ years of experience in complex cloud environments (any of AWS/GCP/Azure), including at least 3 years in AWS. EKS/Kubernetes experience is a strong plus. Strong Terraform skills. You should be able to modularize complex environments so they are environment-agnostic. Hands-on familiarity with the Secure Vault pattern: protecting data in a separate, highly restricted AWS account with tight network controls. Advanced shell scripting and proficiency in either Python or Go to automate restoration tasks that native AWS tooling doesn't cover. Experience with CI/CD tooling (Scalr, GitHub Actions, or equivalent) to enable broad adoption of recovery pipelines across the organization. Proven ability to engineer and automate end-to-end restoration workflows. Preferred:. Hands-on experience leading technical recovery efforts from an actual cyber attack or destructive incident. Experience with chaos engineering tooling to stress-test recovery assumptions. Familiarity with NIST SP 800-34 (Contingency Planning) or similar frameworks. AWS Security Specialty certification or equivalent demonstrated expertise. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $205,000- $233,000 annually + bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. title: Staff Data Engineer
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is looking for a Staff Data Engineer to join our Data Platform team. This is a senior individual contributor role with broad technical scope and high organizational impact. You will own data architecture decisions, lead the design of scalable pipelines and platforms, and set the engineering bar for how we build and operate our data systems. You will partner closely with engineering, product, analytics, and machine learning teams to ensure our data infrastructure enables the business to move fast and make high-quality decisions. Everything you build will matter. A defining piece of this role is owning the data architecture behind one of Xometry's highest-leverage strategic initiatives: the DFM AI + IQE integration with our partner. You will be the data engineering lead for the digital thread that connects Xometry's platform to the partner ecosystem - Solid Edge, NX, Designcenter, and Teamcenter - building the pipelines, contracts, and observability that move quotes, parts, manufacturability signals, and pricing between the two systems in real time. The data plane you design is what makes the "science fiction speed" digital thread from ideation to delivery actually work. How You'll Contribute:. Lead with technical depth - Design and drive the implementation of enterprise-scale data architecture and engineering solutions that span multiple systems and domains. Own the partner integration data plane - Architect and build the data layer of Xometry's embedded DFM AI + IQE integration with partner Teamcenter and Designcenter. Own the bidirectional pipelines, the joint data model for parts / BOMs / quotes / manufacturability signals, the low-latency signal path that delivers DFM and pricing feedback back into the designer's environment, and the governance, lineage, and audit posture required for a public-marketplace partner integration. Build for scale - Architect and optimize reliable batch and streaming data pipelines, data models, and platforms that handle Xometry's complex, high-volume data, including the real-time and event-driven flows that the partner integration depends on. Own the full lifecycle - Take end-to-end accountability for data engineering work from acquisition and transformation through to delivery, observability, and ongoing performance. Set the standard - Define and enforce best practices for data modeling, CI/CD, testing, and code quality across the data engineering function, including the contract-testing and schema-evolution discipline required when data crosses a partner boundary. Solve ambiguous problems - Navigate complex, cross-domain technical challenges, evaluate variable factors, and deliver solutions that meet both business and technical objectives. Develop multi-quarter roadmaps - Translate strategic priorities into concrete technical plans, working independently to determine methods and timelines. Collaborate broadly - Partner with engineers, product managers, data scientists, business stakeholders, and partner partner engineering teams to translate requirements into robust technical solutions. Mentor and elevate - Guide other engineers through design reviews, code reviews, and technical mentorship, raising the overall capability of the team. Evaluate and adopt - Stay current with the data engineering ecosystem and make informed recommendations on tools, platforms, and architectural patterns. . What You'll Bring to Xometry:. Bachelor's degree in a STEM field (or equivalent experience) plus at least 5 years of experience in a data engineering related role, with demonstrated ownership of complex, large-scale data systems. Deep expertise with cloud data warehouses - Snowflake strongly preferred - including optimization, best practices, and performance tuning. Expert-level SQL and strong Python proficiency; comfort picking up additional languages as needed. Hands-on experience building and optimizing data pipelines, architectures, and data sets using modern tooling (dbt, Airbyte, Airflow, or similar). Demonstrated experience planning and implementing enterprise data architecture across multiple systems and domains, including integrations that cross organizational or partner boundaries. Working knowledge of queueing, batch and stream processing (e.g., Kafka, Spark, Kinesis), and highly scalable data stores (e.g., Apache Iceberg). Experience writing database-heavy services or APIs and designing for testability and maintainability. Deep understanding of CI/CD principles and demonstrated experience with automated testing, contract testing, and schema-evolution discipline in data pipelines. Strong grasp of the AWS data ecosystem and cloud-native infrastructure. Ability to operate independently on new and ambiguous assignments, determine methods and procedures, and communicate effectively at all levels of the organization - including with external partner engineering teams. Enterprise / partner integration experience - Prior work integrating with PLM, ERP, or large enterprise SaaS systems; partner Teamcenter experience (data model, BMIDE, Active Workspace APIs, AWC integrations) or comparable PLM exposure is a strong plus. Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Looker, Streamlit). Experience with data governance, data quality frameworks, and observability tooling - especially in contexts where data flows across partner or tenant boundaries. Exposure to modern lakehouse or data mesh architectural patterns. Experience with infrastructure as code (IaC) frameworks (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation). Experience with event-driven architecture, CDC pipelines, and low-latency operational data flows that feed back into a customer-facing UI. Experience in manufacturing, supply chain, or marketplace environments is a plus - but curiosity and drive matter more. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. #LI-Hybrid. title: Staff Product Manager, Buyer Experience
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . About This Role. Xometry is looking for a driven, curious and customer obsessed Staff Product Manager to join its Buyer Experience group. In this role, you will manage the enterprise market segment - large enterprises that use Xometry to get their custom parts manufactured. Enterprise buyers bring a unique set of problems to solve: very large orders, procurement systems, complex purchase orders, contract terms, security and compliance reviews, and multiple stakeholders on a single account. Your job is to design self-service and human-assisted experiences inside that complexity, so an enterprise buyer gets the same frictionless quoting and ordering experience as anyone else, without giving up the controls and process their organization requires. You will define a 6-12 month forward-looking strategy for the enterprise segment, secure cross-functional buy-in across engineering, design, data science, category management, marketing, sales, legal/compliance and customer success, and hold accountability for outcomes that make quoting and ordering with Xometry frictionless for large accounts. You will be given a metric and a problem space, not a fully scoped backlog. Comfort defining your own roadmap from ambiguous signals is a requirement, not a bonus. This role requires a hybrid schedule (3 days a week) at our Waltham, MA or North Bethesda, MD office location. How You'll Contribute. Enterprise Ecosystem Growth: Own the enterprise quote-to-order funnel end to end, from procurement intake and account onboarding through repeat ordering. Run structured experiments on RFQ intake flows and multi-stakeholder approval steps, using the results to drive measurable lifts in enterprise activation, conversion, and account expansion, all while keeping the experience self-service or human assisted depending on the need. User Research and Insights: Get very close to our enterprise customers and deeply understand the needs of all user personas - the engineer who needs the part, the procurement lead who has to source the part and the compliance reviewer who has to sign off, and their needs do not always line up. Gather feedback directly through interviews, surveys, and usage data, and then build creative solutions to solve their problems. Problem Discovery: Proactively identify and define new problem spaces across the enterprise buyer lifecycle that will solve complex pain points for customers and drive the growth of our enterprise business. Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and own the product strategy and the roadmap, with clear outcomes and milestones you present to technical and non-technical audiences. Data-Driven Decisions and Accountability: Set desired outcomes and define KPIs for each initiative you run. Monitor results closely and adjust priorities in real time, synthesizing findings into clear narratives for technical and non-technical audiences alike. Cross-Functional Collaboration and Enablement: Secure alignment across engineering, design, data science, category management and marketing, and drive adoption of new capabilities through rollout strategy, in-app education, and customer communication. Build and Ship with AI Agents: Operate spec-first. Translate your experimentation roadmap into structured, machine-executable specs that AI agents (Claude, Cursor) can build against, and work hand-in-hand with marketing, design, engineering and product analytics to prototype, validate, and ship statistically sound changes fast. What You'll Bring to Xometry. You would be a good fit with:. 10+ years of experience in product management, including direct ownership of an enterprise B2B or two-sided marketplace product. Experience working with large enterprise customers and a track record of not just building features, but crafting solutions that fit into complex organizational structures and workflows. AI-native, with hands-on fluency in tools like Claude and Cursor, and a track record of using them to compress the path from idea to validated, shipped product change. Strong strategic and analytical skills, with a systems-thinking approach to managing complexity and trade-offs across multiple product areas. Comfort making decisions under ambiguity, based on limited information, translating a loosely defined problem into a testable hypothesis and a plan. Strong communication and influence skills, with the ability to align senior leadership and cross-functional partners without direct authority. Proven ability to drive change within a fast-paced, scaling organization. Bachelor's degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field. Signals we look for. You can walk through a specific enterprise feature or workflow you redesigned: the friction you removed, and the before and after numbers, not just the shipped feature. You have designed a product experience on a marketplace or B2B platform that supported large enterprise buyers with multiple personas whose needs did not always line up. You have shipped an ML or AI powered feature into a complex flow with multiple organizational hierarchies. You have worked on manufacturing, supply chain, or logistics products, or you can show how you learn unfamiliar operational domains fast. Pace:. This is a startup pace inside a public company. You will be given a metric and an open problem, not a scoped project plan, and you will be expected to quickly move from hypothesis to shipped test. If you do your best work with a clear brief and a stable backlog, this is not the right role. . We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. . #LI-Hybrid.
