title: Staff Product Manager, Financial Systems
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Every dollar that moves through Xometry passes through Financial Systems: what a buyer is quoted and invoiced, what a partner is paid and when, what gets disputed, what gets recognized as revenue, and what finally lands in the ledger. As Staff Product Manager for Financial Systems, you will sit at the intersections of the order-to-cash and procure-to-pay lifecycles. You will collaborate with cross functional product teams making Xometry the most dependable marketplace for partners and customers. This is an individual contributor position that requires product manager proficiency and a deep understanding of financial and accounting operational functions and internal control concepts. You will be expected to read a journal entry, trace a transaction through to the general ledger, and understand why a control exists, or doesn't, before you create a solution. Day to day, you will gather requirements from customers, partners, and our own Accounting team, and translate what you learn into products & features that serve all three. You will translate finance requirements into PRDs that engineers can design and build from. . How You'll Contribute:. Identify & Prioritize: Identify, define, and prioritize features & product enhancements that matter. You will communicate the value to the organization, and develop the metrics using data that supports the business case. Know the Personas: Develop a deep understanding of finance, procurement and operational persons and their end to end workflows from both the customer and internal accounting teams perspective so that requirements reflect how the work actually gets done from both the Procure to Pay and Order to Cash lenses. Cross Functional Alignment: Act as the hub between Engineering, Finance and Accounting, Sales, Order Operations, Partner Experience, Legal, and Tax, so that launches land with the field ready and users are informed. Own Release Enablement End to End: For every release, you own the communication, documentation, SOPs, and training, and coordinate with Marketing to inform customers and partners. Ensure that the work done turns a deployed feature into an adopted one. Build Controls into the Product: Partner with Accounting, Controllership, Tax, and Internal Audit so that segregation of duties, approval thresholds, the audit trail, revenue recognition treatment, and SOX-relevant controls are designed into workflows rather than reconciled around them afterward. Collaborate with other product managers to guide them through finance required specifications necessary for feature sign off and acceptance. Apply automation and AI where it is verifiable: Target the highest volume of manual work such as cash application, invoice exception handling, dispute triage, payout inquiries with automation that is measurable, reversible, and gated by human review where the cost of a silent error is high. Deconstruct Complex Problems: Break large, ambiguous problems into smaller pieces that deliver iterative wins, without losing sight of the outcome they add up to. Research & Auditing : You will work with accounts receivable and accounts payable teams and research/troubleshoot complex sales orders, purchase orders, general ledger postings and determine a course of action. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 8+ years of product, program or project management experience, and 4+ years in an accounting related role such as book keeping, staff accounting or audit. Accounting fundamentals are at the core of this position. Working fluency with accounting fundamentals, accrual concepts, revenue recognition, chart of accounts, reconciliation, month end close, audit and SOX controls sufficient to partner with Controllership and Accounting as peers rather than as requesters. Experience working with accounting software platforms (Sage Intacct, NetSuite, SAP, Oracle, or similar) that include the general ledger, accounts payable, accounts receivable or procurement subledgers, and how journal entries are recorded between ledgers; or homegrown systems that act as the subledger. Experience designing policy driven workflows (credit limits, approval routing, tiered sign-off, exception queues, escalation logic) rather than single user tools. Track record integrating with ERP platforms and third party solutions such as Stripe, Avalara, High Radius, Zuora, and eProcurment providers such as Coupa and Ariba. Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to distill financial and operational complexity into a clear narrative for engineers and executives alike. Proven ability to operate autonomously with a passion for problem solving and diving deep into transactional ecosystems to understand the micro details that are recorded in accounting systems. Bachelor's degree in accounting, finance, or business, or 10+ years in an accounting related field; advanced degree (MBA,MS, MAcc) and ASC 606 a plus. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $180,000-$207,000 annually + bonus, depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. title: Staff Product Manager, Sales Operations
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is looking for a Staff Product Manager to lead product strategy for Sales Technology and Operations within our Product Development team. You will report to the Senior Director of Sales and Marketing Product Management. You will partner with our VP of Sales Operations, commercial leaders, and Salesforce engineering teams to rebuild our core sales tech infrastructure into a unified revenue and account management engine, aligned to Xometry's segmentation strategy and the distinct customer journeys within those segments. Your core mission is to ensure each segment and buyer profile gets tooling that fits how those customers buy and how their reps sell, while removing operational drag for account executives and freeing them to concentrate on revenue growth. You will design an end-to-end sales technology stack that accelerates velocity on standard quotes, creates robust enterprise transaction rails for long-term production programs, and provides reps with continuous visibility into post-order fulfillment milestones. Operating where commercial urgency intersects with deep operational complexity, you will partner with sales leadership to define the two-year sales tech roadmap while delivering continuous, high-value quarterly capabilities. Recognizing that revenue generation demands both structured execution and pragmatic flexibility, you will build tools that grant reps instant leverage rather than administrative burden. A substantial portion of your work requires driving critical cross-functional capabilities across Buyer Experience (Website), Pricing, Post-Order, and Marketing. You will be handed open problem spaces and target metrics, and you will turn them into a fully fleshed-out roadmap and execute against it. Success requires navigating ambiguity, building clear strategic consensus across executive stakeholders, and exerting influence across organization boundaries without direct authority. This position is based out of our Waltham, MA or North Bethesda, MD office on a hybrid schedule (3 days per week). How You'll Contribute:. Customer Journey Mapping: Build a first-hand understanding of journeys within each customer segment and develop distinct buyer profiles within those segments. Validate profiles and journeys through customer conversations and rep shadowing, and leverage those insights to drive prioritization. Revenue Operating System: Modernize CRM infrastructure to support multi-stakeholder coverage models. Establish automated data pipelines to streamline reporting and incentive tracking. Segment-Specific Sales Motions: Support the distinct sales motions across sales segments, matching tooling to how each segment's buyers evaluate, purchase, and reorder. Orchestrate high-velocity demand through event-driven outreach that unifies conversation intelligence and marketing tools. For enterprise programs, construct transaction infrastructure including e-procurement punchout connectors and sustainment catalogs. Deliver collaborative quote workbenches to empower sales teams on complex recurring deals. Order Milestone Visibility: Eliminate operational blind spots by streaming real-time production and fulfillment milestones directly into sales workflows. Configure automated exception alerts to notify account teams of potential delays well before deadlines are impacted, turning operational risks into opportunities for proactive client management and retention. Cross-Functional Product Bridges: Drive alignment and collaboration across organizational boundaries. Synthesize leadership input into product requirements to improve sales productivity. Build consensus and secure cross-team engineering commitments through influence. AI and Automated Workflows: Translate sales processes into structured specifications that intelligent systems can build and execute against while preserving rep judgment where it matters. Establish a governance framework that routes tasks to appropriate models. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 10+ years of product management experience , with direct ownership of sales tech, revenue operations, CRM platforms, or B2B marketplace sales infrastructure. Experience supporting B2B sales organizations with a defined segmentation model, and translating segments into differentiated tooling, workflows, and data without over-standardizing. Demonstrated depth in customer journey understanding across multiple buyer profiles, including technical vs. non-technical and transactional vs. program-based buyers. Deep architectural mastery of Salesforce , including Sales Cloud, CPQ, complex opportunity models, object hierarchies, territory management, and enterprise integration patterns. Hands-on fluency with modern commercial stacks , including sales engagement platforms (Outreach, Salesloft), conversation intelligence (Kaia, Gong), marketing automation (HubSpot), cloud data warehouses (Snowflake), and reverse ETL tooling. Pragmatic understanding of sales behavior: you respect the realities of quota-carrying reps, balance automation with flexibility, and resist over-engineering rigid standard operating procedures. AI-native operating style , with hands-on fluency in tools like Claude and Cursor, and a proven track record of using them to accelerate product discovery, spec authoring, and delivery. Systems-thinking mindset with the ability to manage intricate technical dependencies across disparate databases, legacy ERPs, and modern cloud platforms. Executive presence and influence , with demonstrated success aligning senior commercial leaders (Chief Commercial Officer, VP Sales Ops) and technical leaders (CTO, VP Engineering) around a cohesive strategy. Comfort making high-stakes decisions under ambiguity , translating high-level business targets into concrete technical requirements and measurable milestones. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Business, or a related technical field. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $180,000-$207,000 annually + bonus depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. We also offer a competitive benefits package, including 401(k) match, medical, dental and vision insurance; life and disability insurance; generous paid time off including vacation, sick leave, floating and fixed holidays, maternity and bonding leave; EAP, other wellbeing resources; and much more. #LI-Hybrid. title: Staff Product Manager, Sourcing & Job Board
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is seeking a Staff Product Manager to own the strategy and lead the development of Sourcing and the Job Board: the systems that determine how manufacturing jobs are matched to partners so they win work that first their shop, succeed, and grow their business, while maximizing xometry's sourcing margin. This is the commercial engine of the partner marketplace. Sourcing matches partner capability data to part and offer data and governs the priority and timing by which partners are shown available jobs. The Job Board is the surface where partners browse, evaluate and then accept/decline/bid/give feedback on the offers Xometry presents. The role sits at the intersection of partner performance, marketplace margin, and job quality, and it directly shapes how efficiently supply meets demand across a marketplace where thousands of partners take jobs every week. It is a senior individual-contributor position: the mandate is to own a major product domain end to end, set the technical product direction, and move the metrics that define marketplace health, chief among them sourcing margin, the number of partners actively taking jobs, and the quality of the matches partners receive. How You'll Contribute:. Own the multi-year strategic vision and roadmap for Sourcing and the Job Board, aligning matching and marketplace-liquidity strategy with Xometry's margin and growth objectives. Drive the design and evolution of the matching and recommendation engine that pairs partner capabilities with the right jobs, along with the priority-scheduling logic that governs which partners see which offers, and when. Own the job acceptance funnel end to end: grow the number of partners viewing the Job Board and raise the share who accept, spanning discovery, evaluation, and the accept, decline, and feedback loop that turns served offers into taken jobs. Partner with the Pricing and Machine Learning teams to influence dynamic pricing and matching strategy. This role shapes and informs pricing and model direction; it does not own pricing. Balance competing objectives across partner performance, margin, and quality, making principled tradeoffs when they conflict (for example, widening job distribution to lower time-to-take without degrading match quality or partner outcomes). Establish and monitor the KPIs that define marketplace health: sourcing margin, time to take, partners per job, eyes on jobs, served rate, and conversion. Conduct deep analysis to surface and prioritize the highest-leverage opportunities to compress time-to-take and expand liquidity. Ground decisions in behavioral data and continuous partner feedback, closing the loop between what the algorithm serves and how partners actually respond on the board. Drive adoption of new matching logic and Job Board capabilities through rigorous experimentation, thoughtful rollout, and clear partner communication. Provide technical product leadership and craft mentorship to Product Managers across Partner Experience, raising the bar without direct management authority. Serve as the primary product voice for Sourcing and the Job Board to executive leadership and cross-functional stakeholders. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 7+ years of progressive product management experience, with a strong track record in marketplaces, matching or recommendation systems, or marketplace optimization problems. Direct experience building or optimizing two-sided marketplace mechanics (supply-demand matching, liquidity, ranking, or recommendation systems). This is the core of the role. Demonstrated success shipping complex, high-scale features in operational, marketplace, or B2B environments with clear and measurable business impact. Expert-level analytical and quantitative skills, with a proven ability to reason about algorithmic systems, interpret complex behavioral and financial data, and build rigorous business cases. Ability to partner credibly with Machine Learning and Pricing teams: enough fluency in how models and pricing logic work to influence and direct them without owning them. Exceptional written and verbal communication, with the ability to align stakeholders from engineering teams to the executive level. Proven ability to operate autonomously as a senior individual contributor, taking full ownership of a major product domain and driving both its strategy and execution. Nice to have: exposure to dynamic pricing, manufacturing or supply chain, or complex logistics tooling. The estimated base salary range for new hires into this role is $180,000-$207,000 annually + bonus, depending on factors such as job-related skills, relevant experience, and location. title: Workday Systems Lead Consultant
description: Xometry (NASDAQ: XMTR) powers the industries of today and tomorrow by connecting the people with big ideas to the manufacturers who can bring them to life. Xometry's digital marketplace gives manufacturers the critical resources they need to grow their business while also making it easy for buyers at Fortune 1000 companies to tap into global manufacturing capacity. . Xometry is seeking an experienced Workday Systems Lead Consultant to drive the end-to-end implementation of Workday across our organization. This is a hands-on, delivery-focused engagement for a proven Workday practitioner who has led at least one full implementation from design through go-live. The consultant will serve as the primary systems lead, partnering closely with HR, IT, Finance, and external implementation partners (SI) to ensure a successful, on-time phased launches between Q1-Q3 2027. We're looking for someone who is naturally curious and a strategic problem solver who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and navigating ambiguity. You'll partner across Talent Operations, Benefits & Compensation, Talent Acquisition, HR Business Partnering, Finance, IT, and beyond to advise stakeholders and ensure the system we build is scalable, well-governed in diverse US and international regions, and a true business enabler - one that reflects Xometry's culture as much as its process requirements. This is a 1-year contract role, with the core deliverable being a full Workday implementation. How You'll Contribute:. Global Tenant Implementation. Serve as the internal systems lead for the full global Workday implementation, owning the project from a technical configuration standpoint. Partner with the SI and Project Team to gather requirements from Functional Teams and translate them into Workday configuration. Participate in design and lead configuration of Xometry's global Workday tenant across Core HCM, Absence, Advanced Compensation, Benefits, Learning powered by Sana, Peakon, Recruiting, US Payroll, Workday Help, and Workforce Planning. Configure and support the tenant across multiple regions - including the US, EMEA, China, and India - accounting for local statutory, regulatory, and business process requirements within a single global framework. Help establish sound data structures, business process design, security frameworks, and system governance for international regions and diverse worker types. Execution & Ownership. Partner with SI on configuration, testing (unit, integration, UAT), and defect resolution cycles ahead of go-live. Manage data conversion and validation activities, working with functional teams to ensure data integrity and completing implementation workbooks. Design and configure security groups, business processes, and workflows aligned to Xometry's org structure. Participate in the design of and troubleshoot system integrations connecting Workday to downstream platforms (e.g., Looker, ERP, international payroll), ensuring data flows are accurate, timely, and well-governed. Provide go-live support and post-go-live. Knowledge & Change Management. Support change management and end-user training in partnership with HR/People Ops, functional leads, and change champions. Act as a knowledge-transfer resource to internal staff who will support Workday post-implementation. Provide regular status updates to project sponsors and leadership on timeline, risks, and issues. What You'll Bring to Xometry:. 5+ years of hands-on Workday configuration/consulting experience. Proven experience leading or serving as a lead systems consultant on at least one full global Workday implementation with functional and configuration experience across several of the following modules: Core HCM, Absence, Advanced Compensation, Benefits, Learning powered by Sana, Peakon, Recruiting, US Payroll, Workday Help, and Workforce Planning. Solid understanding of US and international Workday configuration, with hands-on experience supporting multiple regions - especially the US, EMEA, China, and India - including region-specific business processes, statutory requirements, and localization considerations. Experience integrating Workday with downstream platforms, including experience with Workday integration tools and patterns (EIBs, Workday Studio, and Workday Web Services) and typical HR integration partners (benefits providers, international payroll, Finance and IT systems). Experience working with Workday's report writer, dashboards, and advanced reporting tools, as well as integrations with data management and dashboarding platforms like Snowflake/Looker. Experience managing data conversion and validation for a full implementation. Demonstrated ability to work directly with business stakeholders, translating requirements into system design. Experience partnering with a third-party SI/implementation partner in a co-lead capacity preferred. Demonstrated ability to navigate ambiguity and drive projects forward independently in fast-paced, evolving environments. Strong system aptitude paired with high attention to detail across configuration, testing, and data governance. A strategic mindset - able to connect business objectives to technical design decisions, not just execute requirements as given. Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build trust and partner effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders. A collaborative, builder mindset with a track record of managing multiple competing priorities. Ability to work 3 days a week onsite in our office. Title and Summary. . Vice President, Security Monitoring and Response. . Vice President Enterprise Resilience (Mastercard). . Who is Mastercard?. . Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. . Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all. . Mission First, People Always. . As Corporate Security, we are responsible for keeping Mastercard safe and secure from cyber and physical threats, and it is our people on the frontlines who make this happen every day. . By taking care of our people, their wellbeing, and career development, we provide them the necessary tools and environment to ensure the success of our mission. . Overview. . The Enterprise Resilience Team is looking for a Vice President, to primarily be responsible for developing and executing the enterprise resilience strategy to ensure the organization can effectively prevent, respond to, and recover from significant disruptions. This role encompasses Crisis Management, Operational Resilience, Business Resilience, Technology Resilience, Governance, Compliance, and Assurance. The VP will also lead the global exercising and testing program, including coordination with clients and suppliers to ensure end-to-end resilience. . In this role, you will:. . Leadership & Strategy. . Set and execute against the strategy and direction for Enterprise Resilience which consists of Crisis Management, Service Resilience (Operational) Business Resilience (Continuity), Technical Resilience (Recovery) and Resilience Planning (Governance and Assurance). . Set the vision, mission, strategy, and roadmap for the global Enterprise Resilience function. . . Lead and manage a global team, including Directors and other senior leaders, to drive the resilience agenda across all business units. . Facilitate the Enterprise Resilience Steering Committee, ensuring alignment with the company's strategic goals and risk appetite. . Represent, drive, improve and maintain the Enterprise Resilience program to enable Mastercard to support our Clients, Customers and Critical National Infrastructure where appropriate. . Be the Subject Matter Expert across the organisation and provide industry thought leadership with participation in external industry bodies and other forums. . Functional Oversight. . Oversee Crisis Management, Operational Resilience, Business Resilience, Technology Resilience, Governance, Compliance, and Assurance functions. . Ensure the development and implementation of robust policies, procedures, and frameworks to manage and mitigate risks. . Ensure the exercising and testing program, conducting regular drills and simulations with internal teams, clients, and suppliers. . Manage and control functional budgetary requirements, including staffing plan and program. . Support Emergency events across the organisation, facilitate the response and recovery procedures (including after action activities). . Regulatory Compliance and Governance. . Ensure global resilience regulations are identified and understood and ensure compliance across all operations. . Ensure the development and maintenance of a comprehensive governance framework to oversee resilience activities. . Oversee reporting and escalations (where applicable) to the Board of Directors (Risk Committees) and relevant regulatory bodies. . Risk Management and Resilience. . Enable the Identification, assessment, and mitigation of resilience related risks and issues that could impact the organization's operations and services. . Oversee the Implementation and maintenance of effective crisis management and response plans, including scenario playbooks. . Develop supply chain resilience, cyber resilience, and cloud resilience programs and ensure they are an integral part of the resilience strategy. . Collaboration and Communication. . Foster strong relationships with key stakeholders, including clients, suppliers, and regulatory bodies. . Communicate the resilience strategy and initiatives effectively across the organization. Evangelize the wider benefits and rewards of mature Enterprise Resilience. . Ensure client-facing teams are prepared to address client concerns regarding resilience capabilities. . Continuous Improvement. . Promote a culture of continuous improvement and resilience awareness throughout the organization. . Drive a culture of iterative maturity through the continuous (life)cycle process. . Oversee training and development programs to enhance the resilience capabilities of employees. . Learn from past incidents and exercises to continually improve resilience practices. . . Role:. . Expert level knowledge of Enterprise Resilience and the developing global regulatory landscape. . Expert level knowledge of ITSM and ITAM standards. . Expert level knowledge of Service Resilience End to End (E2E) exercising and testing. . Expert level of knowledge of Cyber Resilience. . . . All About You:. . Minimum of 10 years of experience in enterprise resilience, risk management, or a related field, with at least 5 years in a leadership role. . Proven experience in leading global teams and managing complex resilience programs in a large, multinational organization. . International certification / accreditation experience (ex. ISO22301). . Extensive knowledge and experience leading and responding to audits and regulatory inspections. . Certified Resilience professional (BCI / DRI). . Extensive experience as a practitioner within Resilience (Business Continuity, Disaster Recovery, Crisis Management). . An excellent motivator and leader who possesses exemplary oral and written communication skills. . Detail driven with high accuracy in delivery. . Strong strategic thinking and leadership skills with the ability to drive vision and mission. . Excellent knowledge of global resilience regulations and best practices. . Exceptional communication, collaboration, and stakeholder management skills. . Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. . Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment. . . NICE Framework references. . This Mastercard role shares knowledge, skills, and abilities with related NICE work roles. . OG-OR-005 (OV-MGT-002) Provides leadership, management, direction, or development and advocacy so the organisation can conduct resilience work. . Corporate Security Responsibility. . Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for this position must:. . Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices. . Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed. . Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and. . Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines. . Title and Summary. . Director, SME Global Market Expansion. . Director, SME Global Market Expansion. Overview. The Director, SME Global Market Expansion will lead Mastercard's global market expansion strategy for SMEs, owning a portfolio of growth initiatives with direct accountability for Gross Dollar Volume (GDV), Net Revenue (NR), market share expansion, and pipeline creation. This role combines strategic leadership, commercial execution, and ecosystem development to create scalable growth engines across priority markets and channels. The Director will partner closely with regional leadership, Product, Finance, Franchise, Marketing, and Sales teams to identify whitespace opportunities, shape investment priorities, and accelerate growth at scale.. Role. Define and lead Mastercard's global SME market expansion strategy, identifying the highest-value opportunities to accelerate card displacement and capture incremental payment flows across priority markets. Own a portfolio of growth initiatives with direct accountability for GDV growth, Net Revenue generation, market penetration, and pipeline development. Establish the strategic framework for identifying target geographies, SME segments, verticals, and use cases with the greatest commercial potential. Lead the development and execution of global growth programs that accelerate the migration from cash, checks, wires, and alternative payment methods to Mastercard solutions. Influence investment decisions and strategic priorities by building executive-level business cases and commercialization plans. Serve as the executive sponsor for critical growth initiatives, ensuring successful execution from opportunity identification through scaling and market adoption.. Key Responsibilities. Strategy Development & Commercial Leadership. Define and execute Mastercard's global SME market expansion strategy with accountability for enterprise-level GDV, revenue, and pipeline outcomes. Develop multi-year growth plans and investment priorities aligned to Mastercard's broader SME growth agenda. Build and maintain executive-level business cases that quantify financial impact, customer value, and strategic importance. Prioritize initiatives, investments, and resources based on revenue potential, scalability, competitive advantage, and strategic fit. Establish growth targets, operating metrics, and performance expectations across markets and regions. Growth Execution & Scale. Lead large-scale growth initiatives from concept through commercialization and global deployment. Oversee pilot programs, experimentation frameworks, and test-and-learn methodologies to validate new growth opportunities. Establish KPI frameworks and governance mechanisms to measure business impact and ensure accountability. Drive rapid scaling of successful initiatives across multiple geographies while capturing and applying best practices. Ensure disciplined execution and measurable business outcomes across the expansion portfolio. Market, Competitive & Customer Intelligence. Lead the development of strategic market insights to identify whitespace opportunities and emerging growth trends. Analyze payment behaviors, barriers to adoption, and switching dynamics across SME customer segments. Monitor competitive activity, fintech innovation, embedded finance models, and alternative payment ecosystems to inform strategic decisions. Translate market intelligence into actionable growth strategies and investment recommendations for senior leadership. Opportunity Identification & Portfolio Development. Identify high-value payment flows, underserved segments, and new use cases with significant card conversion potential. Develop prioritization frameworks to guide investment allocation across regions, segments, and initiatives. Evaluate new business models, partnerships, and distribution channels that accelerate market penetration and revenue growth. Shape Mastercard's expansion strategy across emerging SME ecosystems, including embedded finance, digital platforms, marketplaces, trade and logistics, and industry-specific verticals. Cross-Functional & Executive Leadership. Serve as the strategic link between Global SME Product, Regional Product, Franchise, Sales, Marketing, Finance, and Strategy teams. Drive organizational alignment around growth priorities, resource allocation, and commercialization plans. Present growth strategies, investment cases, and performance updates to SVP, EVP, and executive leadership audiences. Influence enterprise-wide decisions through data-driven storytelling and executive stakeholder management. Strategic Partnerships & Ecosystem Development. Identify, evaluate, and cultivate strategic partnerships that accelerate SME payment adoption and market expansion. Sponsor initiatives with issuers, fintechs, acquirers, ISVs, platforms, marketplaces, and ecosystem partners. Develop scalable channel strategies that unlock new customer acquisition opportunities and increase payment volume. Drive innovative partnership models that extend Mastercard's reach into emerging SME payment ecosystems. Value Proposition & Commercial Innovation. Shape differentiated SME value propositions that address customer pain points and accelerate payment conversion. Lead the design and commercialization of new growth initiatives, distribution models, and customer engagement strategies. Partner with Product and Data & Services teams to embed analytics, insights, and value-added capabilities into market expansion initiatives. Ensure all initiatives are tied to measurable business impact and scalable commercial outcomes.. All About You. Strategic growth leader with deep experience driving commercial outcomes in payments, fintech, banking, consulting, or financial services. Proven track record of owning and delivering against significant revenue, GDV, market share, or pipeline objectives. Strong understanding of SME payment ecosystems, commercial card economics, embedded finance, and payment digitization trends. Demonstrated ability to identify market opportunities, build business cases, and scale initiatives across multiple regions. Exceptional executive presence with experience influencing senior leaders and presenting to C-suite stakeholders. Strong analytical and strategic problem-solving skills with the ability to translate complex data into actionable growth strategies. Entrepreneurial mindset with a history of building new capabilities, launching growth programs, and driving organizational change. Ability to operate effectively in highly matrixed global organizations and lead through influence. Results-oriented leader with a strong bias for action, accountability, and business impact. Qualifications. Required. 12+ years of experience in strategy, payments, product management, commercial leadership, consulting, fintech, or related industries. Proven experience leading growth strategies and commercial initiatives with measurable financial outcomes. Experience managing complex, cross-functional programs across multiple geographies and stakeholders. Strong financial acumen with experience building business cases, investment frameworks, and growth models. . . Corporate Security Responsibility. . Title and Summary. . Vice President, Global Public Sector, Tolling and Parking. . Overview. The Global Urban Mobility team is seeking a Vice President to lead a new team supporting the growth of our Public Sector Tolling and Parking business. While Mastercard has a substantive existing tolling and parking business, we require a deep subject matter expert to lead a team of Directors challenged with accelerating the growth of this segment around the world. The VP will enable our regional sales teams with expert-level go to market resources, cultivate external partnerships, build Mastercard's brand in the tolling and parking spaces, and work with our product teams to create innovative solutions to challenges facing these industries. The ideal candidate combines deep tolling payments experience with a history of leading successful complex, multi market programs and demonstrated ability to cultivate successful internal and external partnerships. . Role. • Own the development Mastercard's Public Sector Automotive business. Help prioritize and incubate high growth portions of the urban mobility business such as tolling, parking, and connected car commerce. • Deliver commercial value: Our team is in the business of creating commercial value for Mastercard. We craft solutions that serve the needs of our public and private sector partners as well as end-consumers. When that value is resonant in the market, we drive a high volume of transactions and generate revenue for the company through those transactions. That incubation and scaling are how we measure our success. • Innovation: Building a successful tolling and parking payment practice requires demonstrable internal and external innovation. We are often reshaping entire industries and the ability to think innovatively and inspire innovation in others is absolutely critical in this role. That innovation often takes the shape of small breakthroughs that culminate in a fully scaled business. • Craft expert-level go to market programs: Not all members of the Mastercard team are experts in tolling and parking. We have a responsibility to craft go to market plans and sales materials that enable our regional teams to deliver revenue growth through the urban mobility segment. This often includes frequent interaction with our product team, provisioning of requirements, and assisting with new product rollouts. • Building new partnerships or extending existing partnerships: Identify key use cases and enhancements with our range of products to grow the partnerships and build concrete commercial success, often in the form of transactional volumes. Understand changing partner needs and how those needs map to the Mastercard business; Foster strong external relationships; collaborate on new solutions; be viewed as a high-value asset to our internal and external partners, etc. • Build Mastercard's Brand in the Urban Mobility Space: Tolling and Parking are emerging spaces for Mastercard. We need our partners and customers to think of us first when they consider Urban Mobility payments. As such, the VP will develop the brand through social media channels, marketing efforts, tender responses, and conferences.. All About You. The ideal candidate for this position should have a history of:. • Deep experience in tolling payments. • Strong leadership, interpersonal and communication skills. • Successfully working across global markets. • Driving outcomes by influencing without authority. • Bringing innovative ideas to life. • Encouraging teamwork, integration & inclusion. • Sound business judgement, problem-solving, and analytical skills in multi-cultural and international environments. • Independent self-starting, comfortable with ambiguity. • Establishing, enhancing, and maintaining relationships with government, regulatory, banking, and industry bodies. • Impactful influencing with ability to deploy a range of approaches to build consensus across product and market management teams to drive commercial wins. • Managing multiple high priority efforts concurrently. • Analytic and financial modelling skills. • Establishing and delivering on key performance indicators. • Detail orientation. • Understanding Mastercard's products and services (preferred but not required). • Spanish language skills preferred by not required. . Title and Summary. . Junior Technical Project Manager. . Advisors & Consulting Services. The Services area within Mastercard is responsible for acquiring, engaging, and retaining customers by managing fraud and risk, enhancing cybersecurity, and improving the digital payments experience. We provide value-added services and leverage expertise, data-driven insights, and execution. Our Advisors & Consulting Services team combines traditional management consulting with Mastercard's rich data assets, proprietary platforms, and technologies to provide clients with powerful strategic insights and recommendations. Our teams work with a diverse global customer base across industries, from banking and payments to retail and restaurants.. The Advisors & Consulting Services group has five specializations: Strategy & Transformation, Performance Analytics, Business Experimentation, Marketing, and Program Management. Our Program Management consultants lead clients through business transformations by implementing strategically important Mastercard assets and services to bring value and drive growth. They serve as the Center of Engagement across all stakeholders within Mastercard and the client's organization.. Positions for different specializations and levels are available in separate job postings. Please review our consulting specializations to learn more about all opportunities and apply for the position that is best suited to your background and experience: https://careers.mastercard.com/us/en/consulting-specializations-at-mastercard. . Role & Responsibilities. You will manage defined workstreams or small projects, often embedded within software development or product teams. You will work hands‑on with engineers, testers, and product owners to support agile delivery, track progress, manage risks, and ensure outcomes align with client objectives. It is expected that you will be handling complex analyses and preparing communications to report back to clients and internal leadership. You will develop practical recommendations, contribute to team discussions on implications of analyses, and work alongside the client's staff on each project, assisting with implementation tasks. Client Impact. • Provide input on multiple small and large high-value projects across a range of industries and problem statements. • Contribute proven, accredited change skills, domain experience, and delivery methodology to help clients drive measurable value. • Collaborate with Mastercard team to understand clients' needs, challenges, agenda, and risks. • Develop working relationships with client analysts/managers, and act as trusted and reliable partner. • Identify resources and assign responsibilities, track, and forecast effort and report on expense vs. earned value. Team Collaboration & Culture. • Collaborate with senior project delivery consultants to implement strategically important assets and services. • Independently coordinate a complex range of activities and effectively identify and proactively solution risks and impacts on timelines. • Lead internal and client meetings with strong communication skills. • Contribute to the firm's intellectual capital and be a strong brand ambassador for Mastercard and Data & Services. • Receive mentorship from consulting leaders for professional growth and development. Qualifications. Basic Qualifications. • Undergraduate degree. • Ability to communicate effectively in English and the local office language (if applicable). • Exposure to financial institutions or consultancy firms. • +2 years of work experience managing IT/software development projects. • Familiarity with agile methods such as Scrum or Kanban. • Ability to oversee projects involving cross-functional teams. • Experience working with clients or internal stakeholders. • Excellent communication and leadership skills. • Problem-solving oriented and decision-making abilities. • Ability to perform multiple tasks with multiple clients in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment. • Proficiency in the Microsoft Office suite, including advanced skills in Excel and PowerPoint - Microsoft Project experience will be considered a plus. • Eligibility to work in the country where you are applying, as well as apply for travel visas as required by travel needs. Preferred Qualifications. • A recognized professional accreditation, such as Project Management Professional (PMP). • Knowledge of project management tools. • Exposure to payments and/or retail banking or merchants. • Understanding of SDLC, testing, and release management. . . Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and. Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.. . . . .

Mastercard's Services Technology organization is seeking a Software Engineer II to contribute to the design, development, testing, deployment, and operational excellence of software solutions that support AI & Decision Product Enablement (DPE) platforms. These platforms power intelligent decisioning, real-time analytics, and fraud prevention capabilities at global scale.. This role is responsible for developing and maintaining automated test solutions, validating complex applications and system integrations, contributing to software quality throughout the development lifecycle, and collaborating with Product, Engineering, and Business stakeholders to deliver secure, scalable, and reliable software solutions. Responsibilities. •Design, develop, test, deploy, and support automated software solutions that validate applications, services, APIs, and system integrations throughout the software development performance, regression, and end-to-end automated tests to ensure quality and reliability. •Troubleshoot, debug, and analyze defects, test failures, and application issues to identify root causes and improve system stability. •Partner closely with software engineers to embed quality throughout the development lifecycle, ensuring appropriate test coverage, monitoring, performance validation, and operational readiness. •Analyze and optimize automation frameworks, test execution processes, and validation capabilities to improve scalability, reliability, and efficiency. •Design, generate, and manage test data, environments, and test execution activities required to support delivery objectives. •Build automated quality solutions that integrate with CI/CD pipelines and deployment processes to support continuous testing and release confidence. •Participate in Agile planning, story refinement, requirements elaboration, estimation, prioritization, and delivery activities. •Collect, Guild initiatives. •Continuously learn and adopt new technologies, testing approaches, tools, and development practices that improve software quality and engineering outcomes.. All About You. •3+ years of hands-on Java development experience building, testing, deploying, and supporting enterprise applications. •Experience developing and maintaining automated test frameworks and test suites, including hands-on experience with Selenium. •Understanding of software engineering fundamentals, object-oriented design, common design patterns, and the software development lifecycle (SDLC). •Experience with CI/CD pipelines, source control, automation, and modern software delivery practices. •Experience creating and executing unit, integration, regression, and end-to-end tests to ensure software quality and reliability. •Familiarity with gRPC or similar API technologies and service-to-service integrations. •Strong troubleshooting, debugging, and root-cause analysis skills, with experience diagnosing issues across distributed systems. •Knowledge of secure coding practices, code reviews, and software quality standards. •Experience working in Agile environments utilizing Scrum, Kanban, or similar methodologies. •Strong collaboration and communication skills with technical and non-technical stakeholders. •Demonstrated curiosity, adaptability, and a commitment to continuous learning and knowledge sharing.. Ideal Candidate Profile. •Software engineer first, with a passion for quality and automation. •Brings a strong foundation in Java development and modern engineering practices. •Understands how quality engineering integrates into the software delivery lifecycle and CI/CD pipeline. •Collaborates effectively across teams, embraces feedback, and contributes to a positive engineering culture. •Comfortable navigating ambiguity, solving complex problems, and driving solutions through delivery. . The Mastercard Services global product team is seeking a Specialist to support the Mastercard Business Intelligence product. Mastercard Business Intelligence is at the heart of a business intelligence ecosystem built on market data and payment insights, helping customers across the globe make smarter decisions and stay competitive.. This role is focused on product execution, coordination, and delivery support within a global team. You will work closely with Product, Engineering, and UX partners to help deliver product features and enhancements. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships, and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential. Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.. Mission First, People Always. As Corporate Security, we are responsible for keeping Mastercard safe and secure from cyber and physical threats, and it is our people on the frontlines who make this happen every day. By taking care of our people, their wellbeing, and career development, we provide them the necessary tools and environment to ensure the success of our mission.. Overview. The Identity Access Management team is looking for a Senior Information Security Operations Analyst to join the identity Access Management services expansion, identify ways to leverage the access data to answer important business questions. This would include automating access and streamlining processes - truly understanding end to end provisioning of access across enterprise platforms, and innovating techniques to use and communicate data in new and more effective ways to influencing how access should be granted to users. The ideal candidate is passionate about the customer experience journey, highly motivated, intellectually curious, analytical, and possesses an entrepreneurial mindset. You must be a team player with a positive attitude who is enthusiastic about bringing a vision of the future to life.. In This Role, You Will:. • Supports internal efforts and enhancements of existing Identity Access Management system. • Identifies automation opportunities to deliver smarter and easier identity access management services to support "access as an enabler" strategy. • Implement identity solutions to integrate users and applications from mergers and acquisitions. • Implement security controls for human and non-human identities. • Envision how Mastercard will continue modernizing Identity and Access Management in the cloud. • Ensure that access is appropriately handled during identity lifecycle events (e.g., Joiner, Mover, Leaver). • Improve procedures and feature sets for Identity and Access Management in the cloud. • Provide technical design and architecture advice to internal teams on leveraging cloud IAM services. • Plan and build out access reviews for cloud environments, ensuring compliance and minimizing friction. • Promote these services across the enterprise and foster enthusiasm for modern Identity governance. • Review project documentation, maintain technical documents, and business requirements. • Identify opportunities for improvement and provide technical guidance to junior resources. • Understand security policies, industry best practices, and compliance requirements.. Corporate Security Responsibility. Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. Activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks come with inherent risk. The successful candidate must:. • Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices. • Ensure confidentiality and integrity of accessed information. • Report any suspected security violations or breaches. • Complete all mandatory security training per Mastercard guidelines.. We are seeking a commercially driven Director to lead SME Specialist Sales execution across whole sale trade verticals in Germany. The role is accountable for identifying, developing and converting high-value B2B payment flows, from Small and Medium Business to Wholesale trade industry suppliers into carded flows. Reporting into the European SME Specialist Sales leadership, this Director will act as the market-facing commercial lead for Germany, working closely with local market teams, and ecosystem partners to unlock card-based B2B payment flows. Key Responsibilities. Commercial Delivery & GDV Growth. • Own and execute the SME Whole Sale trade plan for Germany, aligned to the European GDV growth strategy. • Build and convert a high-quality pipeline of wholesale trade and B2B payment opportunities. • Identify invoice-based, account-to-account and manual payment flows where Mastercard solutions can drive card adoption and incremental GDV. • Support complex deal origination, business case development, partner negotiation and commercial execution. Market Coverage & Local Execution. • Develop market-specific sales plays for Germany, reflecting local payment behaviours, regulation, issuer priorities and SME needs. • Partner with country teams to prioritise target verticals, accounts and ecosystem partners. • Build trusted relationships with banks, fintechs, acquirers, ERP/accounting platforms and relevant trade ecosystem participants. • Provide clear market feedback to European leadership on barriers, competitor activity and growth opportunities.. Client Value Proposition. • Position Mastercard solutions as tools to improve payment efficiency, reduce manual collections activity and support working capital optimisation. • Engage with CFOs, Treasurers, Heads of AR/Collections and finance operations stakeholders to demonstrate commercial value. • Create practical business cases showing impact on DSO, cost-to-collect, cash conversion and supplier/customer payment experience. • Translate complex AR/AP and B2B payment flows into simple, compelling sales narratives for clients and partners. Wholesale Trade & SME Segment Expertise. • Develop deep insight into wholesale trade value chains across Germany, including distributors, suppliers and high-volume B2B merchants. • Identify repeatable sales motions where card solutions can replace or complement A2A, bank transfer, direct debit and manual processes. • Capture learnings from local execution and contribute to reusable European playbooks.. Required Qualifications. Experience & Skills. • Experience in payments, AR/AP Wholesale trade industries, financial services, fintech, SME banking, B2B sales or working capital solutions. • Demonstrated ability to deliver commercial growth, manage complex pipelines and execute multi-stakeholder deals. • The ability to create value propositions, based on working capital metrics, from card based economics. • Strong understanding of B2B payment flows, invoice cycles, AR/AP processes and working capital levers. • Proven ability to sell to senior stakeholders across finance, treasury, payments, operations and commercial teams. Knowledge & Expertise. • Knowledge of card acceptance, commercial cards, account-to-account payment alternatives and receivables digitisation. • Understanding of SME and wholesale trade payment behaviours in Germany. • Ability to build commercially credible value propositions using data, customer insight and operational pain points. • Familiarity with ERP, accounting, invoicing or finance workflow platforms would be advantageous. Personal Attributes. • Commercially sharp, execution-focused and comfortable operating with pace and ambiguity. • Strong relationship builder with credibility across senior client and internal stakeholders. • Analytical and structured, with the ability to turn data and customer insight into action. • Collaborative team player able to influence across markets, functions and partner organisations. description:

Title and Summary. . Senior Accountant. . Overview. The Global Business Solutions Center (GBSC) is a shared services organization within Mastercard whose mission is to add value to our partners and serve our customers by delivering operational excellence, enhanced customer experiences, and focused business results. The Senior Accountant will be a key contributor within Mastercard's global controllership organization, supporting treasury accounting, foreign exchange accounting, and related financial reporting activities. This position will partner closely with Treasury, Corporate Accounting, Technical Accounting, Financial Planning & Analysis, Financial Systems, and regional finance teams to help ensure accurate and timely accounting for cash, investments, foreign currency exposures, and treasury-related transactions across Mastercard's global operations. The ideal candidate will bring hands-on treasury and foreign exchange accounting experience, sound technical accounting knowledge, strong analytical skills, and a commitment to operational excellence. This role includes ownership of assigned close activities, account reconciliations, financial analysis, audit support, internal controls, and process improvement initiatives. Role. Perform treasury and foreign exchange accounting activities in accordance with US GAAP, IFRS, and company accounting policies. Execute monthly, quarterly, and annual close activities related to cash, investments, foreign currency transactions, intercompany funding, and other treasury-related accounts. Prepare and review journal entries involving foreign currency remeasurement, translation adjustments, intercompany settlements, cash activity, investments, and other treasury transactions. Prepare general ledger account reconciliations; research and resolve reconciling items, significant fluctuations, and foreign exchange-related variances. Analyze foreign currency impacts and provide clear insights regarding foreign exchange gains and losses and other treasury-related financial results. Support accounting and reporting for cash, cash equivalents, investments, restricted cash, bank fees, intercompany funding, and other treasury-related balances. Partner with Treasury and Technical Accounting to assess the accounting implications of foreign exchange exposures, investments, financing arrangements, and other treasury-related transactions. Prepare treasury and foreign exchange-related disclosures, footnotes, roll-forward schedules, and supporting documentation for internal and external reporting requirements. Support internal and external audits by preparing schedules, responding to inquiries, and maintaining complete and accurate documentation. Maintain effective internal controls, identify process risks, and support timely remediation of control or accounting issues. Collaborate with Treasury, Financial Systems, and technology teams to improve banking integrations, reporting capabilities, and treasury accounting processes. Identify and implement opportunities for standardization, automation, efficiency, scalability, and control enhancement. Support treasury accounting initiatives and system enhancements by tracking assigned milestones and deliverables and coordinating with stakeholders. Build productive relationships across Treasury, Finance, Accounting, and regional teams while managing competing priorities and meeting close deadlines. All About You. Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field. CPA preferred, but not required. 3 to 5 years of relevant accounting experience, with meaningful exposure to treasury accounting, foreign currency accounting, controllership, financial reporting, or corporate accounting. Working knowledge of foreign currency accounting, treasury accounting, financial instruments, and related US GAAP and IFRS guidance. Hands-on experience with foreign currency transactions, remeasurement activities, translation adjustments, and multinational accounting environments. Experience supporting accounting and reporting for cash management, investments, intercompany funding, and treasury-related transactions. Experience preparing journal entries, performing account reconciliations, analyzing variances, and supporting monthly or quarterly close activities. Experience supporting audit requirements and operating within an internal control framework. Experience with ERP systems, treasury management systems, or financial reporting tools; Oracle EBS / Oracle Fusion, REVAL, SAP, AtlasFX, Bloomberg, or similar platforms is preferred. Ability to interpret accounting guidance and apply technical accounting principles to treasury and foreign exchange matters. Demonstrated ability to identify process improvements and automation opportunities that enhance efficiency and control. Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills with close attention to detail. Title and Summary. . Senior Technical Program Manager. . Overview. Foundational Data & Model Services sits in Data & AI Foundations, inside Business & Market Insights. If that reads as an opportunity rather than a risk, you will enjoy this.. Role. Keep the legacy platform's operational commitments visible in the plan, so migration work does not quietly starve the systems still in production. Broker the dependencies we do not control, working with central platform, cloud operations and data governance teams. Run vendor and partner engagement: roadmap alignment, milestone tracking, performance against commitments. Experience of platform migrations where the old system stays live throughout and the decommissioning is the hard part. Understanding of data modelling and why it matters: schemas, lineage, common definitions, and what breaks downstream when they drift. Understanding of data governance, access control and handling customer data in a regulated business. Partnership & Sponsorship Strategy. • Define and lead Japan's partnership and sponsorship strategy aligned to business priorities and brand positioning. • Identify and secure high-impact strategic partnerships (e.g., including but not limited to culture, entertainment, and sports platforms) that create competitive differentiation. • Establish a clear asset strategy that balances brand building, customer value, and monetization. 2. Integrated Consumer Activation (B2C / B2B2C). • Lead the development of differentiated consumer experiences that drive engagement, preference, and brand affinity. • Ensure seamless integration into broader brand campaigns, always-on programs, and key platforms. • Drive innovation in how partnerships are activated across physical, digital, and experiential channels. 5. Value Creation & Monetization. • Maximize commercial returns from sponsorship and partnership assets through structured monetization models. • Develop and track revenue streams tied to issuer programs and partnership-driven initiatives. • Continuously identify opportunities to unlock incremental value from existing and new partnerships. 6. Cross-functional & External Leadership. • Collaborate closely with Marketing, Services, Product, and finance teams at local, regional, and global levels to ensure alignment and scalability. • Lead relationships with rights holders, strategic partners, and agencies to unlock innovation and incremental value. • Ensure strong governance, measurement, and reporting across all partnership activities. Minimum of 4 years of experience leading Workday implementation, deployment, optimization, or support engagements. Minimum of 4 years experience leading at least two end-to-end Workday deployments through planning, design, configuration, testing, cutover, go-live, and stabilization. Minimum of 4 years experience leading cross-functional teams spanning functional, technical, integration, data, security, reporting, testing, and change disciplines. Bachelor's degree or equivalent (minimum 12 years) work experience. (If Associates Degree, must have minimum 6 years of work experience). Bonus Points If:. Demonstrated experience managing scope, schedule, budget, resources, risks, issues, dependencies, decisions, quality, and change control. Experience communicating with executive sponsors and translating detailed delivery information into concise, decision-oriented reporting. Working knowledge of Workday implementation methods and lifecycle activities, including tenant strategy, testing cycles, data conversion, integrations, security, cutover, and production readiness. Demonstrated ability to lead distributed teams and collaborate across client, partner, vendor, and global delivery organizations. You have led large, multi-workstream, multi-country, or global Workday transformation programs. You have experience with Workday Human Capital Management, Financial Management, Payroll, Adaptive Planning, Supply Chain Management, or cross-platform transformation programs. title: Generative AI Software Engineer Specialist (all genders)
description: Who We Are. . Accenture Song is the world's largest tech-powered creative group - a fusion of creativity, technology, intelligence, and experience. Within Song, our practice helps iconic brands reinvent the products, services, and spaces that define their relationship with customers. We work across the full spectrum: from defining product strategy and crafting human-centred digital experiences to engineering the AI-powered platforms and design systems that bring them to life at scale. . We operate like a studio embedded inside a global consultancy: small, high-craft teams with a direct line between design decisions and shipped products. With 70 Song Studios and more than 4,000 designers and makers across six continents, our Design & Digital Products team brings together specialists in Product Design, Product Management, Engineering, Experience Design, and Content Design - all united by a belief that the best digital products make people's lives genuinely better. . For us, AI is not a feature we bolt on - it is the operating model we build around. We are actively shaping what it means to design, build, and deliver AI-native products at enterprise scale, and we are looking for engineers who want to be at the centre of that reinvention. . Who You Are. . You are an AI Native Product Engineer with demonstrated experience building cloud-native systems and shipping production-grade AI solutions. You combine hands-on engineering depth with the creativity and product intuition to shape solutions that make sense for real users and enterprises. You're as comfortable writing production code as you are whiteboarding system designs, facilitating a client workshop, or mapping a product roadmap. You thrive in ambiguity and act as a bridge between vision and execution. . You do not treat AI as a toolset to learn on the side. It is your primary medium. You architect around large language models, retrieval systems, and multi-agent orchestration the way previous generations of engineers built around microservices - with rigour, craft, and a clear eye on what will actually work in production. You translate complex AI behaviour into tangible user experiences that non-technical stakeholders can understand and trust. . . The Work. . You will embed directly with clients as a technologist, product thinker, and trusted engineering partner. Working within cross-functional Song studio teams - alongside Product Designers, Experience Designers, Product Managers, and Strategists - you will lead the engineering of AI-native digital products from concept through to production. You will shape not only what gets built but how it gets built, setting the technical standard for AI-native delivery within the practice. This is not a back-office role. You will be in the room with clients, translating AI possibilities into product realities, and in the codebase, making those realities work. . . AI-Native Product Engineering. . Product Orchestration: Partner with business and technical stakeholders to frame problems, align priorities, and translate needs into orchestrated AI workflows. Agent Architecture & Engineering: Design and engineer enterprise-ready AI agents - including retrieval, orchestration, policy-based routing, tool invocation, evaluation harnesses, and lifecycle observability. Human-AI Experience Engineering: Translate complex AI behaviours (confidence states, reasoning traces, agentic actions, fallback flows) into transparent, controllable, and accessible user experiences - in close collaboration with Experience Designers and Product Designers. AI Platform Integration: Build robust abstraction layers across AI providers (Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI, open-source models) to create portable, multi-provider pipelines that reduce client lock-in and maximise flexibility. AI Design System Contributions: Contribute to AI-native component libraries and design system patterns - error states, human-in-the-loop interactions, progressive disclosure of AI reasoning - ensuring consistency and scalability across client products. . Cloud-Native Engineering & Delivery. . Scalable Systems: Apply containerisation (Kubernetes, Docker), microservices, serverless, and event-driven architectures to ship AI-native systems that perform reliably at enterprise scale. Production Discipline: Own CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, and debugging. Deploy to production and take responsibility for what you ship. Rapid Prototyping: Build working prototypes and proof-of-concept systems that close the gap between design vision and technical reality - using AI tooling actively to accelerate your own delivery. . Client Partnership & Practice Building. . Trusted Advisor: Serve as the primary technical voice in client engagements - framing problems, aligning technical trade-offs with business goals, and communicating clearly to both engineers and executive stakeholders. Workshop Facilitation: Lead design sprints, co-creation sessions, and code-with workshops. Bring clients into the process, not just the outcome. Measurement & Improvement: Define and track evaluation frameworks for agent accuracy, latency, cost, and safety. Use data to drive continuous improvement of deployed AI systems. Knowledge Amplification: Document reusable patterns, architectural decision records, and best practices. . . Demonstrated engineering experience with cloud-native systems - APIs, microservices, containerisation, serverless architectures. Deep, production-proven expertise in agentic AI systems: agents, multi-agent orchestration, context engineering, RAG pipelines, and workflow automation. Hands-on experience with leading AI platforms - Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Google Vertex AI - and comfort building abstraction layers across multiple providers. Strong programming skills in Python (primary) and at least one of Java, TypeScript, or C#; experience with evaluation tooling, logging, and agent observability stacks. Production deployment experience: CI/CD, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform, Helm), monitoring, incident response, and debugging. Fluency in English - able to run workshops, present to executives, and write technical documentation. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent; AI certifications or demonstrated agentic tooling experience is a plus. . Bonus Points. . Experience at the intersection of design and engineering - contributing to or building upon design systems, working alongside UX/product designers on AI-powered experiences.
