title: Oracle Cloud ERP Finance Technical Consultant
description: Oracle Cloud ERP Finance Technical Consultant. Career level: Consultant / Associate Manager (CL9-CL8) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (Oracle). Why this role. . This role builds the Oracle Cloud finance solutions our clients run their books on. You'll take a finance design and turn it into a working, tested, migrated system that stands up at go-live and holds together afterwards. That means the configuration, the build specifications, the integrations and the data conversion behind them, and the evidence that it all works. You'll do it on large-scale Oracle Cloud ERP finance transformations, with real ownership of your own scope: a workstream lead sets the direction and owns the design authority, while you own the build within it and the technical decisions that come with it. You'll do that work from inside the client's finance function, in their design sessions, alongside their controllers and their IT team. You'll explain why the system behaves the way it does to people who will never open a configuration screen, hold a design decision when it is challenged, and become the person a client comes back to when the answer has to be right. We're hiring for both halves of that: the technical depth, and the judgement to carry it in front of a client. Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients - and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients - stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control. "Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent-boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people-our Reinventors." - Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO. . What you'll bring. . Oracle Cloud configuration depth. Hands-on configuration of Oracle Cloud ERP Financials (Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials) across the core finance modules: General Ledger , Payables , Receivables , Fixed Assets , Cash Management , Tax and Intercompany , plus the enterprise and ledger structures underneath them. You configure it, you test it, and you can stand behind why it is set up the way it is. That extends into Oracle Subledger Accounting , where you understand how transactions are accounted and how to configure the rules that decide it; consolidation and close in FCCS ; and enterprise data and chart-of-accounts structures in EDMCS. You stay on standard, extending Oracle the way it is designed to be extended rather than modifying it, and you can explain to a client why that boundary is worth holding. Experience across the wider Oracle finance estate, including the EPM suite and planning in EPBCS , broadens where you can work. The platform matters less than the rigour you bring, so comparable cloud finance platforms are worth talking to us about. Design, build and integration. You translate finance requirements into functional designs and into build specifications a developer can work from, covering reports, interfaces, data conversions, extensions, workflow and integrations. You build the reporting yourself in BI Publisher , OTBI and Smart View , and you have worked hands-on with Oracle's integration patterns across Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) and REST and SOAP web services. Data migration and conversion sits with you, using FBDI and ADFdi , so a cutover holds. Where the standard product doesn't reach, you extend it properly, in a sandbox and through Visual Builder. You take the solution through testing and into deployment, and you know what evidence a client needs before they will sign it off. Finance process knowledge. Genuine Record-to-Report depth, with a feel for how your configuration choices show up for the CFO: a faster close, numbers people trust, stronger control. You understand enterprise structures and chart-of-accounts design and the finance master data underneath them, how finance controls are built into the configuration rather than bolted on afterwards, and how those choices shape reporting downstream. Exposure to a second finance process area broadens your range. Delivery and client skills. You own your scope and see it through. You make the configuration and design calls within it, document them, and explain them to the client and to the workstream lead without either needing to check your working line by line. You're at ease in front of a client: running a working session with finance and IT stakeholders, walking them through what you've built, taking the questions it raises, and turning a technical constraint into what it means for their close, their controls and their reporting. You are straight with people about what the system will and won't do, and you say so early, not late. You bring structured, analytical problem-solving and communicate clearly under pressure, and you support the people around you by reviewing a colleague's configuration, bringing someone newer through a build, and passing on what is worth reusing on the next programme. Ways of working. We're increasingly an AI-first delivery team, bringing agentic tooling and orchestration into how we design, build, test and validate, with our people owning the judgement and the outcome. An appreciation of Oracle's own embedded Fusion AI and agents, and how they augment a finance solution, is a real plus, and we're keen to hear from people bringing that experience. . Who you are. You take ownership and follow through without being chased. You work well in a delivery team and build straightforward, trusted working relationships with client counterparts. You can explain a technical decision to someone who isn't technical: plainly, without talking down and without hiding behind the detail. You bring good judgement to ambiguous problems and you're careful and clear in how you make and explain technical decisions. You know which calls are yours and which belong to the workstream lead, and you raise the second kind early. You're precise about detail and thorough about proof. You test your own configuration and satisfy yourself it holds before you report it as complete. Things that set strong candidates apart: Oracle certification; hands-on configuration experience on end-to-end Oracle Cloud ERP finance implementations, from early design through to go-live; depth in the Oracle finance suite, whether subledger accounting, consolidation (FCCS) or enterprise data (EDMCS); reporting build in BI Publisher or OTBI; integration and data-conversion experience on Oracle Cloud across Oracle Integration Cloud, REST and SOAP services and FBDI; an awareness of how controls, master data and staying on standard shape a finance solution; and a professional finance or accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent industry experience). If you have most of this and the drive to build the rest, we want to hear from you - tell us what you'd bring. . #LI-EU. #LI-MP. . . About Finance RP. Within Accenture, the Finance Reinvention Partner helps clients improve financial performance around the CFO agenda - driving best-in-class performance, and sharper insight and benchmarking across the enterprise. In the UK and Ireland, our Finance RP practice brings together finance strategy and the platforms it runs on, including SAP, Oracle, Workday and EPM. You'd join our Platforms transformation offering within the practice : a growing team delivering Oracle Cloud finance transformations for finance functions, and building AI into how we deliver. It's a place to go deep on the Oracle build while staying close to the CFO agenda the work serves. We're a close team that enjoys working together and keeps asking whether there's a better way to do the work than last time. We deliberately put platform, process, data, AI and advisory backgrounds on the same team, because the mix gives a client a better-informed answer than any one of them does alone. . . As a Customer AI Engineer, you will design, build and deploy machine learning, generative AI and agentic AI solutions that help our clients better understand, serve and grow their customers. This is a hands-on engineering role where you will work across the full delivery lifecycle, from understanding the business problem and shaping the solution through to deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.. Your work could include building a retrieval-augmented generation solution that helps customer service agents access the right information, developing an agentic workflow that automates campaign planning and optimisation, productionising recommendation and personalisation models, or creating customer intelligence solutions that power segmentation, propensity, next-best-action and decisioning capabilities.. title: Senior AI Native Engineer
description: You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. The difference between an AI Engineer and what we are looking for is straightforward: you have shipped a multi-agent system in production, you have owned the eval harness, and you know what happens when your agent fails at 2am because you have lived it. . As an AI Engineer (Agentic/Applied), you will design, build, and deploy production-grade agentic AI systems across the full enterprise technology stack. You will work directly with client engineering teams, lead technical design sessions, and build reusable patterns and accelerators that scale beyond individual engagements. . This role sits at the heart of the AI engineering talent market - demand is growing faster than supply and will continue to do so. We offer what no single product company can: breadth across every industry, every enterprise technology stack, and every level of organizational complexity, combined with vendor fellowship access inside Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, and Google engineering teams and a direct pathway to the Forward Deployed Engineer programme. . Key Responsibilities. Architect and govern production-grade agentic systems at enterprise scale: multi-agent orchestration across complex environments, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, memory management, and programme-level lifecycle observability. Define RAG pipeline standards across engagements: establish chunking and embedding strategies, set quality benchmarks, and ensure metric-backed tradeoff decisions are documented and transferable. Set multi-LLM integration standards: vendor-agnostic architecture by default, fallback routing and cost governance as standard design practice across providers including OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI, and open-source models. Own LLMOps at programme scale: eval strategy, prompt governance, observability tooling standards, safety monitoring and cost controls across multiple concurrent systems. Lead client engineering engagements at senior level - facilitate architecture design sessions, lead proof-of-concept delivery, and drive alignment between client technology leadership and delivery teams. Shape and publish reusable patterns, accelerators, and engineering standards that scale across the practice and reduce ramp-up time on new client engagements. Own the measurement framework for agentic system quality: define accuracy, latency, safety, and cost metrics; present programme-level AI impact in business terms to senior client stakeholders. . #LI-EU. . . 8+ years of software engineering experience in production environments. Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment - non-negotiable. Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph, CrewAI, AutoGen, or equivalent - at production depth, not tutorial level. Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs. RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering. LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability. Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm). Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience. Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure. People lead responsibilities: experience managing, developing, and performance-managing a team of engineers; setting individual development plans and conducting career conversations. . . title: Corporate Investigations Legal Counsel Associate Manager
description: We are seeking an experienced and highly credible Corporate Investigator - Conduct & Ethics to lead and manage complex corporate compliance and workplace investigations across the organization. Reporting to the C&E APAC Regional Lead - Corporate Investigator , the successful candidate will be responsible for conducting and overseeing investigations arising from allegations of misconduct reported through the company's various Code of Business Ethics and compliance reporting channels. This role requires a qualified legal professional with strong investigative, employment law, litigation, ethics, compliance, and employee relations experience. The individual will work closely with senior leadership, Legal, HR, Employee Relations, Compliance, and other internal stakeholders to assess risks, conduct fair and thorough investigations, and recommend appropriate remediation. Manage investigations arising through the organization's various reporting and Code of Business Ethics channels. Conduct legally privileged investigations under the direction of legal counsel, ensuring appropriate confidentiality, independence and procedural integrity. Define investigation scope, identify key issues and risks, and develop appropriate investigation strategies and plans. Review and analyse relevant documents, records, communications and other evidence. Conduct sensitive and complex interviews with reporting individuals, witnesses, employees and other relevant parties. Assess evidence objectively and prepare clear, balanced and well-reasoned findings. Maintain appropriate investigation documentation, records, status updates and reporting throughout the investigation lifecycle. Prepare and review confidential investigation reports, legal analyses and other documentation relating to allegations of misconduct. Ensure investigations are concluded in a timely, fair and appropriate manner. Risk Assessment and Remediation. Assess legal, ethical, compliance and employee-related risks arising from allegations and investigations. Provide practical, balanced and risk-based advice to senior business, Legal and HR leadership. Recommend appropriate corrective actions, remediation and risk mitigation measures. Support the implementation and follow-up of agreed remedial actions. Promptly identify and escalate significant or high-risk matters to the Regional Lead and other appropriate stakeholders. Assist leadership in managing sensitive matters involving significant legal, regulatory, reputational or organizational risks. Stakeholder Collaboration. Partner closely with regional Corporate Investigators, Geographic Legal and HR Leads, Employee Relations, Compliance and other internal functions. Work with internal and external resources involved in the investigation and resolution of misconduct or inappropriate business practices. Consult with HR and Employee Relations leadership regarding the nature, risks, investigation approach and remediation of workplace matters. Collaborate with senior executives and leadership teams to ensure appropriate management and resolution of significant conduct and compliance issues. Build strong and trusted relationships with stakeholders while maintaining the independence and objectivity required of an investigator. Leadership and Capability Building. Provide guidance, coaching and support to attorneys and other personnel involved in corporate compliance investigations. Support and advise local HR, Employee Relations, Legal and other professionals involved in investigations. Develop and enhance internal guidance, processes and best practices relating to corporate compliance and workplace investigations. Stay current on legal and regulatory developments relating to workplace investigations, employee rights, reporting individuals, accused individuals, ethics and compliance standards. Promote consistent, fair and legally sound investigation practices across the region. Knowledge, Skills and Competencies. Strong experience conducting complex and sensitive workplace, employee relations, ethics or corporate compliance investigations. Strong understanding of employment law, litigation, employee rights and obligations, and workplace conduct matters. Demonstrated ability to assess complex facts and provide objective, balanced and legally sound conclusions. Strong business judgment and strategic understanding of legal, compliance and reputational risks. Ability to handle highly confidential and sensitive matters with discretion and professionalism. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate effectively with individuals at all levels of the organization. Demonstrated ability to influence and advise senior executives and leadership teams. Strong executive presence, credibility and stakeholder management skills. Excellent interviewing, analytical, problem-solving and investigative skills. Ability to prepare clear, concise and well-reasoned confidential investigation reports and legal analyses. Strong organizational, prioritization and time management skills, with the ability to manage multiple complex investigations simultaneously. Comfortable working independently while collaborating effectively with regional and global teams. Experience working in a multinational and culturally diverse environment. High level of integrity, sound judgment, objectivity and professionalism. Excellent verbal and written communication skills. . . . Educational Qualifications. Required. Law degree or equivalent legal qualification. Qualified and practicing solicitor, lawyer or equivalent licensed legal professional. Preferred. Architect and govern production-grade agentic systems at enterprise scale: multi-agent orchestration across complex environments, RAG pipelines, policy-based routing, memory management, and programme-level lifecycle observability. . Define RAG pipeline standards across engagements: establish chunking and embedding strategies, set quality benchmarks, and ensure metric-backed tradeoff decisions are documented and transferable. . The Trust and Safety (Content Moderation and Responsible AI) offering(s) within Accenture helps keep the internet safe and helps platform companies accelerate, scale, and improve their businesses.. description: You build the systems that actually make AI work in enterprise environments, not demos, not prototypes that stall after a pilot, but production agentic architectures running inside real client organizations. Extensive experience in software engineering in production environments. . . Minimum 1 year of hands-on experience designing and deploying agentic AI solutions in a production environment - non-negotiable. . Demonstrated experience with agentic orchestration frameworks: LangGraph , CrewAI , AutoGen , or equivalent - at production depth, not tutorial level. . Direct experience calling LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Vertex AI) in production code: provider abstraction, token management, latency and cost tradeoffs. . RAG pipeline ownership: embeddings, chunking strategy, vector databases, and context engineering. . LLMOps fundamentals: eval harness design, prompt versioning, and production observability. . Cloud-native engineering maturity: Kubernetes, Docker, microservices, serverless, CI/CD, and IaC (Terraform or Helm). . Strong Python; Java or equivalent backend language acceptable; production debugging and observability experience. . Quality of experience is weighted over years, a candidate who has shipped three production agentic systems in four years is preferred over a generalist with passive AI exposure. . Development, review and implementation of trade policies and internal controls to support existing program requirements, subject to review and approval by senior trade compliance counsel. Planning and drafting trade compliance communications with internal stakeholders to reinforce existing policies, guidance, and escalation pathways. Working with senior management and outside counsel to conduct risk assessments, recommend improvements to the trade compliance program, and support the implementation of adopted recommendations. Working with internal stakeholders to build trade compliance and monitoring tools to escalate and mitigate trade-related risks. Responds to and helps manage internal audits and internal investigations related to trade/export law issues.. Key Relationships:. Reports to: Senior Trade Compliance Counsel, Americas Lead. Experience supporting compliance programs, including preparing policies and internal controls; developing and conducting training; responding to government inquiries; and drafting and reviewing contracts. Ability to prioritize tasks and synthesize complex legal analysis into clear, practical recommendations. Strong verbal, written and interpersonal skills with the ability to interface, and develop relationships, with all levels of management and staff, and work cross-culturally. title: Forward Deployed Engineer Manager
description: Role Description. . This is not a consulting role. It is not a project delivery role. It is not a research position. A Forward Deployed AI Engineer is a production engineer who works embedded inside a client's enterprise, shoulder to shoulder with their teams, to make complex AI platforms work in real, messy organizational environments. You own outcomes: time-to-value, adoption, reliability, and scalability. Not delivery milestones. Outcomes. . . The market is beginning to understand what leading technology companies have demonstrated : AI products fail not because the models are weak but because deployment is broken. The gap between a successful AI pilot and an AI capability that scales is bridged by engineers who can translate platform capability into measurable business value inside a real enterprise environment. That is this role. . Forward Deployed AI Engineers form the execution spine of our Reinvention Deployment Engineering pods. We are building the largest FDE capability in the services industry. The engineers who join at this stage will define what the role looks like at scale and will have access to the hardest enterprise AI problems in the market across every industry. . . Key Responsibilities. . Lead enterprise AI platform deployments across complex multi-stakeholder client environments - Anthropic, OpenAI, Microsoft, Google, Salesforce, SAP, or Palantir - owning the full programme from architecture through adoption. . Own programme -level delivery outcomes: time-to-value, reliability, adoption velocity, and scalability across multiple concurrent workstreams, with commercial metrics attached. . Lead rapid experimentation at pace: drive ambiguous business problems to working production systems in days or weeks across complex enterprise environments. . Architect and govern enterprise AI solutions across the full technology stack: identity, data, security, governance, platform layer, and multi-system workflow integration at programme scale. . Shape AI reinvention strategy for client CTO, CFO, and CISO: build value architecture, ROI backlogs, use case prioritisation frameworks, and multi-year AI adoption roadmaps. . Define and publish reusable reinvention blueprints, patterns, and accelerators that scale across multiple client engagements and grow the FDE practice. . Lead architecture design sessions, executive workshops, and code-with sessions with client engineering and C-suite leadership teams. . Codify delivery learnings, failure patterns, and engineering standards that shape the FDE practice and enable the next generation of forward deployed engineers. . . . . Compensation at Accenture varies depending on a wide array of factors including but not limited to role, level, seniority, responsibility, skillset, and level of experience. For this position, the job level is under the A1 National Collective Bargaining Agreement. The gross annual salary range is between 50,000 and 86,700 EUR. #LI-EU. #LI-MP. . . Basic Qualifications. . Extensive and demonstrable engineering experience with cloud-native systems (APIs, microservices, containerization, serverless). . Deep expertise in designing and deploying agentic solutions (agents, orchestration, context engineering, RAG, workflows) in production environments. . Extensive and demonstrable experience with AI platforms - OpenAI, Claude, Vertex AI, plus open-source models - including building abstraction layers to manage multi-provider pipelines. . Extensive and demonstrable experience leading software engineering teams: overseeing delivery, allocating resources across workstreams, and owning the professional development of direct reports". . Demonstrated end-to-end delivery ownership in a client-embedded environment, internal projects, vendor labs, or team-only deployments do not qualify. . Proven ability to articulate business value: can quantify the impact of deployments in terms a CFO would recognize and act on. . Experience presenting to and building trust with senior client stakeholders, CTO, CFO, or CISO level. . Non-linear profiles are expected and welcomed, assessment is based on demonstrated deployment experience and outcome ownership, not CV pattern matching. . People lead responsibilities: experience managing, developing, and performance-managing a team of engineers; setting individual development plans and conducting career conversations. . . . description: Accenture is a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Interactive, Technology and Operations services-all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Also, you will get an interesting compensations package: Permanent employment, Basic Salary, Allowances, Special allowances for project assignment (per diem, transport, location premium), Meal, Health insurance & life insurance, Accommodation and transportation are fully covered.. . Key duties and responsibilities:. Drive the improvement of maintenance planning practices across both mobile mining equipment and fixed plant assets, working directly with client maintenance teams on-site. . Coach and develop client planners and supervisors through structured, on-the-job training - demonstrating best practices and embedding them into daily work routines. . Support the design and implementation of work management processes, including how maintenance jobs are identified, planned, scheduled, executed, and recorded. . Contribute to building maintenance planning frameworks, tools, and reference materials that the client team will continue to use independently after the program. . Track and communicate progress against capability improvement milestones, identifying gaps and adjusting the coaching approach accordingly. . Collaborate closely with Accenture's team s and client counterparts to ensure improvements are aligned to overall program objectives. . . Ability to deliver and ensure high quality and sustainable project benefits for the company, focusing on eliminating safety risks and incidents, increasing productivity and reducing costs. . . Minimum Education and Experience:. Bachelor's degree (S1) in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Mining Engineering, or equivalent engineering discipline. 4-10 years of experience in a mining, mineral processing, or heavy industrial environment - with a minimum of 3 years in a dedicated maintenance planning or scheduling role (not a technician or field supervisor role). Demonstrated hands-on experience using a computerized maintenance management system (such as SAP Plant Maintenance, IBM Maximo, PRONTO, or Ellipse) in a daily planning capacity. Direct experience in work management: planning and scheduling maintenance activities, managing work order backlogs, and coordinating planned versus corrective maintenance. Experience in coaching, mentoring, or delivering structured training to maintenance staff - even informally as a senior practitioner guiding a team. Bahasa Indonesia: professional or native fluency - mandatory. Daily work with Indonesian maintenance teams will be conducted in Bahasa. Willing and available to be stationed at a client's site for the assignment duration. Experience in copper, nickel, base metals mining, or equivalent heavy process industry (oil & gas refinery, smelter, or petrochemical plant) is highly preferred. . Core Competencies (Knowledge, Skills & Characters):. Strong domain expertise in maintenance planning - able to demonstrate, not just describe, best practices to a client workforce. A trainer's mindset: patient, structured, and focused on building others' capability rather than doing the work for them. Practical knowledge of preventive maintenance strategies, component life management, and work execution standards for either mobile equipment or fixed plant. Data-driven approach to measuring and communicating maintenance performance improvement. High interpersonal effectiveness and cultural adaptability - able to work closely with Indonesian maintenance crews, supervisors, and management. Self-directed and resilient - able to work productively at a remote mine site with limited day-to-day supervision. Strong oral and written communication in Bahasa Indonesia; working English proficiency is an advantage. Formal maintenance or reliability qualification (such as CMRP - Certified Maintenance and Reliability Professional) is highly preferred. . You will also have opportunities to hone your functional skills and expertise in an area of specialization. We offer a variety of formal and informal training programs at every level to help you acquire and build specialized skills faster. Learning takes place both on the job and through formal training conducted online, in the classroom, or in collaboration with teammates. The sheer variety of work we do, and the experience it offers, provide an unbeatable platform from which to build a career.. description: インダストリーコンサルタント（カスタマーフロント）【素材・エネルギー領域】 は顧客（生活者/消費者、法人顧客および従業員）が求める提供価値/体験を再定義し、持続的な事業成長を実現するべく、業界に深い知見を持ち、顧客を起点とした変革実現をするための要となるコンサルティング集団です。. プロジェクトではソング本部だけでなく、アクセンチュア全体の多様な人材やサービスラインと協業して、企業の顧客体験提供のフロントステージに関わる変革に加え、それを下支えするデータ・テクノロジー・組織・従業員体験含めたバックステージに関わる変革を含めた全領域を一気通貫で支援します。. . ◆業務内容. 担当業界にフォーカスした中で、企業の経営者層のカウンターパートとして下記をカバー. フロントステージ変革：新規ビジネス戦略、ブランド戦略、マーケティング戦略、営業戦略、チャネル改革、顧客体験改革. ・企業のパーパス・ミッションの再定義、それに基づくターゲットカスタマーと企業の価値・ブランドの明確化・市場規模概算. ・ターゲットとなる生活者体験設計・マルチチャネルでのコミュニケーションプランの策定、新たな体験・共感を生み出す既存事業に閉じないサービス・商品の企画・構想立案・実行に向けたBPR/システム構築支援・プログラムマネジメント. バックステージ変革：プロセス・データ・テクノロジー・組織・従業員を含めたオペレーティングモデル改革. ・フロントステージで定義した体験を下支えするプロセス改革、人的資源・組織変革、データ活用・データ基盤戦略、カスタマーフロントのテクノロジー変革、経営資源配賦含めたガバナンス改革. ・また、変革実行のカギとなる従業員を始めとする多様なステークホルダーのチェンジマネジメント推進・体験変革・実行に向けたBPR/システム構築支援・プログラムマネジメント. . . . ◆プロジェクト事例. ・BtoB向けの素材、技術の市場/顧客開拓を狙った、体験デザイン起点での新たなブランディング/マーケティング実行支援、グローバル含む収益拡大、更にデータや生成AIを活用した先進的な営業/マーケティング業務変革まで支援. ・サービス利用者目線でのアプリ通じた体験設計、企業イメージのリブランディング・メッセージ発信活動などを支援. ・エネルギー・インフラ企業として地域住民の生活を支えるための新サービス検討やプロモーション、ブランディングを支援. . . . ◆応募要件（必須）. ・下記いずれか. 電力・ガス・化学・素材・鉄鋼・エネルギー業界または類する主要官庁でのご経験やご知見. ストラテジーコンサルティング・ビジネスコンサルティング ・テクノロジーコンサルティング経験. 経営企画・事業企画・事業開発・サービス企画・マーケティング戦略・営業企画・カスタマーサービス業務経験. テクノロジー戦略・システム導入・DX推進・ITコンサルティング経験、PMO・伴走支援経験. . ◆応募要件（歓迎）. ・プロフェッショナルとしての自覚を持ち、企業の変革実現に対して主体的に推進していきたい方. ・企業視点と消費者/従業員を含む生活者視点の両面から企業のビジネスや社会環境へのインパクトに関心を持ち、社会全体の持続的な成長に関心をお持ちの方. ・生成AIなど最新テクノロジーやサービストレンドに対する感度と理解をお持ちの方. ・ロジカルシンキング・クリティカルシンキングやスライドライティング・プレゼンテーション力に一定の素養をお持ちの方. ・英語を用いたビジネス経験（TOEIC750点以上）. ◆求める人物像. ・デザイナーやクリエイター、エンジニアやデータサイエンティストなど多様なケイパビリティとコラボレーションすることを楽しめる方. . description: ファンクションコンサルタント（新規事業/プロダクト開発） は顧客（生活者/消費者、法人顧客および従業員）が求める提供価値/体験を再定義し、企業・ブランドにとって新たな収益源となる事業やプロダクト、サービスを企画します。. また、それを世の中にローンチするための実行支援から、ローンチ後のビジネス成長の運営を含め、企業変革全般の計画立案・実現支援を担います。. アクセンチュア ソングやアクセンチュア全体の多様な人材やサービスラインと協業して、お客様の成長を最短距離で実現するためのダイナミックなソリューションや、お客様の環境を踏まえた全体アーキテクチャを提案しています。お客様や業界に深い知見とオーナーシップを持ち、顧客を起点とした変革実現をするための要となるチームです。. 当ポジションは、多様なタレントがそれぞれのスペシャリティを追求しながらも、包括的な視点でのお客様の成長を実現するキャリアを目指していただけます。. ◆具体的な業務内容・新規事業構想・各事業に紐づくプロダクトやサービスの新規構想または刷新の企画・事業計画の策定と実行支援・先進テクノロジーを活用した変革テーマの企画と推進・新規プロダクトやサービスづくりの内製化支援. ◆具体的なプロジェクトの例・新規事業構想プロジェクト・既存事業の更なる収益拡大に向けた新規プロダクトやサービス構想プロジェクト・更なる事業成長を目的としたプロダクトやサービスの高度化支援. . ◆応募要件（必須）. ＜マネジャー以上＞. ・チームマネジメント経験. ・ストラテジー/ビジネス/ テクノロジー/デザインコンサルティング経験. ＜メンバークラス＞. 下記いずれかのご経験. ・ストラテジー/ビジネス/ テクノロジー/デザインコンサルティング/WEBコンサルティング経験. ・TO C向けの事業会社にてカスタマーフロント領域やサービス開発のご経験（アプリ、WEB、UIUXなど）. ◆応募要件（歓迎）・新規事業企画/事業開発/サービス企画/プロダクトマネジメントなどのご経験がある方. ・デザイナーやエンジニアとの競合経験. ・チームマネジメント経験・社外との交渉・折衝を含む調整業務の経験（お客様企業の経営層とやりとりできるコミュニケーション力、主体性、積極性）. ◆望ましい経験・スキル英語を用いた実務経験（ビジネスレベルの英語力、TOEIC750点以上、海外常駐経験等）. ◆期待するヒューマンスキルデザイナーやテクノロジー人材、データサイエンティストなど様々なケイパビリティを持った人材と共創ができる方. description: AI Infrastructure Architect. Industry: Infrastructure & Capital Projects Engineering (Construction / Infrastructure / Capital Projects). YOU ARE. As a hands-on AI Infrastructure Architect, you are an experienced engineer with several years in infrastructure engineering who now takes on more complex, higher-impact work designing and optimizing the AI and machine learning infrastructure that powers real-world applications. Working alongside senior architects and engineers - and increasingly leading your own workstreams - you apply proven skills in coding, testing, configuring, deploying, monitoring, and troubleshooting AI systems and the infrastructure they run on. Day to day, you architect and optimize infrastructure components, write and review code and deployment scripts, design and tune cloud and on-premises compute resources such as GPU clusters and distributed training environments, deploy AI systems and models into production, and build and optimize data pipelines that feed AI and ML workflows. You optimize the computational stack for performance, cost, power, and scalability, monitor AI systems and infrastructure health across both InfraOps and MLOps disciplines, perform AI monitoring to track model and system performance, and independently troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across the stack. You also mentor junior engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and help establish best practices. This is a hands-on, ownership-driven role where you apply and deepen your expertise across modern tools and platforms - including container orchestration, model serving, CI/CD pipelines, InfraOps, MLOps, and AI monitoring - while making meaningful contributions to infrastructure that enables AI-driven business outcomes. THE WORK. Write, review, and debug code, scripts, and infrastructure-as-code for AI infrastructure, automation, and tooling, setting standards for quality across the team. Architect, configure, and provision compute resources across cloud and on-premises environments, including GPU clusters and distributed training setups, optimizing for performance and utilization. Design and maintain deployment automation and CI/CD pipelines to support reliable, repeatable releases of AI systems, models, and applications. Deploy AI systems, models, and data pipelines into production, defining and improving the processes and best practices others follow. Lead container orchestration and model serving using tools such as Docker, Kubernetes, and model deployment frameworks. Architect and optimize the computational stack for performance, power, cost, and scalability, balancing trade-offs against business goals. Evaluate and select tools, frameworks, and platforms, making recommendations that shape the infrastructure roadmap. Integrate AI models and systems into existing enterprise systems, ensuring interoperability, security, and regulatory compliance. Own AI monitoring and infrastructure health across InfraOps and MLOps, tracking performance, reliability, and utilization, and driving remediation. Independently troubleshoot and resolve complex issues across the computational stack - hardware, networking, software, and models - and lead root-cause analysis. Mentor junior engineers and lead code reviews, providing technical direction and supporting their growth. Define and document architecture standards, processes, and procedures, and apply security, cost-efficiency, and scalability best practices across the infrastructure. . . Intelligent Enterprise Performance & Analytics Manager
description: . Job Description. Intelligent Enterprise Performance & Analytics Manager. Career level: Manager (CL7) | Location: London / Manchester / Edinburgh | Practice: Finance Reinvention Partner (EPM). . Why this role. This role sits at the heart of how finance plans, forecasts and decides - as the person who designs the data architecture and the AI beneath enterprise performance management. You'll shape how EPM platforms stitch together with the modern data platforms finance now runs on, and how machine learning and generative AI make planning and forecasting sharper, faster and more trusted. You'll build real credibility across both finance planning and the data and AI behind it, on marquee programmes, alongside people who architect this work for a living. . Accenture is a leading solutions and services company. Our strategy is to be the reinvention partner of choice for our clients and to lead in the safe, widespread adoption of AI. We bring together our people, deep industry expertise and technology to deliver end-to-end outcomes for clients - and Finance is one of seven Reinvention Partners at the centre of that. Finance RP brings the CFO agenda to life for clients - stronger performance, sharper insight, and better control. . "Our clients want a partner that can help them reinvent-boldly, continuously and at speed… while continuously building the most client-focused, AI-enabled great place to work for our people-our Reinventors." - Julie Sweet, Chair and CEO. . What you'll bring. EPM and FP&A architecture. Deep command of enterprise performance management - planning, forecasting, consolidation, reporting and close - and the FP&A behind it, from driver-based and rolling forecasting to scenario modelling and long-range planning. You own end-to-end EPM solution architecture: the models, dimensions and business rules that make a planning solution hold up. And you can lead the platform-selection and architecture calls across the leading tools, from Oracle EPM to OneStream to Anaplan. . Finance data architecture and integration. A strong grasp of how EPM connects to the wider enterprise - ERP, operational systems and the modern cloud data platforms finance now runs on. You set the target finance data architecture that ties actuals, drivers, assumptions and forecasts together, and you direct the engineers who build it - fluent enough in pipelines, integration and data quality to own the design and hold the build to account. You know how EPM sits alongside platforms like Snowflake, Palantir Foundry or Databricks as a governed data and AI foundation for finance. . AI-augmented, intelligent finance. You own the design of the AI and machine-learning use cases that make planning better - predictive forecasting, anomaly detection, automated variance analysis, AI-generated commentary and agentic planning workflows among them - and the human-in-the-loop controls that keep finance in charge of what the models produce. AI POWERED TECH TALENT. Title: Mid-Level Application Architect / Senior Developer. Seeking a forward-thinking professional with an AI-first mindset to design, develop, and deploy enterprise-grade solutions using Generative and Agentic AI frameworks that drive innovation, efficiency, and business transformation. AI POWERED TECH TALENT. Roles & Responsibilities: Lead AI-driven solution design and delivery by applying GenAI and Agentic AI to address complex business challenges, automate processes, and integrate intelligent insights into enterprise workflows for measurable impact. Professional & Technical Skills: Strong grasp of Generative and Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and AI evaluation frameworks. Ability to align AI capabilities with business objectives while ensuring scalability, responsible use, and tangible value realization. The ideal candidate will have robust experience in Java and/or .NET, and Python, with working knowledge of front-end technologies like React or Angular, and a foundational understanding of AI integration. This role emphasizes active coding, solution implementation, and collaboration across application development, infrastructure, and integration in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) to deliver scalable, secure enterprise applications. Proven experience in cloud, DevOps, or AI modernization initiatives. Strong understanding of LLMs, automation, and engineering toolchains. Ability to translate AI innovation into business and productivity impact.. Key Responsibilities:. Hands-On Coding: Actively develop, test, and deploy application-heavy solutions, write clean, efficient code in any of the programming language like Java, .NET, and Python for backend systems, and contributing to front-end development using React or Angular. Solution Design: Partner with senior architects to design scalable, cloud-native application architectures, focusing on performance, maintainability, and integration in multi-cloud environments. Integration Development: Build and maintain integrations using APIs, microservices, and event-driven patterns (e.g., REST, GraphQL, Kafka, or message queues). Multi-Cloud Implementation: Develop and deploy applications across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud, ensuring portability and optimization for cost and performance. AI Integration: Implement practical AI features (e.g., automation, basic analytics) using cloud-based AI services or frameworks like TensorFlow or PyTorch. Infrastructure Support: Collaborate with DevOps teams to implement containerized solutions (Docker, Kubernetes) and CI/CD pipelines, with hands-on use of IaC tools like Terraform or CloudFormation. Performance & Security Optimization: Ensure applications meet performance and security standards through code reviews, testing, and adherence to best practices. Team Collaboration: Work closely with developers, product managers, and infrastructure teams to translate requirements into technical implementations, providing hands-on support and mentorship. Continuous Learning: Stay updated on full-stack development trends, cloud technologies, and AI advancements to contribute to innovative solutions.. Qualifications & Skills:. Experience: 7 to 12 years of hands-on experience in full-stack development, with at least 2 years in a lead developer or junior architect role focusing on application-heavy systems. Demonstrated experience building and deploying solutions in multi-cloud environments (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Strong proficiency in Java, .NET, and Python for backend development. Hands-on experience with front-end frameworks like React, Angular, or similar. Basic exposure to AI/ML integration, such as using cloud AI services (e.g., AWS SageMaker, Azure AI) or simple ML frameworks. Practical experience with integration patterns (e.g., REST APIs, message queues) and microservices architecture. Familiarity with infrastructure tools like Docker, Kubernetes, and IaC (e.g., Terraform, CloudFormation). Experience with cloud-native services (e.g., AWS Lambda, Azure Functions, GCP Cloud Run). Working knowledge of DevOps practices, including CI/CD pipelines and monitoring tools. Understanding of secure coding practices and basic enterprise security standards (e.g., IAM, encryption). . Soft Skills:. Strong debugging and problem-solving skills with a hands-on mindset. Clear communication to collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders. Ability to juggle hands-on coding with architectural design contributions. Eagerness to learn and adapt to new tools, frameworks, and cloud technologies.. Education:. Bachelor s degree in computer science, Engineering, or a related field. Certifications like AWS Certified Developer, Azure Developer Associate, or similar are a plus.. . Minimum 2 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash or PowerShell. Strong problem-solving ability, communication skills and collaboration mindset in a fast-paced engineering environment.. Required Skills/ Experience. title: AI Infrastructure Architect
description: Project Role : AI Infrastructure Architect. Project Role Description : Architect and build custom Artificial Intelligence (AI) infrastructure/hardware solutions. Optimize AI infrastructure/hardware performance, power consumption, cost and scalability of computational stack. Advise on AI infrastructure technology and vendor evaluation, selection and full stack integration. Must have skills : AI Agents & Workflow Integration. Good to have skills : Snowflake Data Warehouse. Minimum 7.5 year(s) of experience is required. Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education. Role Summary / Description. AI Powered Tech Talent. As a Senior Engineer in AI Infrastructure Architecture for Snowflake, you will own significant portions of the end-to-end architecture and engineering of optimized data and AI infrastructure for production machine learning and AI-enabled applications. You will design scalable warehouses, Snowpark workloads, AI-ready data/feature pipelines, model-enablement patterns, automation and operational controls that align with client standards, SLAs, security, compliance and cost-efficiency expectations. You will bring industry experience across enterprise AI adoption, platform modernization, regulated data workloads, FinOps and production reliability, while mentoring engineers and partnering with architects to translate business requirements into robust Snowflake-based AI infrastructure solutions.. Key Responsibilities. Own end-to-end architecture and design of optimized Snowflake data and AI infrastructure, including warehouses, Snowpark workloads, secure data architecture, AI-ready feature/data pipelines, model integration and AI application enablement. Design and tune scalable Snowflake warehouses, tasks, streams, Snowpark services, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streamlit applications and cloud integrations, including compute sizing, query optimization, governance, access controls and high-throughput data access design. Serve as an authoritative AI infrastructure expert on Snowflake, applying deep knowledge of Snowflake Data Cloud capabilities, data/AI application patterns, governance, security and cost levers. Develop and evaluate architecture alternatives, weighing trade-offs across compute, networking, storage, orchestration, model serving, observability, security, compliance, cost and operational complexity. Lead architecture assessments and reviews of existing and proposed environments, identifying gaps, risks, bottlenecks and optimization opportunities, and recommending remediation actions. Drive architecture decision-making by documenting rationale, trade-offs, assumptions and dependencies so decisions are transparent, defensible and aligned with business SLAs and standards. Define and maintain AI infrastructure roadmap inputs, capacity planning models, scaling strategies, cost forecasts and performance improvement opportunities. Design deployment, automation and CI/CD strategies for reliable, repeatable and scalable releases of AI systems, models, data pipelines and platform components into production. Establish AI monitoring and observability practices across InfraOps and MLOps, including SLAs, SLOs, alerting, performance/cost tracking and continuous optimization. Integrate AI/ML systems into enterprise environments while ensuring interoperability, security, compliance, regulatory alignment and adherence to client standards. Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, architects and engineering teams to align infrastructure decisions with business outcomes and translate requirements into actionable architecture standards. Set technical direction for workstreams, mentor engineers, review designs/code and promote engineering best practices across the team.. Required Qualifications. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology or a related engineering field. Minimum 4 years of experience coding, building, monitoring, troubleshooting, designing and operating AI/ML infrastructure, cloud platforms, data platforms, model deployment pipelines or large-scale engineering solutions. Strong understanding of AI/ML concepts and the computing infrastructure required to deploy, run and optimize production AI workloads. Minimum 4 years of proficiency in programming or scripting languages such as Python, Java, C++, Bash, PowerShell or equivalent engineering languages. Experience with data pipeline and workflow management tools such as Apache Airflow, Kubeflow, managed orchestration services or platform-native workflow tooling. Strong problem-solving skills and ability to work in a fast-paced engineering or client delivery environment. Excellent communication, collaboration and stakeholder alignment skills. Minimum 4 years of experience in AI/ML infrastructure engineering or related roles on a hyperscaler or enterprise platform for deploying large-scale solutions. Proven experience leading AI projects or engineering workstreams and managing priorities across multiple initiatives. Demonstrated experience evaluating and selecting AI technologies, frameworks, cloud services and architecture patterns.. Required Skills/ Experience. Strong hands-on experience with Snowflake warehouses, databases, schemas, secure data sharing/access controls, Snowpark, Cortex/AI capabilities, Streams/Tasks, Streamlit and cloud ecosystem integrations. Experience architecting scalable data and feature pipelines, AI application integrations, model-enablement patterns, governance, query/warehouse optimization and secure data access. Strong working knowledge of SQL, Python, dbt/Terraform, CI/CD, DataOps, MLOps/AI enablement patterns, observability and incident response practices. Ability to optimize Snowflake AI infrastructure for performance, cost, scalability, security, reliability and compliance. Experience producing architecture decision records, reference implementations, standards, runbooks and reusable platform patterns.. Good to Have Skills. Snowflake certifications such as SnowPro Advanced Architect, SnowPro Advanced Data Engineer or related AI/data platform credentials. Knowledge of Snowflake governance, secure data sharing, FinOps, infrastructure partner/vendor collaboration and production support operating models. . . 15 years full time education. . description: Project Role : Operations Engineer. Project Role Description : Support the operations and/or manage delivery for production systems and services based on operational requirements and service agreement. Must have skills : Agentic Orchestration, Agentic AI, AI Orchestration &LLM. Good to have skills : NA. Minimum 3 year(s) of experience is required. Educational Qualification : 15 years full time education. Summary:. A Tools & Platforms Service Engineer is responsible for the day-to-day operation, monitoring, support, and maintenance of the infrastructure engineering tooling estate - spanning observability platforms, infrastructure-as-code tooling, CI/CD pipelines, ITSM platforms, internal developer portals, secret management, and AI-augmented operations tooling. The role ensures that the platforms enabling Cloud, Network, Security, Database, and Voice teams to operate at scale remain available, performant, and fit for purpose.. At Level 9 / 10, this individual forms the primary operational execution layer within the tools and platforms tower - a proficient hands-on engineer who keeps platform tooling running reliably, resolves incidents and service requests efficiently, executes changes cleanly, and supports the adoption of AI-augmented operational capabilities across the infrastructure engineering function. PLATFORMS IN SCOPE. Observability:. - ELK/Splunk. - OpenTelemetry. - Alertmanager. Automation & IaC:. - Terraform (consumer). - Ansible playbooks. - GitHub Actions. - HashiCorp Vault. ITSM & DevOps:. - ServiceNow. - Jira/Confluence. - Xmatters. - CMDB tooling. AI-Augmented Ops:. - LLM runbook support. - AI alert triage. - Chatbot ops interfaces. - Prompt execution. - LLMOps monitoring. . Roles & Responsibilities:. Observability & Monitoring Platform Operations. - Monitor and maintain observability platforms - Splunk/ELK - ensuring dashboards, alert rules, and data pipelines remain operational and accurate across all infrastructure tiers. - Triage and resolve observability platform incidents - broken scrapers, missing metrics, failed log ingestion, dashboard errors - within defined SLA commitments. - Manage alert configuration - creating, updating, and tuning alert rules in Alertmanager, or equivalent to reduce noise and maintain actionable alerting across infrastructure teams. - Operate ELK stack or Splunk log pipelines - managing index lifecycle, ingest pipeline health, and log source connectivity for infrastructure platforms. - Execute observability platform changes - dashboard deployments, alert rule updates, retention policy changes - following approved change management procedures. - Maintain runbooks and operational documentation for all observability platforms - keeping procedures current, accurate, and audit-ready. ITSM, DevOps Tooling & AI-Augmented Operations. - Manage Xmatters - maintaining escalation policies, on-call schedules, alert routing rules, and integration health with upstream observability platforms. - Support Jira and Confluence platform operations - managing project configurations, workflow rules, automation triggers, and user access across engineering teams. - Monitor and support AI-augmented operations tooling - LLM runbook automation pipelines, agentic ITSM workflow health, and AI alert correlation services - ensuring AI tools are operational and escalating failures to Principal Engineers. - Support engineering teams using AI-augmented operations capabilities - triaging issues with LLM-powered runbook execution, RAG knowledge base queries, and chatbot operational interfaces. - Monitor LLMOps pipelines - tracking prompt execution logs, model API health, token usage, and cost anomalies - escalating degradation or unexpected behaviour promptly. - Perform root cause analysis (RCA) for recurring platform incidents across observability, IaC, CI/CD, ITSM, and AI tooling - documenting findings and driving preventive actions. - Support audit, regulatory, and compliance activities - producing platform access logs, configuration exports, and change evidence for PCI DSS, SOX, and FSI regulatory review. . Professional & Technical Skills:. Must-Have Technical Skills. Observability Operations: Splunk - dashboard management, alert rule configuration, metric scraper troubleshooting, and log pipeline operations (ELK/Splunk). Terraform Operations: Plan/apply execution, state file management, drift alert response, module consumption support, and workspace administration across AWS and GCP environments. CI/CD Operations: GitHub Actions and ArgoCD - pipeline health monitoring, runner management, deployment failure triage, and GitOps workflow support for infrastructure and application teams. HashiCorp Vault: Secret lease monitoring, auth method health, cluster status monitoring, and escalation-ready diagnosis of secrets management failures. . Xmatters: On-call schedule management, escalation policy configuration, alert routing, and integration health with upstream monitoring platforms. AI Tooling Operations: LLM runbook pipeline monitoring, agentic ITSM workflow health, LLMOps dashboard operation, token/cost anomaly alerting, and AI tool incident triage. Scripting & Automation: Python or Bash - operational scripting for platform task automation, API-driven tooling management, and alert-driven remediation workflows. Incident & Change Management: Structured P1-P3 platform incident handling, ITIL-aligned change execution, post-change verification, and RCA documentation in FSI environments. CMDB & Asset Management: Automated discovery tool operations, asset record accuracy monitoring, lifecycle tracking, and CMDB reconciliation for infrastructure tooling assets. Preferred / Advantageous. - Familiarity with LLM APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google Gemini). - sufficient to triage AI tooling incidents and support engineering teams with prompt execution issues. - Experience with Ansible or Chef for configuration management task execution and playbook troubleshooting - Exposure to Kubernetes operations (EKS or GKE). - sufficient to support platform tooling deployed on container platforms. - Familiarity with observability-as-code practices - dashboard and alert rules managed as version-controlled configurations. . Additional Information:. - Observability, IaC, CI/CD, ITSM, and AI tooling platforms are available and performing - incidents are resolved within SLA with accurate RCA and preventive actions that reduce recurrence. - Engineering teams across Cloud, Network, Security, Database, and Voice towers experience reliable, responsive platform tooling - support requests are resolved promptly and platform outages are communicated clearly. - Changes across the tooling estate are executed cleanly - validated, implemented without unplanned impact, and verified post-completion with documented evidence. - AI-augmented operations tooling is operational and monitored - LLM pipelines, agentic workflows, and alert correlation services are healthy, and degradation is escalated before it impacts engineering teams. - Platform access, audit logs, and CMDB records are consistently accurate - supporting PCI DSS, SOX, and regulatory review without remediation effort. - The candidate should have minimum 3 years of experience in Agentic Orchestration. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A 15 years full time education is required.. . . 15 years full time education. . description: Are you ready to lead the transformation of Employee Benefits and Group Insurance for some of the largest insurers and employers in Belgium?. At Accenture, we help insurers modernize their Employee Benefits business, transform customer and employer experiences, optimize operations, and leverage technology, data, and AI to create new value. As a Delivery Lead within our Insurance practice , you will play a critical role in driving large-scale business and technology transformations focused on Employee Benefits and Group Insurance solutions. Joining Accenture means becoming part of a global network of insurance experts, delivery leaders, and technology innovators who are shaping the future of Employee Benefits. . Your Role. As a Delivery Lead , you will be responsible for the successful delivery of complex Employee Benefits transformation programs, combining deep industry expertise with strong leadership and delivery excellence. . Key Responsibilities. Lead complex Employee Benefits and Group Insurance transformation programs from strategy through implementation and delivery. Act as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, helping them navigate challenges related to pension reform, digital transformation, customer experience, operational excellence, and platform modernization. Drive end-to-end delivery across business and technology teams while ensuring alignment with client objectives, timelines, budgets, and quality standards. Manage program financials, commercial performance, governance, risk management, and overall delivery profitability (P&L responsibility). Build and lead multidisciplinary teams across business, technology, product, and operations functions. Deliver transformation initiatives across key Employee Benefits domains including:. Group Life Insurance. Supplementary Pensions. Disability & Income Protection. Health & Hospitalization Benefits. Employee Benefits Administration. Employer & Broker Services. Digital Customer and Employer Portals. Benefits Operations & Claims. Support insurers and Employee Benefits providers in modernizing legacy platforms, optimizing operational processes, and implementing innovative digital solutions. Senior Change Management SME (Bilingual: English & Japanese) - JD. Role Purpose. We are seeking a highly skilled Change Management SME to drive enterprise IT Change Governance in a large-scale global environment. This role requires strong operational ownership, governance discipline, stakeholder management, and the ability to independently govern complex, high-risk production changes with operational stability and compliance. The ideal candidate must confidently drive governance, manage escalations, and operate effectively in high-pressure, regulated environments such as Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services. The role also requires strong bilingual communication capability in both English and Japanese to support Japan-region stakeholders, governance calls, CAB/TAB meetings, operational communications, and Change Management activities.. Key Responsibilities. Change Governance & Operational Control. o Govern Normal, Standard, and Expedited changes end-to-end with strong process understanding of Emergency changes. o Review RFCs for risk, impact, rollback readiness, implementation quality, and compliance. o Own and lead CAB/TAB governance activities. o Prepare agendas, drive risk discussions, manage conflict resolution, and govern scheduling decisions. o Chair meetings confidently with global stakeholders and technical teams. o Ensure action tracking, governance follow-ups, and meeting documentation. o Challenge or reject risky, incomplete, or non-compliant changes. o Conduct Post Implementation Reviews (PIRs) for failed changes and change-related outages. o Identify governance gaps and operational improvement opportunities, and drive corrective/preventive actions with documented lessons learned. o Participating in root cause discussions with technical teams for potentially failed changes causing outages. o Ensure adherence to global Change Management policies and governance standards. o Monitor Change Management SLA breaches, aging backlog, drive strong governance to reduce unauthorized changes, and failed changes. o Conduct Change Management training and awareness sessions for global and Japan-region stakeholders in both English and Japanese. o Create and manage policy and procedural documents and knowledge articles. o Support Japan-region Change Governance activities through bilingual communication in English and Japanese. o Conduct and support CAB/TAB meetings, governance discussions, operational reviews, and stakeholder coordination in Japanese where required. o Review, validate, and manage Change Management communications, governance emails, and operational updates in Japanese and English. Stakeholder Management & Reporting. o Drive Change Governance for global stakeholders, including Japan-region stakeholders, by providing process guidance in both English and Japanese. o Handle bilingual governance communications, operational escalations, and stakeholder discussions professionally. o Publish and manage governance dashboards, KPI metrics, and operational insights. AI & Operational Readiness. o Support AI-enabled ITSM operational models and governance automation. o Adapt to AI-assisted reporting, workflow optimization, and evolving operational models. Mandatory Skills & Experience. o Strong experience in Change Management and ITIL 4 based Change Enablement operations (ITIL4 Certified). o Proven expertise in enterprise Change Governance and CAB/TAB leadership. o Experience governing high-risk and critical production changes. o Strong operational risk assessment and escalation management capability. o Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills. o Hands-on experience with ServiceNow ITSM tool. o Strong analytical capability, governance reporting expertise, and operational ownership mindset. o Exposure to AI-driven operational models. o 5 - 7 years of experience in Change Management operations and governance. o Ability to work in a 24x5 support environment. o Strong bilingual communication capability in English and Japanese (written and verbal). o Experience supporting Japan-region stakeholders and multilingual governance operations. o Ability to independently handle governance calls, meetings, reporting, and communications in Japanese. o Business-level Japanese communication capability is mandatory. Preferred Skills. o Change Management operational experience in Insurance, Banking, or Financial Services industry domain. o Power BI reporting / dashboard experience. o Experience supporting global ITSM operations and service improvement initiatives. o Experience supporting Japanese clients or Japan-region IT operations. What We Are Looking For. o A strong Change Management operator - not a ticket coordinator. o Someone who can confidently lead CAB/TAB discussions and constructively challenge technical teams. o A professional who understands operational risk, governance, and production stability with strong decision-making capability. o A self-driven individual who can enforce compliance with minimal supervision. o Someone who can balance governance, business urgency, and operational stability effectively. o A professional capable of confidently managing bilingual governance discussions and stakeholder interactions across global and Japan-region teams. Language Requirement. o Business-level communication capability in both English and Japanese is mandatory. o Ability to handle governance meetings, CAB/TAB discussions, operational reviews, emails, and stakeholder communications in Japanese. o Ability to work effectively with global and Japan-region stakeholders in a multilingual operational environment. . 15 years full time education. . We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Linux Security Operations Engineer to join our Security Operations Center (SOC). In this role, you will be responsible for safeguarding our Linux-based infrastructure, detecting and responding to security threats, implementing hardening standards, and maintaining compliance across production environments. You will work closely with the Security Delivery Project Manager, DevOps, IT infrastructure, and risk management teams to proactively identify vulnerabilities, investigate security incidents, and drive continuous improvement of our security posture. The position is equally suited for internal candidates looking to grow within our security function and external professionals with a strong Linux security background.. This role participates in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 coverage for critical security events.. To keep it short, below are some key responsibilities:. • Monitor Linux-based systems, servers, and network infrastructure using SIEM tools (e.g., Splunk, Tanium) for anomalous activity, intrusion attempts, and policy violations. • Investigate, triage, and respond to security incidents involving Linux endpoints and servers, following established IR playbooks and escalation procedures. Perform RCA on security events and produce detailed post-incident reports with remediation recommendations. • Implement and maintain OS-level security hardening baselines for Linux distributions (RHEL, CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian). • Manage and audit security configurations using infrastructure-as-code tools such as Ansible, Puppet. • Conduct regular vulnerability scans of Linux systems using tools such as Nessus or Qualys, and prioritize remediation based on risk severity. • Evaluate CVEs and security advisories (e.g., from NVD, RedHat, Ubuntu Security) for applicability to the environment and communicate risk to stakeholders. • Administer and audit user accounts, sudo privileges, SSH key management, configurations across Linux infrastructure. • Configure and maintain centralized logging pipelines for Linux systems using syslog-ng, rsyslog, Fluentd, or the Elastic Stack (ELK). • Conduct proactive threat hunting based on threat intelligence feeds. • Support compliance, external and internal audits. • Maintain accurate and up-to-date documentation. . Requirements and technical knowledge:. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field. 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a Linux system administration or security engineering role. Demonstrated experience with incident detection and response in Linux environments. Strong working knowledge of at least two major Linux distributions: RHEL/CentOS, Ubuntu, Debian, or SUSE. Experience with scripting for security automation (Bash, Python, or equivalent). Deep understanding of Linux security architecture: kernel security modules, namespaces, cgroups, capabilities, and seccomp profiles. Good understanding of security tools: Nessus/Qualys (vulnerability scanning), Fail2ban, iptables/nftables/firewalld. Understanding of network protocols and traffic analysis tools (Wireshark, tcpdump, Zeek/Bro).. Bonus points if you have:. Hands-on experience with SIEM platforms (Splunk, Elastic SIEM, or similar) for log analysis and alerting. Familiarity with container security (Docker, Kubernetes) and securing containerized Linux workloads. Professional certifications :. CompTIA Security+ or CompTIA Linux+. RHCSA / RHCE (Red Hat Certified System/Security Administrator). Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP). GIAC Certified Enterprise Defender (GCED) or GIAC Security Essentials (GSEC). Certified Ethical Hacker (CEH) or Offensive Security Certified Professional (OSCP) - advantageous. . Support observability through OpenTelemetry, CloudWatch, and Grafana dashboards.. . Additional Information:. - The candidate should have minimum 5 years of experience in Spring Boot. - This position is based at our Bengaluru office. - A 15 years full time education is required.. . . 15 years full time education. . title: Windows Security Operations Engineer
description: Accenture i s a global professional services company with leading capabilities in digital, cloud, and security. Combining unmatched experience and specialized skills across more than 40 industries, we offer Strategy and Consulting, Technology and Operations services, and Accenture Song - all powered by the world's largest network of Advanced Technology and Intelligent Operations centers. Our 740,000+ people deliver on the promise of technology and human ingenuity every day, serving clients in more than 120 countries. We are looking for a hands-on Security Engineer to protect and continuously improve Windows environments across Windows Server, Active Directory, endpoints, and Azure/hybrid services. You will translate vulnerability findings, alert data, and security-policy requirements into tested, automated, and auditable improvements - working alongside IAM, platform, cloud, and DevOps teams. The role combines deep technical engineering with managed-service discipline: clear ownership, transparent communication, and verifiable outcomes delivered within customer governance processes.. This role participates in on-call rotations to provide 24/7 coverage for critical security events.. To keep it short, below are some key responsibilities:. • Own Windows hardening profiles for servers, endpoints, and Active Directory; assess deviations, implement through the change process, and verify control effectiveness. • Design and maintain GPO architecture including staged deployment, conflict analysis, change control, and rollback procedures. • Own end-to-end remediation for assigned Windows findings: validate, prioritize by severity and exposure, remediate, rescan, and capture formal closure evidence. • Provide technical input for risk exceptions and compensating controls; perform trend analysis to identify systemic weaknesses. • Own Microsoft Intune and MDE policy, compliance, enrollment, integration, sensor health, and complex troubleshooting. • Convert lessons learned into hardening improvements, detection contributions, automation, and runbook updates. • Develop production-quality PowerShell and Ansible/AWX automation with version control, peer review, structured error handling, and secure credential management. Manage assigned work by risk, priority, SLA, and customer maintenance window; keep tickets, runbooks, and handovers accurate and current.. . Requirements and technical knowledge:. Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, Information Technology, or a closely related technical field. 3-5 years of hands-on experience in a Windows Server system administration and troubleshooting and/or security engineering role - services, registry, permissions, event logs, Defender Firewall, BitLocker, and secure remote management. Active Directory architecture: Forests, domains, trusts, GPOs, Kerberos/NTLM, DC hardening, gMSA, LAPS, privileged access, and recovery. Endpoint & server security: MDE or similar EDR onboarding, policies, alerts, exclusions, sensor health, and troubleshooting. Automation engineering: Production-grade PowerShell, Ansible/AWX, Git, secure credentials, error handling, rollback, and peer review. Azure/hybrid fundamentals: Entra ID, hybrid identity, Azure RBAC, network and monitoring dependencies, and shared responsibility. Logging & investigation: Windows and PowerShell logs plus SIEM tools such as Splunk for triage and containment. ITSM & change management: Incident, problem, change, and request processes, including risk, testing, rollback, and evidence.. Bonus points if you have:. Vulnerability remediation: End-to-end lifecycle using Qualys or comparable: finding validation, risk prioritization, remediation, exceptions, rescanning, and formal closure evidence. Microsoft Intune security baselines for cloud-managed Windows. Microsoft Entra ID: Conditional Access, PIM, access reviews, hybrid join, and sync. Defender for Cloud and Servers: posture and workload protection. Windows LAPS, Credential Guard, BitLocker, Application Control, and ASR. PKI and AD CS: certificate authentication and TLS troubleshooting. Forensics and threat hunting.. . The Rest of the qualities, you know them:. Fluent in English, both verbal and written. We are looking for a skilled HealthEdge Developer to join our healthcare insurance project.
